translation: May kapamilya po ba kayo na nagkaroon ng hika o sakit sa baga?

english: Has anyone in your family had lung cancer?
transliteration: may ka-pa-MIL-ya po ba ka-YO na nag-ka-ROON nang kan-SER sa ba-GA
translation: May kapamilya po ba kayo na nagkaroon ng kanser sa baga?

english: Have you recently travelled outside the country?
transliteration: nag-lak-BAY po ba ka-YO ka-ma-ka-ee-LAN sa la-OB nang ban-SA
translation: Naglakbay po ba kayo kamakailan sa labas ng bansa?

english: I am going to listen to your lungs with a stethoscope.
transliteration: pa-ki-king-GAN ko po ang ee-NYONG mga ba-GA ga-MIT ang is-te-tos-KOP
translation: Pakikinggan ko po ang inyong mga baga gamit ang istetoskop.

english: Please sit upright.
transliteration: oo-MOO-po po ka-YO nang too-WID
translation: Umupo po kayo nang tuwid.

english: Please loosen your shirt so I can examine your chest.
transliteration: pa-ki-loo-WA-gan po ang ee-NYONG da-MIT pa-RA ma-SOO-ri ko ang ee-NYONG dib-DIB
translation: Pakiluwagan po ang inyong damit para masuri ko ang inyong dibdib.

english: Please breathe in deeply through your mouth.
transliteration: hoo-MEE-nga po ka-YO nang ma-la-LIM sa pa-ma-ma-GI-tan nang bee-BIG
translation: Huminga po kayo nang malalim sa pamamagitan ng bibig.

english: Please breathe out slowly.
transliteration: da-HAN-da-HAN po ka-YONG hoo-MEE-nga pa-la-OB
translation: Dahan-dahan po kayong huminga palabas.

english: Please hold your breath for a moment.
transliteration: pee-GEE-lan po nee-NYO ang pag-hee-NGA san-da-LEE
translation: Pigilan po ninyo ang paghinga sandali.

english: Please cough for me.
transliteration: oo-MOO-bo po ka-YO pa-RA sa a-KIN
translation: Umubo po kayo para sa akin.

english: I am going to check your oxygen level with this finger clip.
transliteration: soo-soo-KA-tin ko po ang an-TAS nang ok-see-JEN nee-NYO ga-MIT ang pang-EE-pit na EE-to sa da-LEE-ree
translation: Susukatin ko po ang antas ng oxygen ninyo gamit ang pang-ipit na ito sa daliri.

english: I am going to count how many breaths you take in a minute.
transliteration: bee-bee-LAN-gin ko po kung EE-lang be-ses ka-YONG hoo-MEE-nga sa loob nang EE-sang mee-NOO-to
translation: Bibilangin ko po kung ilang beses kayong humihinga sa loob ng isang minuto.

english: I am going to gently tap on your back.
transliteration: da-HAN-da-HAN ko pong ta-ta-PEE-tin ang ee-NYONG lee-KOD
translation: Dahan-dahan ko pong tatapikin ang inyong likod.

english: Does it hurt when I press here?
transliteration: ma-sa-KIT po ba ka-PA pe-nee-pee-SIL ko ree-TO
translation: Masakit po ba kapag pinipisil ko rito?

english: We would like to do a chest X-ray.
transliteration: GOOS-to po na-MIN mag-pa eks-RAY nang dib-DIB
translation: Gusto po naming magpa-X-ray ng dibdib.

english: Have you had a chest X-ray before?
transliteration: nag-pa eks-RAY na po ba ka-YO nang dib-DIB da-TEE
translation: Nagpa-X-ray na po ba kayo ng dibdib dati?

english: We may need a CT scan of your chest.
transliteration: ma-aa-REENG ka-ee-LAN-gan po na-MIN nang see-TEE scan nang dib-DIB nee-NYO
translation: Maaaring kailangan po namin ng CT scan ng dibdib ninyo.

english: We would like to check your blood oxygen level.
transliteration: GOOS-to po na-MIN soo-ree-YIN ang an-TAS nang ok-see-JEN sa ee-NYONG da-RA
translation: Gusto po naming suriin ang antas ng oxygen sa inyong dugo.

english: We need to take a blood sample.
transliteration: ka-ee-LAN-gan po na-MIN koo-MU-ha nang sam-POL nang da-RA
translation: Kailangan po naming kumuha ng sample ng dugo.

english: We would like to test a sample of your sputum.
transliteration: GOOS-to po na-MIN soo-ree-YIN ang sam-POL nang ple-MA nee-NYO
translation: Gusto po naming suriin ang sample ng plema ninyo.

english: We would like to measure how well your lungs work.
transliteration: GOOS-to po na-MIN soo-MA-tin kung ga-A-no ka-HU-say goo-ma-GA-na ang ee-NYONG mga ba-GA
translation: Gusto po naming sukatin kung gaano kahusay gumagana ang inyong mga baga.

english: Please blow out as hard and fast as you can into this tube.
transliteration: boo-MOO-ga po ka-YO nang na-pang-ma-LA-kas at na-pang-ma-BIL-is na ka-YA nee-NYO sa too-BONG EE-to
translation: Bumuga po kayo nang pinakamalakas at pinakamabilis na kaya ninyo sa tubong ito.

english: We may need to do a sleep study.
transliteration: ma-aa-REENG ka-ee-LAN-gan po na-MIN mag-sa-ga-WA nang pag-soo-SOO-ree ha-BANG na-too-too-LOG ka-YO
translation: Maaaring kailangan po naming magsagawa ng pagsusuri habang natutulog kayo.

english: We may need to look inside your airways with a small camera.
transliteration: ma-aa-REENG ka-ee-LAN-gan po na-MIN see-lee-PIN ang loob nang ee-NYONG mga da-a-NAN nang ha-NGIN ga-MIT ang ma-LEE-it na ka-ME-ra
translation: Maaaring kailangan po naming silipin ang loob ng inyong mga daanan ng hangin gamit ang maliit na kamera.

english: We will give you oxygen to help you breathe.
transliteration: bee-bee-GYAN po na-MIN ka-YO nang ok-see-JEN pa-RA ma-ka-hee-NGA ka-YO
translation: Bibigyan po namin kayo ng oxygen para makahinga kayo.

english: This inhaler helps open your airways.
transliteration: too-too-LOONG po ang in-HEE-ler na EE-to na boo-MOO-kas ang mga da-a-NAN nang ha-NGIN nee-NYO
translation: Tumutulong po ang inhaler na ito na bumukas ang mga daanan ng hangin ninyo.

english: I will show you how to use your inhaler.
transliteration: ee-too-TOO-ro ko po sa ee-NYO kung pa-A-no ga-ME-tin ang in-HEE-ler nee-NYO
translation: Ituturo ko po sa inyo kung paano gamitin ang inhaler ninyo.

english: Please follow the dose written on your prescription.
transliteration: soon-DOON po nee-NYO ang DO-sis na na-ka-soo-LAT sa re-SE-ta nee-NYO
translation: Sundin po ninyo ang dosis na nakasulat sa reseta ninyo.

english: Do not change the dose without speaking to your healthcare team.
transliteration: hoo-WAG po nee-NYONG ba-GO-heen ang DO-sis nang HIN-dee moo-NA na-ki-ki-pag-oo-SA-p sa pang-KAT nang ee-NYONG ta-ga-pa-GA-la-ga nang ka-loo-SOO-gan
translation: Huwag po ninyong baguhin ang dosis nang hindi muna nakikipag-usap sa pangkat ng inyong tagapag-alaga ng kalusugan.

english: Please rinse your mouth after using this steroid inhaler.
transliteration: mag-MOO-mog po ka-YO pag-ka-ta-POS ga-ME-tin ang STE-roid in-HEE-ler na EE-to
translation: Magmumog po kayo pagkatapos gamitin ang steroid inhaler na ito.

english: We can help you make a plan to stop smoking.
transliteration: ma-too-too-LOON-gan po na-MIN ka-YONG goo-MA-wa nang pla-NO pa-RA too-MEE-gil sa pa-nee-nee-ga-REE-lyo
translation: Matutulungan po namin kayong gumawa ng plano para tumigil sa paninigarilyo.

english: Please wear a mask as instructed.
transliteration: mag-soo-SOOT po ka-YO nang mask a-YON sa ee-tee-NOO-ro sa ee-NYO
translation: Magsuot po kayo ng mask ayon sa itinuro sa inyo.

english: Seek urgent medical care if your breathing becomes severely difficult.
transliteration: mag-pa-ga-MOT po a-GAD kung loob-HA nang na-hi-hee-RA-pan ka-YONG hoo-MEE-nga
translation: Magpagamot po agad kung lubha nang nahihirapan kayong huminga.

english: Seek urgent medical care if you cough up a large amount of blood.
transliteration: mag-pa-ga-MOT po a-GAD kung oo-MOO-bo ka-YO nang ma-ra-MING da-RA
translation: Magpagamot po agad kung umubo kayo ng maraming dugo.

english: Do you have any questions?
transliteration: may mga ta-NONG po ba ka-YO
translation: May mga tanong po ba kayo?

english: Can you tell me how you will use your inhaler at home?
transliteration: ma-aa-REE po ba nee-NYONG sa-bee-HIN sa a-KIN kung pa-A-no nee-NYO ga-ga-ME-tin ang in-HEE-ler nee-NYO sa ba-HAY
translation: Maaari po ba ninyong sabihin sa akin kung paano ninyo gagamitin ang inhaler ninyo sa bahay?

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: a-a-YO-sin po na-MIN ang is-ke-JOOL nang soo-SOO-nod nee-NYONG a-point-MENT
translation: Aayusin po namin ang iskedyul ng susunod ninyong appointment.

english: We may refer you to a lung specialist.
transliteration: ma-aa-REENG ee-ree-FER po na-MIN ka-YO sa es-pe-SYA-lis-ta sa ba-GA
translation: Maaaring i-refer po namin kayo sa espesyalista sa baga.

english: Please return if your symptoms get worse.
transliteration: boo-MA-lik po ka-YO kung loo-MA-la ang mga simp-TOM nee-NYO
translation: Bumalik po kayo kung lumala ang mga sintomas ninyo.

english: Thank you for speaking with me today.
transliteration: sa-LA-mat po sa pak-ki-pag-oo-SA-p sa a-KIN nga-YONG A-raw
translation: Salamat po sa pakikipag-usap sa akin ngayong araw.

english: Hello, I am part of your healthcare team.
transliteration: koo-MOOS-ta po ka-BIL-ang a-KO sa pang-KAT nang ee-NYONG mga ta-ga-pa-GA-la-ga nang ka-loo-SOO-gan
translation: Kumusta po, kabilang ako sa pangkat ng inyong mga tagapag-alaga ng kalusugan.

english: What brought you here today?
transliteration: a-NO po ang nag-DA-la sa ee-NYO ree-TO nga-YONG A-raw
translation: Ano po ang nagdala sa inyo rito ngayong araw?

english: I would like to ask some questions about your stomach and digestion.
transliteration: GOOS-to ko po ka-YONG ta-NO-ngin tooNG-KOL sa tee-yan at pa-noo-NAW nee-NYO
translation: Gusto ko po kayong tanungin tungkol sa tiyan at panunaw ninyo.

english: What is worrying you the most?
transliteration: a-NO po ang pee-na-ka-na-ka-ba-ba-LA sa ee-NYO
translation: Ano po ang pinakanakababahala sa inyo?

english: May I examine your abdomen?
transliteration: ma-aa-REE ko po bang soo-ree-YIN ang tee-yan nee-NYO
translation: Maaari ko po bang suriin ang tiyan ninyo?

english: Please tell me if anything hurts.
transliteration: pa-kee-sa-BEE po sa a-KIN kung may ma-sa-KIT
translation: Pakisabi po sa akin kung may masakit.

english: Do you need an interpreter?
transliteration: ka-ee-LAN-gan po ba nee-NYO nang in-TER-pre-ter
translation: Kailangan po ba ninyo ng interpreter?

english: When did your symptoms begin?
transliteration: ka-ee-LAN po nag-sim-BU-la ang mga simp-TOM nee-NYO
translation: Kailan po nagsimula ang mga sintomas ninyo?

english: Did the problem start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: big-LA-an po bang nag-sim-BU-la ang prob-LE-ma o oon-tee-OON-tee
translation: Biglaan po bang nagsimula ang problema o unti-unti?

english: How long have you had this problem?
transliteration: ga-A-no na po ka-ta-GAL ang prob-LE-mang EE-to
translation: Gaano na po katagal ang problemang ito?

english: Is it getting better or worse?
transliteration: boo-MA-boo-TEE po ba EE-to o loo-MA-la
translation: Bumabuti po ba ito o lumalala?

english: Does it come and go?
transliteration: pa-ba-LEE-balik po ba EE-to
translation: Pabalik-balik po ba ito?

english: Have you had this problem before?
transliteration: na-ya-REE na po ba sa ee-NYO ang prob-LE-mang EE-to da-TEE
translation: Nangyari na po ba sa inyo ang problemang ito dati?

english: Does it wake you up at night?
transliteration: nee-gi-GEE-sing po ba ka-YO nee-to sa ga-BEE
translation: Ginagising po ba kayo nito sa gabi?

english: Do you have pain in your abdomen?
transliteration: may pa-na-NA-kit po ba ka-YO sa tee-yan
translation: May pananakit po ba kayo sa tiyan?

english: Where exactly does it hurt?
transliteration: sa-A-an po mee-SEE-mo ang ma-sa-KIT
translation: Saan po mismo ang masakit?

english: Please point to where it hurts most.
transliteration: ee-TOO-ro po nee-NYO kung sa-A-an pee-na-ka-ma-sa-KIT
translation: Ituro po ninyo kung saan pinakamasakit.

english: Is the pain in the upper or lower abdomen?
transliteration: na-SA ee-TA-as o ee-ba-BANG ba-HA-gee po ba nang tee-yan ang sa-KIT
translation: Nasa itaas o ibabang bahagi po ba ng tiyan ang sakit?

english: Is the pain on the right or left side?
transliteration: na-SA ka-NA-an o ka-LEE-wang ba-HA-gee po ba ang sa-KIT
translation: Nasa kanan o kaliwang bahagi po ba ang sakit?

english: Is the pain around your belly button?
transliteration: sa pa-lee-GID po ba nang poo-SOD ang sa-KIT
translation: Sa paligid po ba ng pusod ang sakit?

english: Does the pain spread to your back or shoulder?
transliteration: koo-ma-ka-LAT po ba ang sa-KIT pa-poon-TA sa lee-KOD o ba-LEE-kat
translation: Kumakalat po ba ang sakit papunta sa likod o balikat?

english: Is the pain sharp, dull, burning, or cramping?
transliteration: ma-ta-LIM ma-poo-ROL mah-HAP-dee o poo-LEE-kat po ba ang sa-KIT
translation: Matalim, mapurol, mahapdi, o pulikat po ba ang sakit?

english: How severe is the pain from zero to ten?
transliteration: ga-A-no po ka-tin-DEE ang sa-KIT moo-LA zero hang-GANG sam-POO
translation: Gaano po katindi ang sakit mula zero hanggang sampu?

english: Is the pain constant or does it come and go?
transliteration: pa-la-GEE-an po ba ang sa-KIT o pa-ba-LEE-balik
translation: Palagian po ba ang sakit o pabalik-balik?

english: Did the pain move from one area to another?
transliteration: loo-MEE-pat po ba ang sa-KIT moo-LA sa EE-sang ba-HA-gee pa-poon-TA sa EE-ba
translation: Lumipat po ba ang sakit mula sa isang bahagi papunta sa iba?

english: Does eating make the pain better or worse?
transliteration: boo-MA-boo-TEE po ba o loo-MA-la ang sa-KIT ka-pag koo-ma-KA-in ka-YO
translation: Bumubuti po ba o lumalala ang sakit kapag kumakain kayo?

english: Is the pain worse after a fatty meal?
transliteration: mas loo-MA-la po ba ang sa-KIT pag-ka-ta-POS koo-ma-KA-in nang pag-ka-EE-ng ma-man-TEE-ka
translation: Mas lumalala po ba ang sakit pagkatapos kumain ng pagkaing mamantika?

english: Does drinking milk make your symptoms worse?
transliteration: loo-ma-la-LA po ba ang mga simp-TOM nee-NYO ka-pag oo-MEE-nom ka-YO nang ga-TAS
translation: Lumalalala po ba ang mga sintomas ninyo kapag umiinom kayo ng gatas?

english: Do spicy foods make your symptoms worse?
transliteration: loo-ma-la-LA po ba ang mga simp-TOM nee-NYO ka-pag koo-ma-KA-in ka-YO nang ma-a-Ang-hang na pag-ka-EE-an
translation: Lumalalala po ba ang mga sintomas ninyo kapag kumakain kayo ng maaanghang na pagkain?

english: Does the pain improve after passing stool?
transliteration: boo-MA-boo-TEE po ba ang sa-KIT pag-ka-ta-POS doo-MEE-mee
translation: Bumabuti po ba ang sakit pagkatapos dumumi?

english: Does passing gas relieve the pain?
transliteration: na-wa-WA-la po ba ang sa-KIT ka-pag na-ka-doo-MEE ka-YO nang ha-NGIN
translation: Nawawala po ba ang sakit kapag nakadudumi kayo ng hangin?

english: Does movement or coughing make the pain worse?
transliteration: loo-ma-la-LA po ba ang sa-KIT ka-pag goo-ma-GA-law o oo-MOO-bo ka-YO
translation: Lumalalala po ba ang sakit kapag gumagalaw o umuubo kayo?

english: Does lying down make the pain worse?
transliteration: loo-ma-la-LA po ba ang sa-KIT ka-pag na-ka-hee-LA ka-YO
translation: Lumalalala po ba ang sakit kapag nakahiga kayo?

english: What makes the pain feel better?
transliteration: a-NO po ang nag-pa-pa-ga-AN nang sa-KIT
translation: Ano po ang nagpapagaan ng sakit?

english: Do you feel nauseated or sick to your stomach?
transliteration: na-soo-soo-KA po ba ka-YO o soo-ma-sa-MA ang tee-yan nee-NYO
translation: Nasusuka po ba kayo o sumasama ang tiyan ninyo?

english: Have you vomited?
transliteration: nag-soo-KA po ba ka-YO
translation: Nagsuka po ba kayo?

english: How many times have you vomited today?
transliteration: EE-lang be-ses po ka-YONG nag-soo-KA nga-YONG A-raw
translation: Ilang beses po kayong nagsuka ngayong araw?

english: Can you keep food and fluids down?
transliteration: na-na-na-TEE-lee po ba sa tee-yan nee-NYO ang pag-ka-EE-an at lee-KI-do
translation: Nananatili po ba sa tiyan ninyo ang pagkain at likido?

english: Is there blood in your vomit?
transliteration: may da-RA po ba sa soo-KA nee-NYO
translation: May dugo po ba sa suka ninyo?

english: Does your vomit look like coffee grounds?
transliteration: ka-moo-KHA po ba nang la-Tak nang ka-PE ang soo-KA nee-NYO
translation: Kamukha po ba ng latak ng kape ang suka ninyo?

english: Is your vomit green or yellow?
transliteration: BER-de o dee-LAW po ba ang soo-KA nee-NYO
translation: Berde o dilaw po ba ang suka ninyo?

english: Do you vomit after eating?
transliteration: nag-soo-soo-KA po ba ka-YO pag-ka-ta-POS koo-ma-KA-in
translation: Nagsusuka po ba kayo pagkatapos kumain?

english: When did you last vomit?
transliteration: ka-ee-LAN po ka-YO hoo-LING nag-soo-KA
translation: Kailan po kayo huling nagsuka?

english: How often do you have a bowel movement?
transliteration: ga-A-no po ka-da-LAS ka-YO doo-MEE-mee
translation: Gaano po kayo kadalas dumumi?

english: Have your bowel habits changed recently?
transliteration: nag-ba-GO po ba ka-ma-ka-ee-LAN ang na-ka-sa-NAY-an nee-NYONG pag-doo-MEE
translation: Nagbago po ba kamakailan ang nakasanayan ninyong pagdumi?

english: When was your last bowel movement?
transliteration: ka-ee-LAN po ka-YO hoo-LING doo-MEE-mee
translation: Kailan po kayo huling dumumi?

english: Is your stool hard or soft?
transliteration: ma-ti-GAS po ba o ma-lam-BOT ang doo-MEE nee-NYO
translation: Matigas po ba o malambot ang dumi ninyo?

english: Is your stool watery or loose?
transliteration: ma-too-BIG po ba o ma-lam-BOT ang doo-MEE nee-NYO
translation: Matubig po ba o malambot ang dumi ninyo?

english: Is your stool black or tar-like?
transliteration: ee-TIM po ba o pa-RANG al-kee-TARAN ang doo-MEE nee-NYO
translation: Itim po ba o parang alkitran ang dumi ninyo?

english: Have you noticed red blood in your stool?
transliteration: may na-pa-NA-sin po ba ka-YONG poo-LANG da-RA sa doo-MEE nee-NYO
translation: May napansin po ba kayong pulang dugo sa dumi ninyo?

english: Is there mucus in your stool?
transliteration: may OO-hog po ba sa doo-MEE nee-NYO
translation: May uhog po ba sa dumi ninyo?

english: Is your stool pale or clay-coloured?
transliteration: ma-poo-TLA po ba o koo-LAY poo-TIK ang doo-MEE nee-NYO
translation: Maputla po ba o kulay putik ang dumi ninyo?

english: Is your stool greasy or difficult to flush?
transliteration: ma-man-TEE-ka po ba ang doo-MEE nee-NYO o ma-HEE-rap ee-flush
translation: Mamantika po ba ang dumi ninyo o mahirap i-flush?

english: Do you feel you have completely emptied your bowels?
transliteration: pa-ki-ram-DAM po ba nee-NYO ay na-ee-la-BAS na nee-NYO nang boo-O ang doo-MEE
translation: Pakiramdam po ba ninyo ay nailabas na ninyo nang buo ang dumi?

english: Do you have difficulty controlling your bowel movements?
transliteration: na-hee-hee-RA-pan po ba ka-YONG kon-tro-LIN ang pag-doo-MEE nee-NYO
translation: Nahihirapan po ba kayong kontrolin ang pagdumi ninyo?

english: Do you have diarrhea?
transliteration: nag-ta-TAE po ba ka-YO
translation: Nagtatae po ba kayo?

english: How many loose stools have you had today?
transliteration: EE-lang be-ses po ka-YONG nag-ta-E nang ma-lam-BOT nga-YON
translation: Ilang beses po kayong nagtae nang malambot ngayon?

english: How long have you had diarrhea?
transliteration: ga-A-no na po ka-YO ka-ta-GAL nag-ta-TAE
translation: Gaano na po kayo katagal nagtatae?

english: Do you have cramps before passing stool?
transliteration: soo-ma-sa-KIT po ba ang tee-yan nee-NYO ba-GO doo-MEE-mee
translation: Sumasakit po ba ang tiyan ninyo bago dumumi?

english: Do you feel an urgent need to use the toilet?
transliteration: pa-ki-ram-DAM po ba nee-NYO ay ka-ee-LAN-gan nee-NYONG mag-ma-DA-lee mag-baan-YO
translation: Pakiramdam po ba ninyo ay kailangan ninyong magmadaling magbanyo?

english: Are you constipated?
transliteration: tee-noo-too-BEE-gan po ba ka-YO
translation: Tinutubigan po ba kayo?

english: Do you strain when passing stool?
transliteration: na-pee-pee-lee-TAN po ba ka-YONG oo-MEE-re ka-pag doo-doo-MEE
translation: Napipilitan po ba kayong umire kapag dumudumi?

english: Have you passed gas today?
transliteration: na-ka-pag-la-BAS po ba ka-YO nang ha-NGIN nga-YON
translation: Nakapaglabas po ba kayo ng hangin ngayon?

english: Are you taking laxatives or stool softeners?
transliteration: oo-mee-mee-NOM po ba ka-YO nang pam-pa-doo-MEE o pam-pa-lam-BOT nang doo-MEE
translation: Umiinom po ba kayo ng pampadumi o pampalambot ng dumi?

english: Has anyone around you also had diarrhea?
transliteration: ma-yo-ron deeN po bang nag-ta-TAE sa mga ka-sa-MA nee-NYO
translation: Mayroon din po bang nagtatae sa mga kasama ninyo?

english: Do you have heartburn or burning in your chest?
transliteration: na-ka-ka-ram-DAM po ba ka-YO nang HAP-dee sa sik-MOO-ra o pag-a-a-POY sa dib-DIB
translation: Nakakaramdam po ba kayo ng hapdi sa sikmura o pag-aapoy sa dibdib?

english: Do you have acid coming up into your throat?
transliteration: may oo-ma-a-KYAT po bang a-see-DO sa la-LA-moo-nan nee-NYO
translation: May umaakyat po bang asido sa lalamunan ninyo?

english: Do you have a sour taste in your mouth?
transliteration: may ma-a-SIM po bang la-SA sa bee-BIG nee-NYO
translation: May maasim po bang lasa sa bibig ninyo?

english: Do you burp frequently?
transliteration: ma-da-LAS po ba ka-YONG doo-mee-GHAY
translation: Madalas po ba kayong dumighay?

english: Do you have trouble swallowing food?
transliteration: na-hee-hee-RA-pan po ba ka-YONG loo-moon-GOK nang pag-ka-EE-an
translation: Nahihirapan po ba kayong lumunok ng pagkain?

english: Is swallowing painful?
transliteration: ma-sa-KIT po ba loo-moon-GOK
translation: Masakit po ba lumunok?

english: Is it harder to swallow solids or liquids?
transliteration: mas ma-HEE-rap po ba loo-moon-GOK nang ma-ti-GAS na pag-ka-EE-an o lee-KI-do
translation: Mas mahirap po ba lumunok ng matigas na pagkain o likido?

english: Does food ever feel stuck in your chest?
transliteration: pa-RANG na-ee-EE-pit po ba min-SAN ang pag-ka-EE-an sa dib-DIB nee-NYO
translation: Parang naiipit po ba minsan ang pagkain sa dibdib ninyo?

english: Do you cough or choke when swallowing?
transliteration: oo-oo-MOO-bo po ba ka-YO o na-sa-SA-mid ka-pag loo-moo-LOK
translation: Umuuubo po ba kayo o nasasamid kapag lumulunok?

english: Do you feel full after eating only a small amount?
transliteration: boo-SOG na po ba ka-YO ka-HEET ka-oon-TEE lang ang na-ka-EE-an nee-NYO
translation: Busog na po ba kayo kahit kaunti lang ang nakain ninyo?

english: Does your abdomen feel bloated or swollen?
transliteration: pa-RANG na-ma-MA-ga o loo-MOO-lo-bo po ba ang tee-yan nee-NYO
translation: Parang namamaga o lumolobo po ba ang tiyan ninyo?

english: Are you passing more gas than usual?
transliteration: mas ma-da-LAS po ba ka-YONG mag-la-BAS nang ha-NGIN ka-ysa da-TEE
translation: Mas madalas po ba kayong maglabas ng hangin kaysa dati?

english: Have you lost your appetite?
transliteration: na-wa-WA-lan po ba ka-YO nang ga-NA koo-ma-KA-in
translation: Nawalan po ba kayo ng gana kumain?

english: Have you lost weight without trying?
transliteration: poo-ma-YAT po ba ka-YO ka-HEET HIN-dee nee-NYO see-na-sa-DYA
translation: Pumayat po ba kayo kahit hindi ninyo sinasadya?

english: Have you gained weight unexpectedly?
transliteration: too-MA-ba po ba ka-YO nang HIN-dee ee-na-a-sa-HAN
translation: Tumaba po ba kayo nang hindi inaasahan?

english: Have you changed your diet recently?
transliteration: may bee-NA-go po ba ka-YO ka-ma-ka-ee-LAN sa kee-na-KA-in nee-NYO
translation: May binago po ba kayo kamakailan sa kinakain ninyo?

english: Do you avoid any foods because of symptoms?
transliteration: may ee-nee-ee-wa-SAN po ba ka-YONG pag-ka-EE-an da-HEEL sa mga simp-TOM nee-NYO
translation: May iniiwasan po ba kayong pagkain dahil sa mga sintomas ninyo?

english: How much water do you drink each day?
transliteration: ga-A-no po ka-ra-MING tu-BIG ang ee-nee-NOM nee-NYO ba-wat A-raw
translation: Gaano po karaming tubig ang iniinom ninyo bawat araw?

english: When did you last eat or drink?
transliteration: ka-ee-LAN po ka-YO hoo-LING koo-ma-KA-in o oo-MEE-nom
translation: Kailan po kayo huling kumain o uminom?

english: Have you ever had liver disease or hepatitis?
transliteration: nag-ka-ROON na po ba ka-YO nang sa-KIT sa a-TAY o hep-a-TEE-tis
translation: Nagkaroon na po ba kayo ng sakit sa atay o hepatitis?

english: Have your eyes or skin turned yellow?
transliteration: na-nee-LAW na po ba ang mga MA-ta o ba-LAT nee-NYO
translation: Nanilaw na po ba ang mga mata o balat ninyo?

english: Is your urine darker than usual?
transliteration: mas ma-ee-TIM po ba ang EE-hee nee-NYO ka-ysa da-TEE
translation: Mas maitim po ba ang ihi ninyo kaysa dati?

english: Do you have itching all over your body?
transliteration: na-nga-nga-TEE po ba ang boo-ONG koo-RAP nee-NYO
translation: Nangangati po ba ang buong katawan ninyo?

english: Have you had gallstones?
transliteration: nag-ka-ROON na po ba ka-YO nang ba-TO sa ap-DO
translation: Nagkaroon na po ba kayo ng bato sa apdo?

english: Have you had your gallbladder removed?
transliteration: na-o-pe-RA-han na po ba ka-YO pa-RA tang-GA-lin ang ap-DO
translation: Naoperahan na po ba kayo para tanggalin ang apdo?

english: Have you ever had pancreatitis?
transliteration: nag-ka-ROON na po ba ka-YO nang pan-kree-a-TEE-tis
translation: Nagkaroon na po ba kayo ng pancreatitis?

english: Have you noticed swelling in your abdomen or legs?
transliteration: may na-pa-NA-sin po ba ka-YONG pa-ma-MA-ga sa tee-yan o mga ban-TEE
translation: May napansin po ba kayong pamamaga sa tiyan o mga binti?

english: Do you bruise or bleed easily?
transliteration: ma-da-LEE po ba ka-YONG mag-ka-pa-SA o mag-doo-GO
translation: Madali po ba kayong magkapasa o magdugo?

english: Do you have pain around your anus?
transliteration: ma-sa-KIT po ba sa pa-lee-BOT nang poo-YIT nee-NYO
translation: Masakit po ba sa palibot ng puwit ninyo?

english: Do you have hemorrhoids or piles?
transliteration: may al-mo-RA-nas po ba ka-YO
translation: May almoranas po ba kayo?

english: Do you notice blood on the toilet paper?
transliteration: may na-pa-NA-pan-sin po ba ka-YONG da-RA sa tee-SYOO pag-ka-ta-POS mag-POO-nas
translation: May napapansin po ba kayong dugo sa tisyu pagkatapos magpunas?

english: Do you have itching around your anus?
transliteration: na-nga-nga-TEE po ba ang pa-lee-BOT nang poo-YIT nee-NYO
translation: Nangangati po ba ang palibot ng puwit ninyo?

english: Have you noticed a lump near your anus?
transliteration: may na-pa-NA-sin po ba ka-YONG boo-KOL ma-la-PIT sa poo-YIT nee-NYO
translation: May napansin po ba kayong bukol malapit sa puwit ninyo?

english: Is there any discharge from your anus?
transliteration: may loo-ma-LA-bas po bang lee-KI-do moo-LA sa poo-YIT nee-NYO
translation: May lumalabas po bang likido mula sa puwit ninyo?

english: Do you have pain when passing stool?
transliteration: ma-sa-KIT po ba ka-pag doo-doo-MEE ka-YO
translation: Masakit po ba kapag dumudumi kayo?

english: Have you ever had an ulcer in your stomach?
transliteration: nag-ka-ROON na po ba ka-YO nang soo-GAT sa sik-MOO-ra
translation: Nagkaroon na po ba kayo ng sugat sa sikmura?

english: Have you been diagnosed with Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis?
transliteration: na-sa-BEE-han na po ba ka-YO nang dok-TOR na may-ROON ka-YONG KROHNZ dee-ZEEZ o ul-se-RA-tiv ko-LAI-tis
translation: Nasabihan na po ba kayo ng doktor na mayroon kayong Crohn's disease o ulcerative colitis?

english: Have you ever had irritable bowel syndrome?
transliteration: nag-ka-ROON na po ba ka-YO nang ir-ri-ta-bol BOW-el SIN-drohm
translation: Nagkaroon na po ba kayo ng irritable bowel syndrome?

english: Have you had surgery on your abdomen?
transliteration: na-o-pe-RA-han na po ba ka-YO sa tee-yan
translation: Naoperahan na po ba kayo sa tiyan?

english: Have you had your appendix removed?
transliteration: na-o-pe-RA-han na po ba ka-YO pa-RA tang-GA-lin ang a-pen-DIKS
translation: Naoperahan na po ba kayo para tanggalin ang apendiks?

english: Has anyone in your family had bowel or stomach cancer?
transliteration: may nag-ka-ROON na po ba sa pa-MIL-ya nee-NYO nang kan-SER sa bee-TOO-ka o sik-MOO-ra
translation: May nagkaroon na po ba sa pamilya ninyo ng kanser sa bituka o sikmura?

english: Have you had a colonoscopy before?
transliteration: nag-pa ko-lo-NOS-ko-pee na po ba ka-YO da-TEE
translation: Nagpa-colonoscopy na po ba kayo dati?

english: Do you have any food allergies or intolerances?
transliteration: may al-ler-JEE po ba ka-YO o HIN-dee na-ti-TIS na pag-ka-EE-an
translation: May allergy po ba kayo o hindi natitiis na pagkain?

english: Have you travelled recently?
transliteration: nag-bee-YA-he po ba ka-YO ka-ma-ka-ee-LAN
translation: Nagbiyahe po ba kayo kamakailan?

english: Have you eaten any food that may have been spoiled?
transliteration: may na-ka-EE-an po ba ka-YO nang pag-ka-EE-ng pos-SEE-bleng pa-NIS
translation: May nakain po ba kayong pagkaing posibleng panis?

english: What medicines do you take regularly?
transliteration: a-NONG mga ga-MOT po ang pa-la-GEE nee-NYONG ee-nee-NOM
translation: Anong mga gamot po ang palagi ninyong iniinom?

english: Do you take ibuprofen, naproxen, or aspirin?
transliteration: oo-mee-mee-NOM po ba ka-YO nang eye-byoo-PRO-fen nap-ROK-sen o AS-pir-in
translation: Umiinom po ba kayo ng ibuprofen, naproxen, o aspirin?

english: Do you take blood thinners?
transliteration: oo-mee-mee-NOM po ba ka-YO nang pam-pa-lab-NOW nang da-RA
translation: Umiinom po ba kayo ng pampalabnaw ng dugo?

english: Have you taken antibiotics recently?
transliteration: oo-MEE-nom po ba ka-YO ka-ma-ka-ee-LAN nang an-tee-by-YO-tik
translation: Uminom po ba kayo kamakailan ng antibiotic?

english: Have you started any new medicine or supplement?
transliteration: nag-sim-BU-la po ba ka-YO nang ba-GONG ga-MOT o soo-ple-MEN-to
translation: Nagsimula po ba kayo ng bagong gamot o suplemento?

english: Do you drink alcohol?
transliteration: oo-mee-mee-NOM po ba ka-YO nang a-LAK
translation: Umiinom po ba kayo ng alak?

english: How much alcohol do you usually drink in a week?
transliteration: ga-A-no po ka-ra-MING a-LAK ang ka-ra-nee-WAN nee-NYONG ee-nee-NOM sa ee-SANG ling-GO
translation: Gaano po karaming alak ang karaniwan ninyong iniinom sa isang linggo?

english: Have you ever had problems because of alcohol?
transliteration: nag-ka-ROON na po ba ka-YO nang prob-LE-ma da-HEEL sa a-LAK
translation: Nagkaroon na po ba kayo ng problema dahil sa alak?

english: Is your abdominal pain severe right now?
transliteration: ma-TIN-de po ba ang sa-KIT nang tee-yan nee-NYO nga-YON
translation: Matindi po ba ang sakit ng tiyan ninyo ngayon?

english: Is your abdomen hard or very tender to touch?
transliteration: ma-ti-GAS po ba ang tee-yan nee-NYO o ma-sa-KIT na ma-sa-KIT ka-pag hee-na-HA-wa-kan
translation: Matigas po ba ang tiyan ninyo o masakit na masakit kapag hinahawakan?

english: Have you fainted or felt very dizzy?
transliteration: na-hee-MA-tay po ba ka-YO o na-ka-ram-DAM nang ma-TIN-ding hee-LO
translation: Nahimatay po ba kayo o nakaramdam ng matinding hilo?

english: Are you vomiting blood?
transliteration: nag-soo-soo-KA po ba ka-YO nang da-RA
translation: Nagsusuka po ba kayo ng dugo?

english: Are you passing black, tarry stool?
transliteration: ma-ee-TIM at pa-RANG al-kee-TARAN po ba ang doo-MEE nee-NYO
translation: Maitim at parang alkitran po ba ang dumi ninyo?

english: Are you passing a large amount of blood in your stool?
transliteration: ma-RA-mee po bang da-RA sa doo-MEE nee-NYO
translation: Marami po bang dugo sa dumi ninyo?

english: Are you unable to pass stool or gas?
transliteration: HIN-dee po ba ka-YO ma-ka-doo-MEE o ma-ka-pag-la-BAS nang ha-NGIN
translation: Hindi po ba kayo makadumi o makapaglabas ng hangin?

english: Have you stopped passing urine or are you urinating much less?
transliteration: too-MEE-gil po ba ka-YO sa pag-EE-hee o mas ma-koon-TEE na ang EE-hee nee-NYO
translation: Tumigil po ba kayo sa pag-ihi o mas kaunti na ang ihi ninyo?

english: Do you have fever with severe abdominal pain?
transliteration: may lag-NAT po ba ka-YO ka-sa-MA nang ma-TIN-ding sa-KIT nang tee-yan
translation: May lagnat po ba kayo kasabay ng matinding sakit ng tiyan?

english: Is there any chance you could be pregnant?
transliteration: po-SEE-bleng boo-OO-ntee po bang ma-BUN-tis ka-YO
translation: Posible po bang buntis kayo?

english: Please lie down on your back.
transliteration: hoo-ma-LEE-ga po ka-YO nang pa-tee-HA-ya
translation: Humiga po kayo nang patihaya.

english: Please bend your knees slightly.
transliteration: pa-kee-a-NGAT po nang ka-oon-TEE ang mga too-HOD nee-NYO
translation: Pakiangat po nang kaunti ang mga tuhod ninyo.

english: Please lift your shirt so I can examine your abdomen.
transliteration: pa-kee-ta-AS po ang da-MIT nee-NYO pa-RA ma-soo-REE ko ang tee-yan nee-NYO
translation: Pakitaas po ang damit ninyo para masuri ko ang tiyan ninyo.

english: I am going to listen to your abdomen.
transliteration: pa-ki-king-GAN ko po ang tee-yan nee-NYO
translation: Pakikinggan ko po ang tiyan ninyo.

english: I am going to press gently on your abdomen.
transliteration: da-HAN-da-HAN ko pong pee-pee-SIL-in ang tee-yan nee-NYO
translation: Dahan-dahan ko pong pipisilin ang tiyan ninyo.

english: Tell me if it hurts when I press here.
transliteration: sa-bee-HIN po nee-NYO sa a-KIN kung ma-sa-KIT ka-pag pee-nee-PIN-dot ko ree-TO
translation: Sabihin po ninyo sa akin kung masakit kapag pinipindot ko rito.

english: Does it hurt more when I let go?
transliteration: mas soo-ma-sa-KIT po ba ka-pag bee-nee-bee-TA-wan ko
translation: Mas sumasakit po ba kapag binibitawan ko?

english: Please take a deep breath.
transliteration: hoo-MEE-nga po ka-YO nang ma-la-LIM
translation: Huminga po kayo nang malalim.

english: I may need to examine your rectum, and I will explain why first.
transliteration: ma-aa-REENG ka-ee-LAN-gan kong soo-ree-YIN ang poo-YIT nee-NYO at ee-pa-pa-lee-wa-NAG ko moo-NA kung ba-KIT
translation: Maaaring kailangan kong suriin ang puwit ninyo, at ipapaliwanag ko muna kung bakit.

english: We would like to do some blood tests.
transliteration: GOOS-to po na-MIN mag-pa-soo-REE nang da-RA nee-NYO
translation: Gusto po naming magpasuri ng dugo ninyo.

english: We need a stool sample.
transliteration: ka-ee-LAN-gan po na-MIN nang sam-POL nang doo-MEE nee-NYO
translation: Kailangan po namin ng sampol ng dumi ninyo.

english: Please collect a stool sample in this container.
transliteration: pa-kee-ko-lek-TA po nang sam-POL nang doo-MEE nee-NYO sa la-lag-YAN na EE-to
translation: Pakikolekta po ng sampol ng dumi ninyo sa lalagyang ito.

english: We may need an ultrasound of your abdomen.
transliteration: ma-aa-REENG ka-ee-LAN-gan po na-TING mag-pa-ul-tra-SOWND nang tee-yan nee-NYO
translation: Maaaring kailangan po nating magpa-ultrasound ng tiyan ninyo.

english: We may need a CT scan of your abdomen.
transliteration: ma-aa-REENG ka-ee-LAN-gan po na-TING mag-pa see-TEE scan nang tee-yan nee-NYO
translation: Maaaring kailangan po nating magpa-CT scan ng tiyan ninyo.

english: A gastroscopy uses a small camera to look inside your food pipe and stomach.
transliteration: sa gas-TROS-ko-pee yoo-MA-ga-mit nang ma-LEE-it na ka-ME-ra pa-RA ma-KEE-ta ang loob nang la-LA-moo-nan at sik-MOO-ra
translation: Sa gastroscopy, gumagamit ng maliit na kamera para makita ang loob ng lalamunan at sikmura.

english: A colonoscopy uses a camera to look inside your large intestine.
transliteration: sa ko-lo-NOS-ko-pee yoo-MA-ga-mit nang ka-ME-ra pa-RA ma-KEE-ta ang loob nang ma-la-KING bee-TOO-ka
translation: Sa colonoscopy, gumagamit ng kamera para makita ang loob ng malaking bituka.

english: You may need to take bowel preparation before the colonoscopy.
transliteration: ma-aa-REENG ka-ee-LAN-gan nee-NYONG oo-MEE-nom nang pam-pa-LEE-nis nang bee-TOO-ka ba-GO ang ko-lo-NOS-ko-pee
translation: Maaaring kailangan ninyong uminom ng pampalinis ng bituka bago ang colonoscopy.

english: You may need to avoid eating or drinking before the procedure.
transliteration: ma-aa-REENG ka-ee-LAN-gan nee-NYONG oo-MEE-wa sa pag-ka-EE-an o pag-oo-MEE-nom ba-GO ang pro-SEE-jer
translation: Maaaring kailangan ninyong umiwas sa pagkain o pag-inom bago ang procedure.

english: We will explain the risks and ask for your consent before the procedure.
transliteration: ee-pa-pa-lee-WA-nag na-MIN ang mga pa-nga-NIB at hee-hee-NGEE na-MIN ang pa-hin-TOO-lot nee-NYO ba-GO ang pro-SEE-jer
translation: Ipapaliwanag namin ang mga panganib at hihingi kami ng pahintulot ninyo bago ang procedure.

english: We will give you fluids to prevent dehydration.
transliteration: bee-bee-GYAN po na-MIN ka-YO nang mga lee-KI-do pa-RA ma-ee-wa-SAN ang dee-hee-DRAY-shun
translation: Bibigyan po namin kayo ng mga likido para maiwasan ang dehydration.

english: Take small sips of water frequently.
transliteration: ma-da-LAS po ka-YONG oo-MEE-nom nang ka-oon-TEE-ng tu-BIG sa ba-wat la-GOK
translation: Madalas po kayong uminom ng kaunting tubig sa bawat lagok.

english: Please take this medicine as prescribed.
transliteration: ee-NOO-min po nee-NYO ang ga-MOT na EE-to a-YON sa re-SE-ta
translation: Inumin po ninyo ang gamot na ito ayon sa reseta.

english: This medicine may help reduce stomach acid.
transliteration: ma-aa-REENG ma-too-too-LOONG ang ga-MOT na EE-to pa-RA ma-ba-WA-san ang a-SEE-do sa sik-MOO-ra
translation: Maaaring makatulong ang gamot na ito para mabawasan ang asido sa sikmura.

english: Avoid foods that make your symptoms worse.
transliteration: ee-wa-SAN po ang mga pag-ka-EE-ang nag-pa-pa-loo-MA-la nang mga simp-TOM nee-NYO
translation: Iwasan po ang mga pagkaing nagpapalala ng mga sintomas ninyo.

english: Do not take painkillers such as ibuprofen unless your clinician advises it.
transliteration: hoo-WAG po ka-YONG oo-MEE-nom nang mga pam-pa-WA-la nang sa-KIT too-LAD nang eye-byoo-PRO-fen mal-ee-BAN kung ee-pee-NA-yo EE-to nang dok-TOR nee-NYO
translation: Huwag po kayong uminom ng mga pampawala ng sakit tulad ng ibuprofen maliban kung ipinayo ito ng doktor ninyo.

english: We may refer you to a digestive system specialist.
transliteration: ma-aa-REENG ee-ree-FER na-MIN ka-YO sa es-pe-SYA-lis-ta sa sis-TE-ma nang pag-toon-GAW
translation: Maaaring i-refer namin kayo sa espesyalista sa sistema ng pagtunaw.

english: If you develop severe pain or bleeding, seek urgent medical care.
transliteration: koong mag-ka-roon po ka-yo nang ma-tee-ding pa-na-na-kit o pag-du-ROO-go, mag-pa-ting-in po a-GAD sa dok-TOR.
translation: Kung magkaroon po kayo ng matinding pananakit o pagdurugo, magpatingin po agad sa doktor.

english: Do you have any questions?
transliteration: may mga ta-NONG po ba ka-yo?
translation: May mga tanong po ba kayo?

english: Can you tell me what symptoms would make you seek urgent help?
transliteration: ma-sa-SA-bi po ba ni-NYO sa a-KIN kung a-NONG mga simp-TO-mas ang da-HEE-lan pa-ra hu-MEE-ngi ka-yo a-GAD nang tu-LOONG?
translation: Masasabi po ba ninyo sa akin kung anong mga sintomas ang dahilan para humingi kayo agad ng tulong?

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: a-a-YOO-sin po na-MIN ang is-ke-DYOOL nang su-SU-nod ni-NYONG a-point-MENT.
translation: Aayusin po namin ang iskedyul ng susunod ninyong appointment.

english: Please return if your symptoms get worse.
transliteration: mag-pa-ting-in po oo-LEET kung loo-MA-la ang mga simp-TO-mas ni-NYO.
translation: Magpatingin po ulit kung lumala ang mga sintomas ninyo.

english: Thank you for speaking with me today.
transliteration: sa-LA-mat po sa pa-ki-ki-pag-oo-sap sa a-KIN nga-YON.
translation: Salamat po sa pakikipag-usap sa akin ngayon.

english: Hello, I am part of your healthcare team.
transliteration: ka-BEE-lang po a-KO sa pang-KAT ni-NYO sa pa-nga-nga-LA-gang pang-ka-LOO-soo-gan.
translation: Kabilang po ako sa pangkat ninyo sa pangangalagang pangkalusugan.

english: What brought you here today?
transliteration: a-NO po ang nag-DA-la sa in-YO ree-TO nga-YON?
translation: Ano po ang nagdala sa inyo rito ngayon?

english: I would like to ask some questions about your urinary health.
transliteration: GOOS-to ko po sa-NANG mag-ta-NONG tung-KOL sa ka-LOO-soo-gan nang ee-NYONG pag-EE-hee.
translation: Gusto ko po sanang magtanong tungkol sa kalusugan ng inyong pag-ihi.

english: Some questions may be personal; is that okay?
transliteration: ma-a-a-REE-ng per-so-NAL ang ee-LANG ta-NONG; a-YOS lang po ba EE-yon?
translation: Maaaring personal ang ilang tanong; ayos lang po ba iyon?

english: May I examine you?
transliteration: ma-a-REE po ba kee-TANG soo-REE-in?
translation: Maaari po ba kitang suriin?

english: Would you like a chaperone present for the examination?
transliteration: GOOS-to po ba ni-NYO nang ka-SA-ma ha-BANG see-noo-SOO-ree ka-YO?
translation: Gusto po ba ninyo ng kasama habang sinusuri kayo?

english: Do you need an interpreter?
transliteration: ka-ee-LANGAN po ba ni-NYO nang ta-ga-sa-LEEN?
translation: Kailangan po ba ninyo ng tagasalin?

english: When did the problem begin?
transliteration: ka-EE-lan po nag-see-MOO-la ang prob-LE-ma?
translation: Kailan po nagsimula ang problema?

english: Did it start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: big-LA-an po ba EE-tong nag-see-MOO-la o oon-tee-oon-TEE?
translation: Biglaan po ba itong nagsimula o unti-unti?

english: How long have you had these symptoms?
transliteration: ga-a-NO na po ka-TA-gal ang mga simp-TO-mas na EE-to?
translation: Gaano na po katagal ang mga sintomas na ito?

english: Are the symptoms getting better or worse?
transliteration: boo-ma-BOO-tee po ba o loo-MA-la ang mga simp-TO-mas?
translation: Bumabuti po ba o lumalala ang mga sintomas?

english: Does the problem come and go?
transliteration: pa-ba-LEEK-ba-LEEK po ba ang prob-LE-ma?
translation: Pabalik-balik po ba ang problema?

english: Have you had this problem before?
transliteration: na-ra-NA-san na po ba ni-NYO EE-to da-TEE?
translation: Naranasan na po ba ninyo ito dati?

english: What concerns you most about these symptoms?
transliteration: a-NO po ang pee-na-ka-na-ba-ba-HA-la sa in-YO tung-KOL sa mga simp-TO-mas na EE-to?
translation: Ano po ang pinakanababahala sa inyo tungkol sa mga sintomas na ito?

english: Are you urinating more often than usual?
transliteration: mas ma-da-LAS po ba ka-YONG oo-mee-EE-hee ka-ysa da-TEE?

english: Have you suddenly lost control of your bladder or bowels?
transliteration: big-LA po ba ka-YONG na-WA-lan nang kon-TROL sa pag-EE-hee o pag-DOO-mee?
translation: Bigla po ba kayong nawalan ng kontrol sa pag-ihi o pagdumi?

english: Have you been vomiting and unable to keep fluids down?
transliteration: nag-soo-SOO-ka po ba ka-yo at HIN-dee ma-ka-ee-NOOM nang TOO-big nang HIN-dee ee-noo-SOO-ka?
translation: Nagsusuka po ba kayo at hindi makainom ng tubig nang hindi isinusuka?

english: Please lie down on your back.
transliteration: hoo-MI-ga po ka-yo nang na-ka-tee-HA-ya.
translation: Humiga po kayo nang nakatihaya.

english: I will examine your abdomen and lower back.
transliteration: soo-soo-REE-in ko po ang tee-AN at ee-ba-BANG ba-HA-gee nang lee-KOD ni-NYO.
translation: Susuriin ko po ang tiyan at ibabang bahagi ng likod ninyo.

english: Please point to the area that hurts.
transliteration: ee-TOO-ro po ni-NYO kung sa-AN ma-SA-keit.
translation: Ituro po ninyo kung saan masakit.

english: I will press gently on your lower abdomen.
transliteration: da-HAN-da-HAN ko pong pee-pee-SEE-lin ang ee-ba-BANG ba-HA-gee nang tee-AN ni-NYO.
translation: Dahan-dahan ko pong pipisilin ang ibabang bahagi ng tiyan ninyo.

english: Tell me if it hurts when I press here.
transliteration: sa-BEEN po ni-NYO kung ma-SA-keit ka-pag pee-pee-SEE-lin ko ree-TO.
translation: Sabihin po ninyo kung masakit kapag pinipisil ko rito.

english: I am going to tap gently on your back near the kidneys.
transliteration: ma-RA-han ko pong ka-ka-TOO-kin ang lee-KOD ni-NYO ma-lee-PIT sa mga ba-TO.
translation: Marahan ko pong kakatukin ang likod ninyo malapit sa mga bato.

english: I may need to examine your genital area; I will explain and ask permission first.
transliteration: ma-a-REE-ng ka-ee-LANG-an kong soo-REE-in ang a-REE ni-NYO; ee-pa-pa-lee-WA-nag ko MOO-na at hi-hee-NGEE a-KO nang pa-hin-TU-lot.
translation: Maaaring kailangan kong suriin ang ari ninyo; ipapaliwanag ko muna at hihingi ako ng pahintulot.

english: Please tell me immediately if anything hurts.
transliteration: sa-BEEN po ni-NYO a-GAD kung may ma-SA-keit.
translation: Sabihin po ninyo agad kung may masakit.

english: We can pause or stop the examination at any time.
transliteration: ma-a-REE po ta-YONG hum-mee-NTO san-TA-be o it-TEE-gil ang pag-soo-SOO-ree a-NU-mang a-RAW.
translation: Maaari po tayong huminto sandali o itigil ang pagsusuri anumang oras.

english: A prostate examination may be helpful; I will explain it first.
transliteration: ma-a-a-YO-long ang pag-soo-SOO-ree sa pros-TATE; ee-pa-pa-lee-WA-nag ko MOO-na EE-to.
translation: Maaaring makatulong ang pagsusuri sa prostate; ipapaliwanag ko muna ito.

english: The prostate examination may involve a gloved finger in the rectum.
transliteration: ma-a-REE-ng may ee-PA-sok na da-TEER-ing may GOO-wan-tes sa poo-WEET sa pag-soo-SOO-ree nang pros-TATE.
translation: Maaaring may ipasok na daliring may guwantes sa puwit sa pagsusuri ng prostate.

english: Is it okay to proceed with this examination?
transliteration: a-YOS lang po ba sa in-YO kung it-TEE-loy na-TIN ang pag-soo-SOO-ree-EE-to?
translation: Ayos lang po ba sa inyo kung ituloy natin ang pagsusuring ito?

english: Would you like a chaperone for this examination?
transliteration: GOOS-to po ba ni-NYO nang ka-SA-ma sa see-LOOD ha-BANG ee-nee-SA-sa-GA-wa ang pag-soo-SOO-ree-EE-to?
translation: Gusto po ba ninyo ng kasama sa silid habang isinasagawa ang pagsusuring ito?

english: Please turn onto your side.
transliteration: poo-MEE-hit po ka-yo at hoo-ma-RAP sa ta-GEE-liran.
translation: Pumihit po kayo at humarap sa tagiliran.

english: Please bend your knees toward your chest.
transliteration: ee-ba-LOONG-kot po ni-NYO ang mga too-HOD pa-POON-ta sa dib-DIB.
translation: Ibaluktot po ninyo ang mga tuhod papunta sa dibdib.

english: I will check for swelling or tenderness in the scrotum.
transliteration: tee-TEE-ngnan ko po kung may pa-ma-MA-ga o pa-na-na-KIT sa es-KRO-tum.
translation: Titingnan ko po kung may pamamaga o pananakit sa eskrotum.

english: Please cough while I examine your groin.
transliteration: oo-MOO-bo po ka-yo ha-BANG soo-noo-SOO-ree ko ang see-NGEET ni-NYO.
translation: Umubo po kayo habang sinusuri ko ang singit ninyo.

english: We need a urine sample.
transliteration: ka-ee-LANG-an po na-MIN nang SAM-pol nang EE-hee.
translation: Kailangan po namin ng sample ng ihi.

english: Please collect urine in this clean container.
transliteration: ee-POON-in po ang EE-hee sa ma-LEE-nis na la-LA-yang EE-to.
translation: Ipunin po ang ihi sa malinis na lalagyang ito.

english: We will test your urine for infection and blood.
transliteration: soo-soo-REE-in po na-MIN ang EE-hee ni-NYO kung may im-pek-SYON at DOO-go.
translation: Susuriin po namin ang ihi ninyo kung may impeksiyon at dugo.

english: We may send the urine for a culture.
transliteration: ma-a-REE-ng ee-PA-da-la na-MIN ang EE-hee pa-ra sa KUL-cher test.
translation: Maaaring ipadala namin ang ihi para sa culture test.

english: We would like to check your kidney function with blood tests.
transliteration: GOOS-to po na-MING soo-REE-in ang pag-ga-NAP nang mga ba-TO ni-NYO sa pa-ma-ma-GEE-tan nang pag-soo-SOO-ree nang da-HOON.
translation: Gusto po naming suriin ang paggana ng mga bato ninyo sa pamamagitan ng pagsusuri ng dugo.

english: We may arrange an ultrasound of your kidneys and bladder.
transliteration: ma-a-REE-ng mag-pa-is-ke-DYOOL ka-MEE nang UL-tra-sound nang mga ba-TO at pan-TOG ni-NYO.
translation: Maaaring magpa-iskedyul kami ng ultrasound ng mga bato at pantog ninyo.

english: We may need a CT scan to look for kidney stones.
transliteration: ma-a-REE-ng ka-ee-LANG-an na-MIN nang see-TEE scan pa-ra tee-NEE-gnan kung may ba-TO sa ba-TO.
translation: Maaaring kailanganin namin ng CT scan para tingnan kung may bato sa bato.

english: We may check how much urine remains in your bladder after you urinate.
transliteration: ma-a-REE-ng soo-MEE-kat ka-MEE kung ga-a-NO ka-RA-ming EE-hee ang na-TEE-tira sa pan-TOG ni-NYO pag-ka-TA-pos oo-MEE-hee.
translation: Maaaring sukatin namin kung gaano karaming ihi ang natitira sa pantog ninyo pagkatapos umihi.

english: We may need a camera examination of the bladder called cystoscopy.
transliteration: ma-a-REE-ng ka-ee-LANG-an na-MIN nang pag-soo-SOO-ree sa pan-TOG ga-MIT ang ka-ME-ra na tee-na-TA-wag na sis-TOS-ko-pee.
translation: Maaaring kailanganin namin ng pagsusuri sa pantog gamit ang kamera na tinatawag na cystoscopy.

english: We may need to give you antibiotics.
transliteration: ma-a-REE-ng ka-ee-LANG-an na-MIN nang bi-GYAN ka-yo nang an-tee-by-o-TIK.
translation: Maaaring kailangan naming bigyan kayo ng antibiotic.

english: Please take this medicine exactly as prescribed.
transliteration: ee-NOOM-in po ang ga-MOT na EE-to a-YON MEE-smo sa re-SE-ta.
translation: Inumin po ang gamot na ito ayon mismo sa reseta.

english: You may need a catheter to drain your bladder.
transliteration: ma-a-REE-ng ka-ee-LANG-an ni-NYO nang ka-THI-ter pa-ra ma-a-LEEs ang EE-hee sa pan-TOG.
translation: Maaaring kailanganin ninyo ng catheter para maalis ang ihi sa pantog.

english: We will explain the catheter procedure and ask for your consent.
transliteration: ee-pa-pa-lee-WA-nag po na-MIN ang pag-LA-lagay nang ka-THI-ter at hi-hee-NGEE ka-MEE nang pa-hin-TU-lot ni-NYO.
translation: Ipapaliwanag po namin ang paglalagay ng catheter at hihingi kami ng pahintulot ninyo.

english: Please keep the catheter bag below the level of your bladder.
transliteration: pa-na-TEE-lee-hin po ang bag nang ka-THI-ter na mas ma-ba-BA sa pan-TOG ni-NYO.
translation: Panatilihin po ang bag ng catheter na mas mababa sa pantog ninyo.

english: You may need to strain your urine to collect a stone.
transliteration: ma-a-REE-ng ka-ee-LANG-an ni-NYONG sa-LEEN ang EE-hee pa-ra ma-ko-LEK-ta ang ba-TO.
translation: Maaaring kailangan ninyong salain ang ihi para makolekta ang bato.

english: We may refer you to a urologist.
transliteration: ma-a-REE-ng ee-PA-da-la na-MIN ka-yo sa es-pe-SYA-lis-ta sa da-a-NAN nang EE-hee.
translation: Maaaring ipadala namin kayo sa espesyalista sa daanan ng ihi.

english: We may refer you to a kidney specialist.
transliteration: ma-a-REE-ng ee-PA-da-la na-MIN ka-yo sa es-pe-SYA-lis-ta sa ba-TO.
translation: Maaaring ipadala namin kayo sa espesyalista sa bato.

english: If you cannot urinate or develop severe pain or fever, seek urgent care.
transliteration: kung HIN-dee ka-yo ma-ka-EE-hee o mag-ka-ROON nang ma-TEEN-ding sa-KEET o LAG-nat, mag-pa-ting-in a-GAD sa ser-BIS-yong me-dee-KAL pa-ra sa a-ga-RANG pa-nga-nga-LA-ga.
translation: Kung hindi kayo makaihi o magkaroon ng matinding sakit o lagnat, magpatingin agad sa serbisyong medikal para sa agarang pangangalaga.

english: Do you have any questions?
transliteration: may mga ta-NONG po ba ka-yo?
translation: May mga tanong po ba kayo?

english: Can you tell me which symptoms would need urgent medical attention?
transliteration: ma-sa-SA-bi po ba ni-NYO kung a-LEENG mga simp-TO-mas ang na-nga-nga-ee-LANG-an nang a-ga-RANG a-ten-SYONG me-dee-KAL?
translation: Masasabi po ba ninyo kung aling mga sintomas ang nangangailangan ng agarang atensiyong medikal?

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: a-a-YOO-sin po na-MIN ang su-SU-nod ni-NYONG a-point-MENT.
translation: Aayusin po namin ang susunod ninyong appointment.

english: Please return if your symptoms worsen.
transliteration: boo-MA-lik po ka-yo kung loo-MA-la ang mga simp-TO-mas ni-NYO.
translation: Bumalik po kayo kung lumala ang mga sintomas ninyo.

english: Thank you for speaking with me today.
transliteration: sa-LA-mat po sa pa-ki-ki-pag-oo-sap sa a-KIN nga-YON.
translation: Salamat po sa pakikipag-usap sa akin ngayon.

english: What brings you in today?
transliteration: a-NO po ang da-HEE-lan nang pag-POON-ta ni-NYO ree-TO nga-YON?
translation: Ano po ang dahilan ng pagpunta ninyo rito ngayon?

english: When did your symptoms start?
transliteration: ka-EE-lan po nag-see-MOO-la ang mga simp-TO-mas ni-NYO?
translation: Kailan po nagsimula ang mga sintomas ninyo?

english: Have your symptoms been getting worse?
transliteration: loo-MA-la po ba ang mga simp-TO-mas ni-NYO?
translation: Lumalala po ba ang mga sintomas ninyo?

english: Do you have any other symptoms?
transliteration: may EE-ba pa po ba ka-YONG simp-TO-mas?
translation: May iba pa po ba kayong sintomas?

english: May I ask about your medical history?
transliteration: ma-a-REE ko po bang ee-ta-NONG ang tung-KOL sa ee-NYONG ka-sa-YSAY-ang me-dee-KAL?
translation: Maaari ko po bang itanong ang tungkol sa inyong kasaysayang medikal?

english: May I examine you?
transliteration: ma-a-REE ko po ba ka-YONG soo-REE-in?
translation: Maaari ko po ba kayong suriin?

english: Would you like an interpreter?
transliteration: GOOS-to po ba ni-NYO nang ta-ga-sa-LEEN?
translation: Gusto po ba ninyo ng tagasalin?

english: Have you been diagnosed with diabetes?
transliteration: na-sa-BEE-han na po ba ka-YO nang dok-TOR na may dy-a-BEE-tes ka-yo?
translation: Nasabihan na po ba kayo ng doktor na may diyabetes kayo?

english: Do you have type 1 or type 2 diabetes?
transliteration: type wan po ba o type too ang dy-a-BEE-tes ni-NYO?
translation: Type 1 po ba o type 2 ang diyabetes ninyo?

english: How long have you had diabetes?
transliteration: ga-a-NO na po ka-yo ka-TA-gal may dy-a-BEE-tes?
translation: Gaano na po kayo katagal may diyabetes?

english: Are you more thirsty than usual?
transliteration: mas na-oo-OO-was po ba ka-yo ka-ysa ka-ra-NEE-wan?
translation: Mas nauuhaw po ba kayo kaysa karaniwan?

english: Are you urinating more often?
transliteration: mas ma-da-LAS po ba ka-YONG oo-mee-EE-hee?
translation: Mas madalas po ba kayong umiihi?

english: Do you wake up at night to urinate?
transliteration: na-gee-GEE-sing po ba ka-yo sa ga-BEE pa-ra oo-MEE-hee?
translation: Nagigising po ba kayo sa gabi para umihi?

english: Have you lost weight without trying?
transliteration: poo-MA-yat po ba ka-yo nang HIN-dee see-NA-sad-ya?
translation: Pumayat po ba kayo nang hindi sinasadya?

english: Do you feel more hungry than usual?
transliteration: mas na-goo-GOO-tom po ba ka-yo ka-ysa ka-ra-NEE-wan?
translation: Mas nagugutom po ba kayo kaysa karaniwan?

english: Have you noticed blurred vision?
transliteration: na-PAN-sin po ba ni-NYONG ma-LA-bo ang pa-NEEN-gee-nin ni-NYO?
translation: Napansin po ba ninyong malabo ang paningin ninyo?

english: Do you feel unusually tired?
transliteration: na-ka-ka-RA-mdam po ba ka-yo nang ka-ee-BA-ng pag-ka-pa-GOD?
translation: Nakakaramdam po ba kayo ng kakaibang pagkapagod?

english: Have you had frequent infections?
transliteration: ma-da-LAS po ba ka-YONG mag-ka-im-pek-SYON?
translation: Madalas po ba kayong magka-impeksiyon?

english: Do your wounds take a long time to heal?
transliteration: ma-TA-gal po bang goo-MA-lee ang mga soo-GAT ni-NYO?
translation: Matagal po bang gumaling ang mga sugat ninyo?

english: Do you check your blood sugar at home?
transliteration: see-noo-SOO-kat po ba ni-NYO ang a-SOO-kal sa da-HOON ni-NYO sa ba-HAY?
translation: Sinusukat po ba ninyo ang asukal sa dugo ninyo sa bahay?

english: How often do you check your blood sugar?
transliteration: ga-a-NO po ka-da-LAS ni-NYO see-noo-SOO-kat ang a-SOO-kal sa da-HOON ni-NYO?
translation: Gaano po kadalas ninyo sinusukat ang asukal sa dugo ninyo?

english: What was your last blood sugar reading?
transliteration: a-NO po ang hoo-LING soo-KAT nang a-SOO-kal sa da-HOON ni-NYO?
translation: Ano po ang huling sukat ng asukal sa dugo ninyo?

english: Do you use a continuous glucose monitor?
transliteration: goo-MA-ga-MIT po ba ka-yo nang too-LOY-too-LOY na GLOO-kows MON-i-tor?
translation: Gumagamit po ba kayo ng tuloy-tuloy na glucose monitor?

english: Have you brought your glucose readings?
transliteration: na-DA-la po ba ni-NYO ang mga soo-KAT nang GLOO-kows ni-NYO?
translation: Nadala po ba ninyo ang mga sukat ng glucose ninyo?

english: Have you had an HbA1c blood test?
transliteration: nag-pa H-B-A-one-see blood test na po ba ka-yo?
translation: Nagpa-HbA1c blood test na po ba kayo?

english: We will check your blood sugar now.
transliteration: soo-soo-MEE-kat po na-MIN ang a-SOO-kal sa da-HOON ni-NYO nga-YON.
translation: Susukatin po namin ang asukal sa dugo ninyo ngayon.

english: Your blood sugar is higher than the target.
transliteration: mas ma-TA-as po sa TAR-get ang a-SOO-kal sa da-HOON ni-NYO.
translation: Mas mataas po sa target ang asukal sa dugo ninyo.

english: Have you ever had low blood sugar?
transliteration: nag-ka-ROON na po ba ka-yo nang ma-BA-bang a-SOO-kal sa da-HOON?
translation: Nagkaroon na po ba kayo ng mababang asukal sa dugo?

english: Do you get shaky or sweaty when your sugar is low?
transliteration: na-nee-nee-NIG o pee-na-pag-pa-WEES-an po ba ka-yo ka-pag ma-BA-ba ang a-SOO-kal sa da-HOON ni-NYO?
translation: Nanginginig o pinagpapawisan po ba kayo kapag mababa ang asukal sa dugo ninyo?

english: Do you feel dizzy or confused when your sugar is low?
transliteration: na-hee-HEE-lo o na-lee-LOO-to po ba ka-yo ka-pag ma-BA-ba ang a-SOO-kal sa da-HOON ni-NYO?
translation: Nahihilo o nalilito po ba kayo kapag mababa ang asukal sa dugo ninyo?

english: Have you ever fainted because of low blood sugar?
transliteration: na-WA-lan na po ba ka-yo nang ma-LAY da-HEEL sa ma-BA-bang a-SOO-kal sa da-HOON?
translation: Nawalan na po ba kayo ng malay dahil sa mababang asukal sa dugo?

english: What do you do when your blood sugar is low?
transliteration: ah-NOH poh ahng ngah-GAH-gah-wah nee-NYOH kah-pahg mah-BAH-bah ahng ah-SOO-kahl sah DOO-goh nee-NYOH?
translation: Ano po ang ginagawa ninyo kapag mababa ang asukal sa dugo ninyo?

english: Do you carry something sugary with you?
transliteration: mah-ee dah-LAH poh bah kah-YOHNG pahg-kah-EEHNG mah-TAH-mees?
translation: May dala po ba kayong pagkaing matamis?

english: Have you had very high blood sugar recently?
transliteration: mah-SYAH-doh poh bahng too-MAH-ahs ahng ah-SOO-kahl sah DOO-goh nee-NYOH kah-MAH-kah-LAHHN?
translation: Masyado po bang tumaas ang asukal sa dugo ninyo kamakailan?

english: Have you had nausea, vomiting, or stomach pain?
transliteration: nah-kah-rahm-DAHM poh bah kah-YOH nahng pahg-kah-HEE-loh, pahg-soo-SOO-kah, oh pah-nah-NAH-keeht nahng tah-YAHN?
translation: Nakaramdam po ba kayo ng pagkahilo, pagsusuka, o pananakit ng tiyan?

english: Are you breathing faster or deeper than usual?
transliteration: mahs mah-BEE-lis oh mahs mah-lah-LAH-lim poh bah ahng pahg-HEE-nga nee-NYOH kah-YSAH kah-rah-nee-WAHN?
translation: Mas mabilis o mas malalim po ba ang paghinga ninyo kaysa karaniwan?

english: Have you ever been hospitalized for diabetic ketoacidosis?
transliteration: nah-ohs-pee-TAHL nah poh bah kah-YOH dah-HEEL sah dah-ee-ah-BEH-teek keh-toh-ah-see-DOH-sees?
translation: Naospital na po ba kayo dahil sa diabetic ketoacidosis?

english: What medicines do you take for diabetes?
transliteration: ah-NOHNG mah-NGAH gah-MOHT poh ahng ee-nee-EE-nom nee-NYOH pah-RAH sah dah-ee-ah-BEH-tees?
translation: Anong mga gamot po ang iniinom ninyo para sa diabetes?

english: Do you take diabetes tablets?
transliteration: oo-mee-EE-nom poh bah kah-YOH nahng mah-NGAH tahb-LEH-tah pah-RAH sah dah-ee-ah-BEH-tees?
translation: Umiinom po ba kayo ng mga tableta para sa diabetes?

english: Do you use insulin?
transliteration: goo-mah-GAH-mit poh bah kah-YOH nahng EEN-soo-lin?
translation: Gumagamit po ba kayo ng insulin?

english: How many units of insulin do you take?
transliteration: ee-LAHNG YOO-neet poh nahng EEN-soo-lin ahng ee-nee-EE-nom nee-NYOH?
translation: Ilang yunit po ng insulin ang iniinom ninyo?

english: When do you take your insulin?
transliteration: KAH-ee-LAHN poh kah-YOH nahg-een-SOO-lin?
translation: Kailan po kayo nag-iinsulin?

english: Did you take your insulin today?
transliteration: nahg-een-SOO-lin poh bah kah-YOH ngah-YOHNG AH-raw?
translation: Nag-insulin po ba kayo ngayong araw?

english: Have you missed any doses recently?
transliteration: mah-ee mah-NGAH DOH-sees poh bah kah-YOHNG hee-NEE-nee-NOM kah-MAH-kah-LAHHN?
translation: May mga dosis po ba kayong hindi nainom kamakailan?

english: Do you use an insulin pen or pump?
transliteration: goo-mah-GAH-mit poh bah kah-YOH nahng EEN-soo-lin pehn oh pahmp?
translation: Gumagamit po ba kayo ng insulin pen o pump?

english: Where do you inject your insulin?
transliteration: sah-AHN poh kah-YOH ngah-too-TOO-rohk nahng EEN-soo-lin?
translation: Saan po kayo nagtuturok ng insulin?

english: Do you rotate your injection sites?
transliteration: sah-leet-sah-LEE-tahn poh bah nee-NYOH ahng mah-NGAH bah-HAH-ging tee-noo-TOO-roo-kahn?
translation: Salit-salitan po ba ninyo ang mga bahaging tinuturukan?

english: Have you had side effects from your medicines?
transliteration: nahg-kah-ROH-ohn poh bah kah-YOH nahng mah-NGAH side effect moolah sah mah-NGAH gah-MOHT nee-NYOH?
translation: Nagkaroon po ba kayo ng mga side effect mula sa mga gamot ninyo?

english: Would you like me to show you how to inject insulin?
transliteration: goo-stoh poh bah nee-NYOHNG ee-pah-KEE-tah koh kung pah-ah-NOH mahg-too-TOO-rohk nahng EEN-soo-lin?
translation: Gusto po ba ninyong ipakita ko kung paano magturok ng insulin?

english: Do you have numbness or tingling in your feet?
transliteration: mah-NEED poh bah oh pah-RAHNG kee-nee-kee-LEE-tee ahng mah-NGAH pah-AH nee-NYOH?
translation: Manhid po ba o parang kinikiliti ang mga paa ninyo?

english: Do you have burning pain in your feet?
transliteration: mah-ee mah-HAHP-ding sah-KEET poh bah sah mah-NGAH pah-AH nee-NYOH?
translation: May mahapding sakit po ba sa mga paa ninyo?

english: Have you noticed any sores on your feet?
transliteration: mah-ee nah-pahn-SIN poh bah kah-YOHNG mah-NGAH soo-GAHT sah mah-NGAH pah-AH nee-NYOH?
translation: May napansin po ba kayong mga sugat sa mga paa ninyo?

english: Do you check your feet every day?
transliteration: see-noo-SOO-ree poh bah nee-NYOH ahng mah-NGAH pah-AH nee-NYOH ah-RAW-ah-RAW?
translation: Sinusuri po ba ninyo ang mga paa ninyo araw-araw?

english: Have you had a diabetic eye examination?
transliteration: nahg-pah-ek-SAH-min nah poh bah kah-YOH nahng mah-tah dah-HEEL sah dah-ee-ah-BEH-tees?
translation: Nagpaeksamin na po ba kayo ng mata dahil sa diabetes?

english: Has diabetes affected your kidneys?
transliteration: nah-ah-pek-TOO-hahn poh bah nahng dah-ee-ah-BEH-tees ahng mah-NGAH bah-TOH nee-NYOH?
translation: Naapektuhan po ba ng diabetes ang mga bato ninyo?

english: Have you had a heart attack or stroke?
transliteration: ee-NAH-tah-keh nah poh bah kah-YOH sah POO-soh oh nah-STROHK?
translation: Inatake na po ba kayo sa puso o na-stroke?

english: I am going to check the feeling in your feet.
transliteration: soo-soo-ree-in koh poh kung nah-kah-kah-RAHM-dahm kah-YOH sah mah-NGAH pah-AH nee-NYOH.
translation: Susuriin ko po kung nakakaramdam kayo sa mga paa ninyo.

english: Can you feel this on your toes?
transliteration: nah-rah-RAHM-dahm poh bah nee-NYOH EE-toh sah mah-NGAH dah-LEE-ree nahng pah-AH nee-NYOH?
translation: Nararamdaman po ba ninyo ito sa mga daliri ng paa ninyo?

english: Have you ever had a thyroid problem?
transliteration: nahg-kah-ROH-ohn nah poh bah kah-YOH nahng proh-BLEH-mah sah THY-roid?
translation: Nagkaroon na po ba kayo ng problema sa thyroid?

english: Do you have an underactive thyroid?
transliteration: mah-EE-nah poh bah ahng pahg-GAH-nah nahng THY-roid nee-NYOH?
translation: Mahina po ba ang paggana ng thyroid ninyo?

english: Do you have an overactive thyroid?
transliteration: SOH-brah poh bah ahng pahg-GAH-nah nahng THY-roid nee-NYOH?
translation: Sobra po ba ang paggana ng thyroid ninyo?

english: Do you feel unusually cold?
transliteration: nee-lah-LAH-mig poh bah kah-YOH nahng heen-dee kah-rah-nee-WAHN?
translation: Nilalamig po ba kayo nang hindi karaniwan?

english: Do you feel unusually hot or sweaty?
transliteration: nah-kah-kah-RAHM-dahm poh bah kah-YOH nahng SOH-brahng EE-neet oh pahg-pah-PAH-wees?
translation: Nakakaramdam po ba kayo ng sobrang init o pagpapawis?

english: Have you noticed your heart racing?
transliteration: nah-pahn-SIN poh bah nee-NYOHNG boo-mee-BEE-lis ahng TEE-bohk nahng POO-soh nee-NYOH?
translation: Napansin po ba ninyong bumibilis ang tibok ng puso ninyo?

english: Have you noticed shaking in your hands?
transliteration: nah-pahn-SIN poh bah nee-NYOHNG nah-nee-NI-ngig ahng mah-NGAH kah-MAHY nee-NYOH?
translation: Napansin po ba ninyong nanginginig ang mga kamay ninyo?

english: Have you been constipated?
transliteration: nah-HEE-rahp poh bah kah-YOHNG doo-MOO-mee?
translation: Nahirapan po ba kayong dumumi?

english: Have you been having frequent bowel movements?
transliteration: mah-DAH-lahs poh bah kah-YOHNG doo-MOO-mee?
translation: Madalas po ba kayong dumumi?

english: Have you noticed swelling in your neck?
transliteration: mah-ee nah-pahn-SIN poh bah kah-YOHNG pah-MAH-mah-GAH sah LEH-ehg?
translation: May napansin po ba kayong pamamaga sa leeg?

english: Is it difficult to swallow?
transliteration: nah-HEE-rahp poh bah kah-YOHNG loo-MOONG-gohk?
translation: Nahihirapan po ba kayong lumunok?

english: Has your voice become hoarse?
transliteration: nah-ging pah-OHS poh ahng BOH-sehs nee-NYOH?
translation: Naging paos po ba ang boses ninyo?

english: Do you take thyroid medication?
transliteration: oo-mee-EE-nom poh bah kah-YOH nahng gah-MOHT pah-RAH sah THY-roid?
translation: Umiinom po ba kayo ng gamot para sa thyroid?

english: Have you had thyroid surgery or radioactive iodine treatment?
transliteration: nah-oh-peh-RAH-hahn nah poh bah kah-YOH sah THY-roid oh nahg-pah-gah-MOHT gah-MEET ahng reh-dee-oh-AHK-tiv AY-oh-dine?
translation: Naoperahan na po ba kayo sa thyroid o nagpagamot gamit ang radioactive iodine?

english: Has your weight changed recently?
transliteration: nahg-BAH-goh poh bah ahng tim-BAHNG nee-NYOH kah-MAH-kah-LAHHN?
translation: Nagbago po ba ang timbang ninyo kamakailan?

english: How much weight have you gained or lost?
transliteration: gah-AH-noh poh kah-rah-MEENG tim-BAHNG ahng nah-DAH-gdag oh nah-BAH-wahs sah ee-NYOH?
translation: Gaano po karaming timbang ang nadagdag o nabawas sa inyo?

english: Has your appetite changed?
transliteration: nahg-BAH-goh poh bah ahng GAH-nah nee-NYOH sah pahg-KAH-een?
translation: Nagbago po ba ang gana ninyo sa pagkain?

english: What do you usually eat in a day?
transliteration: ah-NOH poh ahng kah-rah-nee-WAHN nee-NYOHNG kah-EE-nin sah ee-SA HNG AH-raw?
translation: Ano po ang karaniwan ninyong kinakain sa isang araw?

english: How often do you exercise?
transliteration: gah-AH-noh poh kah-YOH kah-DAH-lahs mahg-eh-HER-sis?
translation: Gaano po kayo kadalas mag-ehersisyo?

english: Do you drink sugary drinks?
transliteration: oo-mee-EE-nom poh bah kah-YOH nahng mah-tah-TAH-mees nahng EE-noom-in?
translation: Umiinom po ba kayo ng matatamis na inumin?

english: Have you tried making changes to your diet?
transliteration: see-noo-BAH-yahn nah poh bah nee-NYOHNG bah-goo-HEEN ahng kee-nee-KAH-een nee-NYOH?
translation: Sinubukan na po ba ninyong baguhin ang kinakain ninyo?

english: Would you like help with weight management?
transliteration: goo-stoh poh bah nee-NYOH nahng TOO-long sah pahg-koh-KON-trohl nahng tim-BAHNG?
translation: Gusto po ba ninyo ng tulong sa pagkontrol ng timbang?

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Have you ever broken a bone after a minor fall?
transliteration: nah-bah-LAH-ee nah poh bah kah-YOH nahng BOO-toh mah-TOH-pohs mah-dah-PAH nahng bah-HAG-yah?
translation: Nabalian na po ba kayo ng buto matapos madapa nang bahagya?

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Have you been told you have osteoporosis?
transliteration: nah-sah-BEE-hahn nah poh bah kah-YOH nahng mah-ee ohs-tee-oh-poh-ROH-sees kah-YOH?
translation: Nasabihan na po ba kayo na may osteoporosis kayo?

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Have you had a bone density scan?
transliteration: nahg-pah-SKAN nah poh bah kah-YOH pah-RAH mah-soo-KAHT ahng TEE-bay nahng mah-NGAH BOO-toh nee-NYOH?
translation: Nagpa-scan na po ba kayo para masukat ang tibay ng mga buto ninyo?

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Do you take calcium or vitamin D?
transliteration: oo-mee-EE-nom poh bah kah-YOH nahng KAL-see-yum oh VY-tah-min dee?
translation: Umiinom po ba kayo ng calcium o vitamin D?

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Have you had kidney stones?
transliteration: nahg-kah-ROH-ohn nah poh bah kah-YOH nahng BAH-toh sah BAH-toh?
translation: Nagkaroon na po ba kayo ng bato sa bato?

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Do you have muscle cramps or spasms?
transliteration: nahg-kah-kah-ROH-ohn poh bah kah-YOH nahng poo-LEE-kaht oh pah-moo-MOO-lee-kaht nahng mah-NGAH kah-lah-MAHN?
translation: Nagkakaroon po ba kayo ng pulikat o pamumulikat ng mga kalamnan?

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Do you have tingling around your mouth or fingers?
transliteration: nah-kah-kah-RAHM-dahm poh bah kah-YOH nahng pah-nee-nee-LEE-gil sah pah-ree-LEE-geh nahng bee-BEEG oh mah-NGAH dah-LEE-ree?
translation: Nakakaramdam po ba kayo ng pangingilig sa paligid ng bibig o mga daliri?

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Have you been diagnosed with a parathyroid problem?
transliteration: nah-soo-REE nah poh bah kah-YOH at nah-sah-BEE-hahng mah-ee proh-BLEH-mah sah pah-rah-THY-roid?
translation: Nasuri na po ba kayo at nasabihang may problema sa parathyroid?

english: Have you ever had a problem with your adrenal glands?
transliteration: nahg-kah-ROH-ohn nah poh bah kah-YOH nahng proh-BLEH-mah sah mah-NGAH ah-DREE-nahl gland?
translation: Nagkaroon na po ba kayo ng problema sa mga adrenal gland?

english: Do you take steroid medicines such as prednisone?
transliteration: oo-mee-EE-nom poh bah kah-YOH nahng mah-NGAH STEH-roid gah-MOHT too-LAHD nahng pred-nee-SOHN?
translation: Umiinom po ba kayo ng mga steroid na gamot tulad ng prednisone?

english: How long have you been taking steroids?
transliteration: gah-AH-noh nah poh kah-YOH kah-TAH-lahng oo-mee-EE-nom nahng mah-NGAH STEH-roid?
translation: Gaano na po kayo katagal umiinom ng mga steroid?

english: Have you recently stopped taking steroids?
transliteration: ee-tee-neeg poh bah nee-NYOH kah-MAH-kah-LAHHN ahng pahg-EE-nom nahng mah-NGAH STEH-roid?
translation: Itinigil po ba ninyo kamakailan ang pag-inom ng mga steroid?

english: Do you feel dizzy when you stand up?
transliteration: nah-HEE-lee poh bah kah-YOH kah-pahg too-mah-TAY-oh?
translation: Nahihilo po ba kayo kapag tumatayo?

english: Have you noticed darker patches of skin?
transliteration: mah-ee nah-pahn-SIN poh bah kah-YOHNG mah-ee-TEE-mim bah-HAH-gee sah BAH-lahht nee-NYOH?
translation: May napansin po ba kayong maiitim na bahagi sa balat ninyo?

english: Do you crave salty foods?
transliteration: mah-DAH-lahs poh bah kah-YOHNG mahg-HAH-nahp nahng mah-ah-LAHT nahng kah-EE-nin?
translation: Madalas po ba kayong maghanap ng maalat na pagkain?

english: Have you noticed easy bruising or purple stretch marks?
transliteration: nah-pahn-SIN poh bah nee-NYOHNG mah-DAH-lee mahg-kah-pah-SAH oh mah-ee LEE-lahng goo-HEET sah BAH-lahht?
translation: Napansin po ba ninyong madaling magkapasa o may lilang guhit sa balat?

english: Do you have an emergency steroid plan?
transliteration: mah-PLAH-noh poh bah kah-YOH pah-RAH sah STEH-roid kah-pahg eh-MER-jen-see?
translation: May plano po ba kayo para sa steroid kapag emergency?

english: Have you had persistent headaches or changes in vision?
transliteration: nahg-kah-ROH-ohn poh bah kah-YOH nahng too-loy-too-LOY nahng sah-KEET nahng OO-loh oh bah-BAH-goh sah pah-NEEN?
translation: Nagkaroon po ba kayo ng tuloy-tuloy na sakit ng ulo o pagbabago sa paningin?

english: Have your periods become irregular or stopped?
transliteration: nah-ging hee-NEE reg-yoo-LAHR oh too-MEE-gil poh bah ahng REH-glah nee-NYOH?
translation: Naging hindi regular o tumigil po ba ang regla ninyo?

english: Have you noticed unexpected milk discharge from your breasts?
transliteration: mah-ee nah-pahn-SIN poh bah kah-YOHNG heen-dee ee-nyah-AH-sah-hahng pahg-LOO-ahs nahng GAH-tahs moo-LAH sah mah-NGAH SOO-soh nee-NYOH?
translation: May napansin po ba kayong hindi inaasahang paglabas ng gatas mula sa mga suso ninyo?

english: Have you noticed changes in sexual desire?
transliteration: mah-ee nah-pahn-SIN poh bah kah-YOHNG bah-BAH-goh sah pahg-nah-NYAH ees-tee-bah?
translation: May napansin po ba kayong pagbabago sa pagnanais makipagtalik?

english: Have you had problems with erections?
transliteration: nahg-kah-ROH-ohn poh bah kah-YOH nahng proh-BLEH-mah sah pahg-TOO-yoh nahng ah-REE?
translation: Nagkaroon po ba kayo ng problema sa pagtayo ng ari?

english: Have you noticed increased facial or body hair?
transliteration: mah-ee nah-pahn-SIN poh bah kah-YOHNG pahg-dah-MEE nahng BOO-hohk sah moo-KHAH oh kah-TOO-wahn?
translation: May napansin po ba kayong pagdami ng buhok sa mukha o katawan?

english: Have you noticed unusual acne or hair loss?
transliteration: mah-ee nah-pahn-SIN poh bah kah-YOHNG kah-ee-BAHng tee-GYAH-waht oh pahg-kah-LAH-gahs nahng BOO-hohk?
translation: May napansin po ba kayong kakaibang tigyawat o pagkalagas ng buhok?

english: Have you had difficulty becoming pregnant?
transliteration: nah-HEE-rahp poh bah kah-YOHNG mah-boon-TEES?
translation: Nahirapan po ba kayong mabuntis?

english: Are you taking any hormone treatment?
transliteration: oo-mee-EE-nom poh bah kah-YOH nahng ah-NUH-mahng HOR-mohn TREET-mint?
translation: Umiinom po ba kayo ng anumang hormone treatment?

english: Does anyone in your family have diabetes?
transliteration: mah-ee dah-ee-ah-BEH-tees poh bah ahng SEE-noo-mahn sah pah-MEE-lee nee-NYOH?
translation: May diabetes po ba ang sinuman sa pamilya ninyo?

english: Does anyone in your family have thyroid disease?
transliteration: mah-ee sah-KEET poh bah sah THY-roid ahng SEE-noo-mahn sah pah-MEE-lee nee-NYOH?
translation: May sakit po ba sa thyroid ang sinuman sa pamilya ninyo?

english: Do you have high blood pressure or high cholesterol?
transliteration: mah-ee ahl-tah-PRES-yon oh mah-TAH-ahs nahng koh-les-TEH-rohl poh bah kah-YOH?
translation: May altapresyon o mataas na kolesterol po ba kayo?

english: Do you have any kidney or heart problems?
transliteration: mah-ee proh-BLEH-mah poh bah kah-YOH sah BAH-toh oh POO-soh?
translation: May problema po ba kayo sa bato o puso?

english: Have you had any surgery?
transliteration: nah-oh-peh-RAH-hahn nah poh bah kah-YOH?
translation: Naoperahan na po ba kayo?

english: Are you pregnant or planning a pregnancy?
transliteration: boon-TEES poh bah kah-YOH oh pahg-pah-PLAH-nohNG mahg-boon-TEES?
translation: Buntis po ba kayo o nagpaplanong magbuntis?

english: Do you smoke or drink alcohol?
transliteration: nah-nee-nee-gah-REE-lyoh poh bah kah-YOH oh oo-mee-EE-nom nahng ah-LAHK?
translation: Naninigarilyo po ba kayo o umiinom ng alak?

english: Do you have any medication allergies?
transliteration: mah-ee AHL-er-jee poh bah kah-YOH sah ah-NUH-mahng gah-MOHT?
translation: May allergy po ba kayo sa anumang gamot?

english: I am going to measure your height and weight.
transliteration: soo-soo-KAH-tin koh poh ahng TAH-ahs at tim-BAHNG nee-NYOH.
translation: Susukatin ko po ang taas at timbang ninyo.

english: I am going to check your blood pressure.
transliteration: soo-soo-REE-in koh poh ahng preh-SYOHN nahng DOO-goh nee-NYOH.
translation: Susuriin ko po ang presyon ng dugo ninyo.

english: Please hold your hands out in front of you.
transliteration: ee-oo-NAHT poh nee-NYOH ahng mah-NGAH kah-MAHY nee-NYOH sah hah-RAHP.
translation: Iunat po ninyo ang mga kamay ninyo sa harap.

english: I am checking whether your hands are shaking.
transliteration: tee-nee-tee-NGAHN koh poh kung nah-nee-NI-ngig ahng mah-NGAH kah-MAHY nee-NYOH.
translation: Tinitingnan ko po kung nanginginig ang mga kamay ninyo.

english: Please tilt your head back slightly.
transliteration: pah-kee-tah-GEE-lid poh nahng bah-HAHG-yah pah-ah-TAHHS ahng OO-loh nee-NYOH.
translation: Pakitagilid po nang bahagya paatras ang ulo ninyo.

english: Please swallow while I examine your neck.
transliteration: loo-MOONG-gohk poh kah-YOH habang soo-soo-REE-in koh ahng LEH-ehg nee-NYOH.
translation: Lumunok po kayo habang sinusuri ko ang leeg ninyo.

english: I am going to feel your thyroid gland.
transliteration: kah-PAH-in koh poh ahng THY-roid gland nee-NYOH.
translation: Kapain ko po ang thyroid gland ninyo.

english: Please follow my finger with your eyes.
transliteration: soon-DAHN poh nee-NYOH nahng mah-NGAH MAH-tah ahng dah-LEE-ree koh.
translation: Sundan po ninyo ng mga mata ang daliri ko.

english: I am going to examine your feet for sores.
transliteration: soo-soo-REE-in koh poh ahng mah-NGAH pah-AH nee-NYOH kung mah-ee mah-NGAH soo-GAHT.
translation: Susuriin ko po ang mga paa ninyo kung may mga sugat.

english: Please tell me when you feel this touch.
transliteration: sah-BEE-hin poh nee-NYOH sah ah-KIN kah-pahg nah-rah-RAHM-dahm nee-NYOH ahng DAHM-pee nahng EE-toh.
translation: Sabihin po ninyo sa akin kapag naramdaman ninyo ang dampi na ito.

english: I am going to check your reflexes.
transliteration: soo-soo-REE-in koh poh ahng mah-NGAH REE-fleks nee-NYOH.
translation: Susuriin ko po ang mga reflex ninyo.

english: We need a blood test to check your thyroid hormones.
transliteration: kah-ee-LAH-ngahn poh nah-TEEN nahng pahg-soo-SOO-ree nahng DOO-goh pah-RAH tee-NGAHN ahng mah-NGAH HOR-mohn nahng THY-roid nee-NYOH.
translation: Kailangan po natin ng pagsusuri ng dugo para tingnan ang mga hormone ng thyroid ninyo.

english: We will check your HbA1c to assess your average blood sugar.
transliteration: soo-soo-REE-in poh nah-TEEN ahng HbA1c nee-NYOH pah-RAH mah-LAH-mahn ahng kah-rah-nee-WAHNG ahn-TAHS nahng ah-SOO-kahl sah DOO-goh nee-NYOH.
translation: Susuriin po natin ang HbA1c ninyo para malaman ang karaniwang antas ng asukal sa dugo ninyo.

english: We need to check your kidney function.
transliteration: kah-ee-LAH-ngahn poh nah-TEEN soo-REE-in kung pah-AH-noh goo-MAH-gah-NAH ahng mah-NGAH BAH-toh nee-NYOH.
translation: Kailangan po nating suriin kung paano gumagana ang mga bato ninyo.

english: We will check your cholesterol.
transliteration: soo-soo-REE-in poh nah-TEEN ahng koh-les-TEH-rohl nee-NYOH.
translation: Susuriin po natin ang kolesterol ninyo.

english: We need a urine sample.
transliteration: kah-ee-LAH-ngahn poh nah-TEEN nahng SAM-pohl nahng OO-hee.
translation: Kailangan po natin ng sample ng ihi.

english: You may need an ultrasound of your thyroid.
transliteration: mah-ah-AH-ree poh kah-ee-LAH-ngahn nee-NYOH nahng OOL-trah-sound nahng THY-roid.
translation: Maaaring kailanganin po ninyo ng ultrasound ng thyroid.

english: We may need a bone density scan.
transliteration: mah-ah-AH-ree poh kah-ee-LAH-ngahn nah-TEEN nahng SKAN pah-RAH mah-soo-KAHT ahng KAH-pahl nahng ee-NYOHNG mah-NGAH BOO-toh.
translation: Maaaring kailangan po natin ng scan para masukat ang kapal ng inyong mga buto.

english: Please follow the fasting instructions for this test.
transliteration: soon-DAHN poh nee-NYOH ahng mah-NGAH tah-gee-BEE-lin tooh-kol sah pahg-ah-ah-YOO-noh pah-RAH sah pahg-soo-SOO-ree nahng ee-TOH.
translation: Sundin po ninyo ang mga tagubilin tungkol sa pag-aayuno para sa pagsusuring ito.

english: We will review your medications together.
transliteration: SAH-bay poh nah-TEEN ree-reh-PAH-soo-hin ahng mah-NGAH gah-MOHT nee-NYOH.
translation: Sabay po nating rerepasuhin ang mga gamot ninyo.

english: Please take this medicine as prescribed.
transliteration: ee-NEE-nom poh nee-NYOH ahng gah-MOHT nahng ee-TOH ah-YOHN sah reh-SEH-tah.
translation: Inumin po ninyo ang gamot na ito ayon sa reseta.
