english: Do not change your insulin dose without guidance.
transliteration: HOO-wahg poh nee-NYOHNG bah-goo-HEEN ahng DOH-sees nahng EEN-soo-lin nee-NYOH nahng WAH-lahng gah-BYAH.
translation: Huwag po ninyong baguhin ang dosis ng insulin ninyo nang walang gabay.

english: Do not stop long-term steroids suddenly without medical advice.
transliteration: HOO-wahg poh nee-NYOHNG big-LAHNG ee-HEEN-toh ahng mah-TAH-lahng nahg-gee-gee-NAH-mit nahng STEH-roid nahng WAH-lahng pah-YOHNG meh-dee-KAHL.
translation: Huwag po ninyong biglang ihinto ang matagal nang paggamit ng steroid nang walang payong medikal.

english: We can arrange a visit with a diabetes educator.
transliteration: mah-ah-AH-ree poh nah-TEEN mahg-ah-YOHS nahng pahg-vee-SEE-tah sah ee-SAHNG tah-gah-pahg-TOO-roh tuh-kol sah dah-ee-ah-BEH-tees.
translation: Maaari po tayong mag-ayos ng pagbisita sa isang tagapagturo tungkol sa diabetes.

english: Please bring your medicines and glucose readings next time.
transliteration: dah-LEEN poh nee-NYOH sah soo-SOO-nohd ahng mah-NGAH gah-MOHT at tah-LAH nahng ee-NYOHNG mah-NGAH soo-KAHT nahng GLOO-kohs.
translation: Dalhin po ninyo sa susunod ang mga gamot at tala ng inyong mga sukat ng glucose.

english: We will discuss a plan that works for you.
transliteration: pahg-oo-oo-SAH-pahn poh nah-TEEN ahng plah-NOHNG ahng-KOHP sah ee-NYOH.
translation: Pag-uusapan po natin ang planong angkop sa inyo.

english: Are you very drowsy or confused?
transliteration: ee-nah-AN-tohk nah ee-nah-AN-tohk poh bah kah-YOH oh nah-lee-LOO-toh?
translation: Inaantok na inaantok po ba kayo o nalilito?

english: Are you vomiting and unable to keep fluids down?
transliteration: nahg-soo-SOO-kah poh bah kah-YOH at heen-dee mah-kah-EE-nom nahng TOO-big oh ee-bahng lee-KEE-doh nahng heen-dee ee-nee-soo-SOO-kah?
translation: Nagsusuka po ba kayo at hindi makainom ng tubig o ibang likido nang hindi isinusuka?

english: Do you have severe weakness or fainting?
transliteration: mah-ee mah-TEEN-ding pahng-hee-NAH poh bah kah-YOH oh nah-hee-mee-TAH?
translation: May matinding panghihina po ba kayo o nahihimatay?

english: Seek urgent medical help if you become confused or faint.
transliteration: hoo-MEE-ngi poh ah-GAHD nahng meh-dee-KAHL nahng too-LOHNG kung mah-lee-LOO-toh kah-YOH oh mah-hee-mee-TAH.
translation: Humingi po agad ng medikal na tulong kung malito kayo o mahimatay.

english: When is your next follow-up appointment?
transliteration: KAH-ee-LAHN poh ahng soo-SOO-nohd nee-NYOHNG ah-POYNT-mint pah-RAH sah FAH-loh up?
translation: Kailan po ang susunod ninyong appointment para sa follow-up?

english: Do you have any questions about the plan?
transliteration: mah-ee mah-NGAH tah-NOHNG poh bah kah-YOH tuh-KOL sah plah-NOH?
translation: May mga tanong po ba kayo tungkol sa plano?

english: What would you like help with today?
transliteration: ah-NOH poh ahng goo-STOH nee-NYOHNG too-MO-long koh sah ee-NYOH NGAH-yon?
translation: Ano po ang gusto ninyong matulungan ko sa inyo ngayon?

english: How have you been feeling lately?
transliteration: koo-MOOS-tah poh ahng pahg-KAH-ram-DAHM nee-NYOH nee-TOHNG mah-NGAH kah-RAH-ahng ARAW?
translation: Kumusta po ang pakiramdam ninyo nitong mga nakaraang araw?

english: Is it okay if I ask some personal questions?
transliteration: AH-yohs lahng poh bah kung mahg-tah-NOHNG ah-koh nahng EE-lahng per-SOH-nahl nahng BA-ging?
translation: Ayos lang po ba kung magtanong ako ng ilang personal na bagay?

english: You can tell me if a question feels uncomfortable.
transliteration: mah-ah-AH-ree poh nee-NYOHNG sah-BEE-hin sah ah-KIN kung heen-DEE kah-YOH kom-FOR-tah-blee sah ee-SAHNG tah-NOHNG.
translation: Maaari po ninyong sabihin sa akin kung hindi kayo komportable sa isang tanong.

english: I will listen without judging you.
transliteration: mah-kee-KEE-nig poh ah-KOH nahng heen-DEE kah-YOH hee-nee-HEE-soo-GAHN.
translation: Makikinig po ako nang hindi kayo hinuhusgahan.

english: Would you prefer to speak with an interpreter?
transliteration: mahs goo-STOH poh bah nee-NYOHNG mahg-oo-SAH-pah nahng too-LOHNG nahng een-ter-PREH-ter?
translation: Mas gusto po ba ninyong makipag-usap sa tulong ng interpreter?

english: I will explain the limits of confidentiality.
transliteration: ee-pah-pee-lee-WAH-nahg koh poh ahng mah-NGAH hang-GAH-nahn nahng pahg-kee-kee-LOO-meen-see-YAHL.
translation: Ipapaliwanag ko po ang mga hangganan ng pagiging kumpidensiyal.

english: Is there anything important you want me to know?
transliteration: mah-ee mah-HAH-lah-gah poh bah kah-YOHNG goo-STOHNG ee-pah-EE-lahm sah ah-KIN?
translation: May mahalaga po ba kayong gustong ipaalam sa akin?

english: When did these feelings or symptoms begin?
transliteration: KAH-ee-LAHN poh nahg-soo-MOO-lah ahng mah-NGAH dam-DAH-min oh sim-TOH-mahs nahng EE-toh?
translation: Kailan po nagsimula ang mga damdamin o sintomas na ito?

english: Did anything happen around the time they started?
transliteration: mah-ee nah-YAH-ree poh bah noong nahg-soo-MOO-lah ahng mah-NGAH EE-toh?
translation: May nangyari po ba noong nagsimula ang mga ito?

english: Have things been getting better or worse?
transliteration: goo-MAH-gaan poh bah ahng kah-lah-GAH-yahn nee-NYOH oh lah-LAH-lah?
translation: Gumagaan po ba ang kalagayan ninyo o lumalala?

english: How often do you feel this way?
transliteration: gah-AH-noh poh kah-DAH-lahs nee-NYOH nah-rah-RAHM-dahm EE-toh?
translation: Gaano po kadalas ninyo nararamdaman ito?

english: How much is this affecting your daily life?
transliteration: gah-AH-noh poh kah-LAH-kee ahng ee-TOH sah pahg-ANG-ah-RAW-ah-RAW nee-NYOHNG boo-HEE?
translation: Gaano po kalaki ang epekto nito sa pang-araw-araw ninyong buhay?

english: Are you able to go to work or school?
transliteration: nah-kah-kah-POOK poh bah kah-YOH sah TRAH-bah-hoh oh pah-RAH-ah-LAHN?
translation: Nakakapasok po ba kayo sa trabaho o paaralan?

english: Are you managing your usual responsibilities?
transliteration: nah-gah-GAHM-pah-nahn poh bah nee-NYOH ahng mah-NGAH kah-rah-nee-WAHN nee-NYOHNG reh-spon-see-bee-lee-DAHD?
translation: Nagagampanan po ba ninyo ang mga karaniwan ninyong responsibilidad?

english: What has helped you cope so far?
transliteration: ah-NOH poh ahng nah-TOO-long sah ee-NYOH pah-RAH mah-ka-YAH-nahn EE-toh hang-GAH NGAH-yon?
translation: Ano po ang nakatulong sa inyo para makayanan ito hanggang ngayon?

english: Have you been feeling sad or down?
transliteration: nah-loo-LOONG-kot oh nah-loo-LOOM-bay poh bah kah-YOH?
translation: Nalulungkot o nalulumbay po ba kayo?

english: Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy?
transliteration: nah-WAH-lahn poh bah kah-YOH nahng ee-neh-REHS sah mah-NGAH bah-HAH-ging dah-TEE nee-NYOHNG kah-nee-gee-GEE-lah-wahn?
translation: Nawalan po ba kayo ng interes sa mga bagay na dati ninyong kinagigiliwan?

english: Do you feel hopeless about the future?
transliteration: WAH-lah nah poh bah kah-YOHNG pahg-AH-sah sah hee-nah-HAH-rahp?
translation: Wala na po ba kayong pag-asa sa hinaharap?

english: Do you feel guilty or worthless?
transliteration: nah-koh-kon-SEN-see-yah oh pah-kee-RAHM-dahm nee-NYOH ay WAH-lah kah-YOHNG ah-RAHGAH?
translation: Nakokonsensiya o pakiramdam ninyo ay wala kayong halaga?

english: Do you cry more often than usual?
transliteration: mahs mah-DAH-lahs poh bah kah-YOHNG oo-mee-EE-yahk kah-SAH da-TEE?
translation: Mas madalas po ba kayong umiiyak kaysa dati?

english: Has your energy been low?
transliteration: mah-BAH-bah poh bah ahng ee-NYOHNG EH-ner-jee?
translation: Mababa po ba ang inyong enerhiya?

english: Is it hard to concentrate or make decisions?
transliteration: nah-HEE-rahp poh bah kah-YOHNG mahg-poh-KOOS oh mahg-pah-SYAH?
translation: Nahihirapan po ba kayong magpokus o magpasya?

english: Have you noticed changes in your appetite?
transliteration: mah-ee nah-pahn-SIN poh bah kah-YOHNG bah-BAH-goh sah ee-NYOHNG GAH-nah sah pahg-KAH-een?
translation: May napansin po ba kayong pagbabago sa inyong gana sa pagkain?

english: Have you noticed any changes in your weight?
transliteration: mah-ee nah-pahn-SIN poh bah kah-YOHNG bah-BAH-goh sah ee-NYOHNG tim-BAHNG?
translation: May napansin po ba kayong pagbabago sa inyong timbang?

english: Do you often feel worried or anxious?
transliteration: mah-DAH-lahs poh bah kah-YOHNG mahg-ah-AH-lah oh mah-bah-LEE-sah?
translation: Madalas po ba kayong mag-alala o mabalisa?

english: Is it difficult to control your worries?
transliteration: nah-HEE-rahp poh bah kah-YOHNG kon-troh-LEEN ahng ee-NYOHNG mah-NGAH ah-lah-LEE-ning?
translation: Nahihirapan po ba kayong kontrolin ang inyong mga alalahanin?

english: Do you feel restless or on edge?
transliteration: heen-DEE poh bah kah-YOH mah-pah-KEE-lee oh pah-RAHNG lah-ging kee-nah-KAH-bah?
translation: Hindi po ba kayo mapakali o parang laging kinakabahan?

english: Do you have sudden episodes of intense fear?
transliteration: big-LAHNG big-LAHNG poh bah kah-YOHNG nah-kah-rah-RAH-nahs nahng mah-TEEN-ding tah-KOHT?
translation: Bigla-bigla po ba kayong nakararanas ng matinding takot?

english: During these episodes, does your heart race?
transliteration: sah mah-NGAH gah-NEE-tohNG pahg-kah-KAH-tahn, boo-mee-BEE-lis poh bah ahng TEE-bohk nahng POO-soh nee-NYOH?
translation: Sa mga ganitong pagkakataon, bumibilis po ba ang tibok ng puso ninyo?

english: Do you feel short of breath when anxious?
transliteration: nah-oo-OO-bos poh bah kah-YOH nahng hee-NEE-nga kah-pahg nah-bah-LEE-sah?
translation: Nauubusan po ba kayo ng hininga kapag nababalisa?

english: Do you avoid places because you fear having a panic attack?
transliteration: oo-mee-EE-wahs poh bah kah-YOH sah mah-NGAH loo-GAHR dah-HEEL nah-tah-TAH-kohht kah-YOHNG mag-ka-ROH-ohn nahng mah-TEEN-ding pahg-ah-TAH-keh nahng tah-KOHT?
translation: Umiiwas po ba kayo sa mga lugar dahil natatakot kayong magkaroon ng matinding pag-atake ng takot?

english: Do unwanted thoughts keep coming into your mind?
transliteration: pah-oolit-OO-lit poh bahng poo-MAH-pahs sa ee-SIP nee-NYOH ahng mah-NGAH kah-ee-see-PAHNG ah-YAW nee-NYOH?
translation: Paulit-ulit po bang pumapasok sa isip ninyo ang mga kaisipang ayaw ninyo?

english: Do you feel you must repeat certain actions?
transliteration: pah-kee-RAHM-dahm poh bah nee-NYOH ay kah-ee-LAH-ngahn nee-NYOHNG oo-lee-TEEN ahng EE-lahng KEE-lohs?
translation: Pakiramdam po ba ninyo ay kailangan ninyong ulitin ang ilang kilos?

english: How many hours do you sleep each night?
transliteration: ee-LAHNG OH-rahs poh kah-YOHNG nah-too-too-LOHG bah-WAHT gah-BEE?
translation: Ilang oras po kayong natutulog bawat gabi?

english: Is it difficult to fall asleep?
transliteration: nah-HEE-rahp poh bah kah-YOHNG mah-kah-too-LOHG?
translation: Nahihirapan po ba kayong makatulog?

english: Do you wake up often during the night?
transliteration: mah-DAH-lahs poh bah kah-YOHNG mah-gee-SING sah gah-BEE?
translation: Madalas po ba kayong magising sa gabi?

english: Do you wake up earlier than you want to?
transliteration: nah-gee-gee-SING poh bah kah-YOH nahng mahs mah-AH-gah kah-SAH goo-STOH nee-NYOH?
translation: Nagigising po ba kayo nang mas maaga kaysa gusto ninyo?

english: Do you feel rested in the morning?
transliteration: pah-kee-RAHM-dahm poh bah nee-NYOH ay nahg-pah-HEE-rah kah-YOH pahg-gee-SING sah ah-MAH-gah?
translation: Pakiramdam po ba ninyo ay nakapagpahinga kayo pagkagising sa umaga?

english: Do you have nightmares?
transliteration: nahg-kah-ROH-ohn poh bah kah-YOH nahng bah-NGOONG-oht?
translation: Nagkakaroon po ba kayo ng bangungot?

english: Have you been sleeping much more than usual?
transliteration: mahs mah-HAH-bah poh bah ahng too-LOHG nee-NYOH kah-SAH kah-rah-nee-WAHN?
translation: Mas mahaba po ba ang tulog ninyo kaysa karaniwan?

english: Do you feel tired during the day?
transliteration: nah-kah-kah-RAHM-dahm poh bah kah-YOH nahng pahg-OD sah mahg-HAH-pon?
translation: Nakakaramdam po ba kayo ng pagod sa maghapon?

english: Have there been times when you felt unusually energetic or excited?
transliteration: mah-ee mah-NGAH pah-NAH-hohn poh bah pah-kee-RAHM-dahm nee-NYOH ay dee-kah-rah-nee-WAHNG mahs-EE-gah oh sah-BEEK nahng sah-BEEK kah-YOH?
translation: May mga panahong pakiramdam ninyo ay di-karaniwang masigla o sabik na sabik kayo?

english: Have you needed much less sleep without feeling tired?
transliteration: mahs kah-OO-nti poh bah ahng too-LOHG nahng kah-ee-LAH-ngahn nee-NYOH nang heen-DEE kah-YOH nah-kah-kah-RAHM-dahm nahng pahg-OD?
translation: Mas kaunti po ba ang tulog na kailangan ninyo nang hindi kayo nakakaramdam ng pagod?

english: Have others said you were talking unusually fast?
transliteration: mah-ee nahg-sah-BEE poh bah sah ee-NYOH ay dee-kah-rah-nee-WAHNG mah-lee-GAHN kah-YOHNG mahg-sah-LEE-tah?
translation: May nagsabi po ba sa inyo na di-karaniwang mabilis kayong magsalita?

english: Have your thoughts been racing?
transliteration: pah-RAHNG nahg-oo-oo-NAH-hahn poh bah ahng mah-NGAH nah-ee-SEE-pah nee-NYOH?
translation: Parang nag-uunahan po ba ang mga naiisip ninyo?

english: Have you felt unusually confident or powerful?
transliteration: pah-kee-RAHM-dahm poh bah nee-NYOH ay dee-kah-rah-nee-WAHN kah-YOHNG koom-pee-YAHN-sah oh mah-kah-pah-NGYAH-ree-hahn?
translation: Pakiramdam po ba ninyo ay di-karaniwan kayong kumpiyansa o makapangyarihan?

english: Have you spent more money than you intended?
transliteration: mahs mah-LAH-kee poh bah ahng nahg-ah-NAHHS nee-NYOH kah-SAH sah beh-RAH?
translation: Mas malaki po ba ang nagastos ninyo kaysa sa balak ninyo?

english: Have you taken unusual risks during these periods?
transliteration: mah-ee nahg-eh-ROHNs poh bah kah-YOH nahng mah-NGAH dee-kah-rah-nee-WAHNG mah-pah-ngah-NIB nahng mah-NGAH pah-NAH-hohn ee-TOH?
translation: May ginawa po ba kayong mga di-karaniwang mapanganib na bagay sa mga panahong iyon?

english: How long did these periods last?
transliteration: gah-AH-noh poh kah-TAH-lahg too-MAH-gahl ahng mah-NGAH pah-NAH-hohn ee-TOH?
translation: Gaano po katagal tumagal ang mga panahong iyon?

english: Have you heard voices that others cannot hear?
transliteration: mah-ee nah-ree-REE-nig poh bah kah-YOH nahng mah-NGAH tee-NIG nahng deen-ree-REE-nig nahng ee-BAH?
translation: May naririnig po ba kayong mga tinig na hindi naririnig ng iba?

english: Have you seen things that others cannot see?
transliteration: mah-ee nah-kee-KEE-tah poh bah kah-YOH nahng mah-NGAH bah-HAH-ging deen-kee-KEE-tah nahng ee-BAH?
translation: May nakikita po ba kayong mga bagay na hindi nakikita ng iba?

english: Do you feel that someone is watching or following you?
transliteration: pah-kee-RAHM-dahm poh bah nee-NYOH ay mah-ee nahg-mah-MAH-nahsd oh soo-MOO-nohd sah ee-NYOH?
translation: Pakiramdam po ba ninyo ay may nagmamasid o sumusunod sa inyo?

english: Do you feel that someone wants to harm you?
transliteration: pah-kee-RAHM-dahm poh bah nee-NYOH ay mah-ee goos-TOHNG mah-nah-NAH-keet sah ee-NYOH?
translation: Pakiramdam po ba ninyo ay may gustong manakit sa inyo?

english: Do you feel your thoughts are being controlled?
transliteration: pah-kee-RAHM-dahm poh bah nee-NYOH ay mah-ee koo-moo-kon-TROHL sah ee-NYOHNG mah-NGAH ee-nee-EE-sip?
translation: Pakiramdam po ba ninyo ay may kumokontrol sa inyong mga iniisip?

english: Do the voices ever tell you to do something?
transliteration: mah-ee mah-NGAH pahg-kah-KAH-tahn poh bah nahng ee-oo-oo-TOOS kah-YOH nahng mah-NGAH tee-NIG nahng goo-MAH-wah nahng ee-SAHNG BA-ging bagay?
translation: May mga pagkakataon po ba na inuutusan kayo ng mga tinig na gumawa ng isang bagay?

english: What do you think these experiences mean?
transliteration: ah-NOH poh sah pah-lah-GAY nee-NYOH ahng ee-BAH-bee-GAHY sah mah-NGAH kah-rah-nah-sahng EE-toh?
translation: Ano po sa palagay ninyo ang ibig sabihin ng mga karanasang ito?

english: Do these experiences frighten you?
transliteration: nah-tah-TAH-kohht poh bah kah-YOH sah mah-NGAH kah-rah-nah-sahng EE-toh?
translation: Natatakot po ba kayo sa mga karanasang ito?

english: Sometimes when people feel overwhelmed, they think about death. Has that happened to you?
transliteration: MEEN-sahn, kah-pahg lah-HEES nahng nah-HEE-rahp ahng mah-NGAH tah-OH, nah-EE-see-PAH nee-LAH ahng kah-mah-TAH-ahn. nah-YAH-ree nah poh bah EE-yon sah ee-NYOH?
translation: Minsan, kapag labis na nahihirapan ang mga tao, naiisip nila ang kamatayan. Nangyari na po ba iyon sa inyo?

english: Have you wished you could go to sleep and not wake up?
transliteration: nah-ee-NAH-ees poh bah nee-NYOH nahng minsahn nah mah-kah-too-LOHG at heen-DEE nah mah-GEE-sing?
translation: Ninais po ba ninyo minsan na makatulog at hindi na magising?

english: Have you had thoughts of ending your life?
transliteration: nah-EE-see-PAH poh bah nee-NYOHNG wah-KAH-sahn ahng boo-HEE nee-NYOH?
translation: Naisip po ba ninyong wakasan ang buhay ninyo?

english: Are you having those thoughts right now?
transliteration: mah-ee mah-NGAH nah-ee-SEE-pah poh bah kah-YOHNG gah-NYAHN NGAH-yon?
translation: May mga naiisip po ba kayong ganoon ngayon?

english: Have you thought about how you might do it?
transliteration: nah-EE-see-PAH poh bah nee-NYOH kung pah-AH-noh nee-NYOH ee-TOH mah-ah-AH-reeNG goo-MAH-wah?
translation: Naisip po ba ninyo kung paano ninyo ito maaaring gawin?

english: Have you made a plan to end your life?
transliteration: nahg-OO-wah poh bah kah-YOH nahng plah-NOH pah-RAH wah-KAH-sahn ahng boo-HEE nee-NYOH?
translation: Nakagawa po ba kayo ng plano para wakasan ang buhay ninyo?

english: Do you have access to anything you might use to hurt yourself?
transliteration: mah-ee AK-ses poh bah kah-YOH sah ah-NUH-mahng bagay nah mah-ah-AH-ree nee-NYOHNG ee-GAH-mit pah-RAH sah-KTAHN ahng sah-REE-lee nee-NYOH?
translation: May access po ba kayo sa anumang bagay na maaari ninyong gamitin para saktan ang sarili ninyo?

english: Have you ever tried to end your life before?
transliteration: see-noo-BAH-yahn nah poh bah nee-NYOHNG wah-KAH-sahn ahng boo-HEE nee-NYOH noon?
translation: Sinubukan na po ba ninyong wakasan ang buhay ninyo noon?

english: Have you ever hurt yourself on purpose?
transliteration: see-nah-KTAHN nah poh bah nee-NYOH ahng sah-REE-lee nee-NYOH nahng sahd-YAH?
translation: Sinaktan na po ba ninyo ang sarili ninyo nang sadya?

english: What has helped you stay safe so far?
transliteration: ah-NOH poh ahng nah-TOO-long sah ee-NYOH pah-RAH mah-nah-TEE-ling LEE-gtaas hang-GAH NGAH-yon?
translation: Ano po ang nakatulong sa inyo para manatiling ligtas hanggang ngayon?

english: Is there someone you trust whom we can contact?
transliteration: mah-ee tah-OHNG pee-nahg-kah-tee-WAH-lah-ahn poh bah kah-YOH nah mah-ah-AH-ree nah-TEEN taw-HAH-gahn?
translation: May taong pinagkakatiwalaan po ba kayo na maaari nating tawagan?

english: I am concerned about your safety and want to help you stay safe.
transliteration: nahg-ah-AH-lah poh ah-KOH pah-RAH sah kah-lee-GTAH-sahn nee-NYOH at goo-STOH koh kah-YOHNG too-loo-NGAHN nah-mah-NAH-tee-ling LEE-gtaas.
translation: Nag-aalala po ako para sa kaligtasan ninyo at gusto ko kayong tulungang manatiling ligtas.

english: Do you feel safe where you live?
transliteration: LEE-gtaas poh bah ahng pah-kee-RAHM-dahm nee-NYOH sah tee-nee-TEE-rah-hahn nee-NYOH?
translation: Ligtas po ba ang pakiramdam ninyo sa tinitirhan ninyo?

english: Has anyone threatened or hurt you?
transliteration: mah-ee nahg-BAH-nah oh nahn-AH-kit nah poh bah sah ee-NYOH?
translation: May nagbanta o nanakit na po ba sa inyo?

english: Are you afraid of anyone at home?
transliteration: mah-ee kee-nah-tah-KOO-tahn poh bah kah-YOH sah BAH-hay nee-NYOH?
translation: May kinatatakutan po ba kayo sa bahay ninyo?

english: Have you had thoughts of hurting someone else?
transliteration: nah-EE-see-PAH poh bah nee-NYOHNG sah-KTAHN ahng ee-BAHNG tah-OH?
translation: Naisip po ba ninyong saktan ang ibang tao?

english: Is there a particular person you are thinking about hurting?
transliteration: mah-ee pah-tee-koo-LAHR poh bah kah-YOHNG nah-ee-SEE-pahng sah-KTAHN?
translation: May partikular po ba kayong naiisip na saktan?

english: Do you have a plan to hurt anyone?
transliteration: mah-ee plah-NOH poh bah kah-YOHNG mah-nah-NAH-kit nahng kah-YT SEE-noh?
translation: May plano po ba kayong manakit ng kahit sino?

english: Are there children or other vulnerable people at home?
transliteration: mah-ee mah-NGAH bah-TAH oh ee-BAHNG tah-OHNG mah-DAH-lee mah-pah-HAH-mahk sah BAH-hay nee-NYOH?
translation: May mga bata o ibang taong madaling mapahamak sa bahay ninyo?

english: Have you experienced something frightening or traumatic?
transliteration: mah-ee nah-rah-NAH-sahn poh bah kah-YOHNG nah-kah-kah-TAH-kohht oh trah-MAH-tee-kohng pahg-YAH-ree?
translation: May naranasan po ba kayong nakakatakot o traumatikong pangyayari?

english: You do not have to share details before you are ready.
transliteration: heen-DEE poh nee-NYOH kah-ee-LAH-ngahn mahg-BAH-gee nahng mah-NGAH deh-TAHL-yay hang-GAHT heen-DEE pah kah-YOH handa.
translation: Hindi po ninyo kailangang magbahagi ng mga detalye hangga't hindi pa kayo handa.

english: Do memories of that experience come back unexpectedly?
transliteration: big-LAHNG big-LAHNG poh bahng bah-BAH-lik sah ee-SIP nee-NYOH ahng mah-NGAH ah-lah-AH-lah nahng kah-rah-nah-sahng EE-yon?
translation: Bigla-bigla po bang bumabalik sa isip ninyo ang mga alaala ng karanasang iyon?

english: Do you have nightmares about what happened?
transliteration: nahg-kah-ROH-ohn poh bah kah-YOH nahng mah-NGAH bah-NGOONG-oht tuh-KOL sah nah-YAH-ree?
translation: Nagkakaroon po ba kayo ng mga bangungot tungkol sa nangyari?

english: Do you avoid reminders of what happened?
transliteration: oo-mee-EE-wahs poh bah kah-YOH sah mah-NGAH bagay nahng pah-PAH-ah-RAH-lah sah ee-NYOH nahng nah-YAH-ree?
translation: Umiiwas po ba kayo sa mga bagay na nagpapaalala sa inyo ng nangyari?

english: Do you feel constantly on guard or unsafe?
transliteration: pah-RAH-gee poh bah kah-YOH nahg-bah-BAH-ntay oh nah-kah-kah-RAHM-dahm nah heen-DEE LEE-gtaas?
translation: Palagi po ba kayong nagbabantay o nakakaramdam na hindi ligtas?

english: Do you sometimes feel disconnected from yourself or your surroundings?
transliteration: mah-ee mah-NGAH pahg-kah-KAH-tahn poh bah nahng pah-kee-RAHM-dahm nee-NYOH ay hi-NYAHG kah-YOH sah sah-REE-lee oh sah pah-ree-LEE-gid nee-NYOH?
translation: May mga pagkakataon po ba na pakiramdam ninyo ay hiwalay kayo sa sarili o sa paligid ninyo?

english: Do you drink alcohol?
transliteration: oo-mee-EE-nom poh bah kah-YOH nahng ah-LAHK?
translation: Umiinom po ba kayo ng alak?

english: How often and how much do you drink?
transliteration: gah-AH-noh poh kah-dah-LAHS aht gah-AH-noh kah-rah-MEE ahng ee-nee-EE-nohm nee-NYOH?
translation: Gaano po kadalas at gaano karami ang iniinom ninyo?

english: Have you wanted to cut down on drinking?
transliteration: nah-EES nah poh bah nee-NYOHNG bah-wah-SAHN ahng pahg-ee-NOHM?
translation: Nais na po ba ninyong bawasan ang pag-inom?

english: Has anyone expressed concern about your drinking?
transliteration: mah-nee-gpah-HAH-yahg nah poh bah ngah pahg-ee-ah-gah-LAH gah-tooong-KOHL sah pahg-ee-NOHM nee-NYOH?
translation: May nagpahayag na po ba ng pag-aalala tungkol sa pag-inom ninyo?

english: Do you use cannabis?
transliteration: goo-mah-GAH-mit poh bah kah-YOH ngah KAHN-nah-bis?
translation: Gumagamit po ba kayo ng cannabis?

english: Do you use cocaine, opioids, or other drugs?
transliteration: goo-mah-GAH-mit poh bah kah-YOH ngah koh-KAYN oh-pee-OYDS oh EE-bah pahng DROH-gah?
translation: Gumagamit po ba kayo ng cocaine, opioids, o iba pang droga?

english: Have you ever injected drugs?
transliteration: nah-kah-pahg-een-EEK-shon nah poh bah kah-YOH ngah DROH-gah?
translation: Nakapag-iniksyon na po ba kayo ng droga?

english: When did you last use alcohol or other substances?
transliteration: kah-ee-LAHN poh kah-YOH HOO-ling oo-mee-NOHM ngah ah-LAHK oh goo-MAH-mit ngah EE-bahng soos-tahn-SEE-yah?
translation: Kailan po kayo huling uminom ng alak o gumamit ng ibang substansiya?

english: Do you feel shaky or unwell when you stop using them?
transliteration: nah-nging-ee-NIG oh heen-DEE mah-gahn-DAH ahng pah-kee-RAHM-dahm nee-NYOH kah-pahg too-mee-TEE-tihl kah-YOH sah pahg-GAH-mit ngah mahng EE-toh?
translation: Nanginginig o hindi maganda ang pakiramdam ninyo kapag tumitigil kayo sa paggamit ng mga ito?

english: Have you ever had a seizure during withdrawal?
transliteration: nah-gah-ROHN nah poh bah kah-YOH ngah kohm-BOOL-syon hah-BAHNG nahg-ah-ah-LEES ngah bee-SAH ahng DROH-gah oh ah-LAHK?
translation: Nagkaroon na po ba kayo ng kombulsyon habang nag-aalis ng bisa ang droga o alak?

english: Would you like support to reduce or stop using substances?
transliteration: goo-STOH poh bah nee-NYOH ngah TOO-lohng pah-rah mah-bah-wah-SAHN oh mah-TEE-tihl ahng pahg-GAH-mit ngah mahng soos-tahn-SEE-yah?
translation: Gusto po ba ninyo ng tulong para mabawasan o matigil ang paggamit ng mga substansiya?

english: How do you feel about your eating habits?
transliteration: ah-NOH poh ahng pah-kee-RAHM-dahm nee-NYOH tooong-KOHL sah mahng nah-kah-SAH-nahn nee-NYOHNG pahg-KAH-een?
translation: Ano po ang pakiramdam ninyo tungkol sa mga nakasanayan ninyong pagkain?

english: Do you worry a lot about your weight or body shape?
transliteration: mah-DAH-lahs poh bah kah-YOHNG mahg-ah-GAH-lah tooong-KOHL sah TIM-bahng oh HOO-liz ngah kah-TOO-wahn nee-NYOH?
translation: Madalas po ba kayong mag-alala tungkol sa timbang o hugis ng katawan ninyo?

english: Have you been skipping meals or restricting food?
transliteration: heen-DEE poh bah kah-YOH koo-MAH-kahn sah EE-lahng oh-RAHS ngah pahg-KAH-een oh nee-lee-lee-MEE-tahn ahng ee-nee-KAH-een nee-NYOH?
translation: Hindi po ba kayo kumakain sa ilang oras ng pagkain o nililimitahan ang kinakain ninyo?

english: Do you sometimes feel unable to stop eating?
transliteration: mah-EYE mahng pahg-kah-kah-TAH-ohhn poh bahng pah-kee-RAHM-dahm nee-NYOH eye heen-DEE nee-NYOH mah-pee-GEE-lahn ahng pahg-KAH-een?
translation: May mga pagkakataon po bang pakiramdam ninyo ay hindi ninyo mapigilan ang pagkain?

english: Have you made yourself vomit after eating?
transliteration: pee-NEE-lit nah poh bah nee-NYOHNG pah-soo-KAH-hin ahng ee-NYOHNG sah-REE-lee pahg-kah-TEH-lahk kah-EEN?
translation: Pinilit na po ba ninyong pasukahin ang inyong sarili pagkatapos kumain?

english: Have you been exercising to compensate for eating?
transliteration: nahg-ee-HEHR-see-syo poh bah kah-YOH pah-rah toom-BAH-sahn ahng ee-NEE-kahn nee-NYOH?
translation: Nag-eehersisyo po ba kayo para tumbasan ang kinain ninyo?

english: Have you had trouble paying attention?
transliteration: nah-hee-RAH-pahn poh bah kah-YOHNG mahg-bee-GAY-pahn-sin?
translation: Nahihirapan po ba kayong magbigay-pansin?

english: Do you often forget appointments or tasks?
transliteration: mah-DAH-lahs poh bah nee-NYOHNG nah-kah-kah-lim-OO-tahn ahng mahng ah-POYNT-ment oh gah-WAH-een?
translation: Madalas po ba ninyong nakakalimutan ang mga appointment o gawain?

english: Have you noticed changes in your memory?
transliteration: mah-EYE nah-pahn-SIN poh bah kah-YOH ngah pahg-bah-BAH-go sah ee-NYOHNG MEM-or-yah?
translation: May napansin po ba kayong pagbabago sa inyong memorya?

english: Do you find it difficult to organize tasks?
transliteration: nah-hee-RAH-pahn poh bah kah-YOHNG mahg-ah-YOHS ngah mahng gah-WAH-een?
translation: Nahihirapan po ba kayong mag-ayos ng mga gawain?

english: Have you been feeling confused?
transliteration: nah-lee-LOO poh bah kah-YOH nee-TONG mahng nah-kah-RAH-ahn?
translation: Nalilito po ba kayo nitong mga nakaraan?

english: Has anyone noticed a change in your behaviour?
transliteration: mah-EYE nah-kah-PAN-sin poh bah ngah pahg-bah-BAH-go sah ee-NYOHNG ah-SAL?
translation: May nakapansin po ba ng pagbabago sa inyong asal?

english: Can you tell me your full name?
transliteration: mah-ah-REE poh bahng mah-LAH-mahn ahng boo-OHNG pah-nga-LAHN nee-NYOH?
translation: Maaari po bang malaman ang buong pangalan ninyo?

english: Can you tell me today’s date?
transliteration: mah-ah-REE poh bahng sah-BEE-hin nee-NYOH kung ah-NOHNG PET-sah ngah-YOHN?
translation: Maaari po bang sabihin ninyo kung anong petsa ngayon?

english: Can you tell me where we are right now?
transliteration: mah-ah-REE poh bahng sah-BEE-hin nee-NYOH kung nah-sah-AHN tah-YOH ngah-YOHN?
translation: Maaari po bang sabihin ninyo kung nasaan tayo ngayon?

english: I will say three words; please repeat them.
transliteration: mahg-sah-SAH-bee poh ah-KOH ngah tah-TLOHNG sah-LEE-tah pah-kee-SAH-bee poh oo-LEET ahng mahng EE-toh.
translation: Magsasabi po ako ng tatlong salita; pakisabi po ulit ang mga ito.

english: Please try to remember those words for later.
transliteration: pah-kee-soo-BUH-kahn pohng tah-NDAH-ahhn ahng mahng sah-LEE-tahng EE-yohn pah-rah sah soo-noo-DNOOD.
translation: Pakisubukan pong tandaan ang mga salitang iyon para sa susunod.

english: Can you tell me those three words now?
transliteration: mah-ah-REE poh bahng sah-BEE-hin nee-NYOH ngah-YOHN ahng tah-TLOHNG sah-LEE-tahng EE-yohn?
translation: Maaari po bang sabihin ninyo ngayon ang tatlong salitang iyon?

english: Can you spell a word backwards?
transliteration: mah-ah-REE poh bahng bahy-bah-YIN ahng ee-SAHNG sah-LEE-tahng nahng pah-bah-LEEK-tahd?
translation: Maaari po bang baybayin ang isang salita nang pabaliktad?

english: What do you think is causing these difficulties?
transliteration: ah-NOH poh sah pah-LAH-gay nee-NYOH ahng sahn-SEE ngah mahng pahg-hee-RAH-pahn EE-toh?
translation: Ano po sa palagay ninyo ang sanhi ng mga paghihirap na ito?

english: How would you describe your mood today?
transliteration: pah-ah-NOH poh nee-NYOH ee-lah-lah-RAH-wahn ahng ee-NYOHNG mood ngah-YOHN?
translation: Paano po ninyo ilalarawan ang inyong mood ngayon?

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Have you ever seen a psychiatrist or counsellor?
transliteration: nahg-pah-TEE-ngin nah poh bah kah-YOH sah sy-kye-ah-trist oh KOWN-seh-ler?
translation: Nagpatingin na po ba kayo sa psychiatrist o counselor?

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Have you ever been admitted to hospital for mental health care?
transliteration: nah-ad-MIT nah poh bah kah-YOH sah ohs-pee-TAHL pah-rah sah pahg-kah-rah-GAH ngah kah-loo-soo-GAHN pahng-kah-EEPS-ee-tahn?
translation: Na-admit na po ba kayo sa ospital para sa pangangalaga ng kalusugang pangkaisipan?

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Has anyone in your family had mental health difficulties?
transliteration: mah-EYE kah-pahm-EE-lyah poh bahng nah-gah-ROHN ngah mahng proh-BLEH-mah sah kah-loo-soo-GAHN pahng-kah-EEPS-ee-tahn?
translation: May kapamilya po ba kayong nagkaroon ng mga problema sa kalusugang pangkaisipan?

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Do you have any medical conditions?
transliteration: mah-YOHN poh bah kah-YOH ngah ah-NOO-mahng sah-KIT?
translation: Mayroon po ba kayong anumang sakit?

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Who do you live with?
transliteration: SEE-noh-SEE-noh poh ahng kah-SAH-mah nee-NYOH sah bah-HAY?
translation: Sino-sino po ang kasama ninyo sa bahay?

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Who can you turn to for support?
transliteration: SEE-noh poh ahng mah-lah-LAH-pit nee-NYOH pah-rah hoo-MEE-ngih ngah soo-POR-tah?
translation: Sino po ang malalapitan ninyo para humingi ng suporta?

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Have you had recent financial or housing difficulties?
transliteration: nah-gah-ROHN poh bah kah-YOH kah-MAH-ee-lahn ngah proh-BLEH-mah sah PEH-rah oh tee-RAH-hahn?
translation: Nagkaroon po ba kayo kamakailan ng problema sa pera o tirahan?

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Are your relationships causing you stress?
transliteration: nah-gee-gee-NGEE ngah-SEE ngah stress ahng mahng reh-LAH-syon nee-NYOH?
translation: Nagiging sanhi po ba ng stress ang mga relasyon ninyo?

english: What medicines are you taking now?
transliteration: ah-NOHNG mahng gah-MOHT poh ahng ee-nee-EE-nohm nee-NYOH ngah-YOHN?
translation: Anong mga gamot po ang iniinom ninyo ngayon?

english: Do you take antidepressant medication?
transliteration: oo-mee-EE-nohm poh bah kah-YOH ngah gah-MOHT pah-rah sah deh-PREH-syon?
translation: Umiinom po ba kayo ng gamot para sa depresyon?

english: Do you take medicine for anxiety?
transliteration: oo-mee-EE-nohm poh bah kah-YOH ngah gah-MOHT pah-rah sah pahg-kah-bah-LEE-sah?
translation: Umiinom po ba kayo ng gamot para sa pagkabalisa?

english: Do you take antipsychotic medication?
transliteration: oo-mee-EE-nohm poh bah kah-YOH ngah gah-MOHT nah ahn-tee-sy-KOH-tik?
translation: Umiinom po ba kayo ng gamot na antipsychotic?

english: Do you take a mood stabilizer?
transliteration: oo-mee-EE-nohm poh bah kah-YOH ngah pahm-pah-tah-TAHG ngah mood?
translation: Umiinom po ba kayo ng pampatatag ng mood?

english: Do you take sleeping pills or benzodiazepines?
transliteration: oo-mee-EE-nohm poh bah kah-YOH ngah pahm-pah-TOO-log oh ben-zoh-die-AZ-eh-peens?
translation: Umiinom po ba kayo ng pampatulog o benzodiazepines?

english: What dose do you take and how often?
transliteration: ah-NOHNG DOH-sis poh ahng ee-nee-EE-nohm nee-NYOH aht gah-AH-noh kah-dah-LAHS?
translation: Anong dosis po ang iniinom ninyo, at gaano kadalas?

english: How long have you been taking this medicine?
transliteration: gah-AH-noh nah poh kah-YOH kah-TAH-gahl oo-mee-EE-nohm ngah gah-MOHT nah EE-toh?
translation: Gaano na po kayo katagal umiinom ng gamot na ito?

english: Have you missed any doses recently?
transliteration: mah-EYE nah-lahk-TAH-wahn poh bah kah-YOHNG DOH-sis kah-MAH-ee-lahn?
translation: May nalaktawan po ba kayong dosis kamakailan?

english: Has the medicine been helping?
transliteration: nah-kah-kah-TOO-lohng poh bah ahng gah-MOHT?
translation: Nakakatulong po ba ang gamot?

english: Have you noticed any side effects?
transliteration: mah-EYE nah-pahn-SIN poh bah kah-YOH ngah ah-NOO-mahng side eh-FEKT?
translation: May napansin po ba kayong anumang side effect?

english: Have you stopped any medication recently?
transliteration: mah-EYE ee-tee-NEE-gil poh bah kah-YOHNG gah-MOHT kah-MAH-ee-lahn?
translation: May itinigil po ba kayong gamot kamakailan?

english: What are your goals for treatment?
transliteration: ah-NOH poh ahng mahng lah-OO-nih nee-NYOH sah pahg-TOO-tah-pohs?
translation: Ano po ang mga layunin ninyo sa paggamot?

english: Would you be interested in talking therapy or counselling?
transliteration: in-teh-REH-sah-doh poh bah kah-YOHNG soo-BUH-kahn ahng talk THEH-rah-pee oh KOWN-seh-ling?
translation: Interesado po ba kayong subukan ang talk therapy o counseling?

english: We can discuss medication options together.
transliteration: mah-ah-REE poh tah-YOHNG pahg-oooos-AH-pahn nahng mag-kah-SAH-mah ahng mahng OHP-shohn sah gah-MOHT.
translation: Maaari po nating pag-usapan nang magkasama ang mga opsyon sa gamot.

english: Some medicines take several weeks to work fully.
transliteration: mah-EYE mahng gah-MOHT poh nah EE-lahng LING-goh moo-nah bah-go loo-BOO-sahng oo-MEH-pek-toh.
translation: May ilang gamot po na ilang linggo muna bago lubusang umepekto.

english: Please speak with your clinician before stopping medication.
transliteration: mah-kee-pahg-ooos-AHP poh moo-nah sah clinician nee-NYOH bah-go ee-TEE-gil ahng gah-MOHT.
translation: Makipag-usap po muna sa clinician ninyo bago itigil ang gamot.

english: Would you like us to involve a trusted family member?
transliteration: goo-STOH poh bah nee-NYOHNG ee-SAH-mah tah-YOHN sah oo-SAH-pahn ahng ee-SAHNG kah-pahm-EE-lyah nah pee-nahg-kah-tah-WAH-lahhn nee-NYOH?
translation: Gusto po ba ninyong isama natin sa usapan ang isang kapamilya na pinagkakatiwalaan ninyo?

english: We can make a plan for what to do if symptoms worsen.
transliteration: mah-ah-REE poh tah-YOHNG mahg-tah-KDAH ngah plah-NOH kung ah-NOH ahng gah-GAH-win kah-pahg loo-MAH-lah ahng mahng simp-TOHMS.
translation: Maaari po tayong gumawa ng plano kung ano ang gagawin kapag lumala ang mga sintomas.

english: What concerns do you have about treatment?
transliteration: ah-NOH poh ahng mahng ee-kee-nah-bah-BAH-lah nee-NYOH tooong-KOHL sah pahg-TOO-tah-pohs?
translation: Ano po ang mga ikinababahala ninyo tungkol sa paggamot?

english: Do you feel safe going home today?
transliteration: LEE-gthahs poh bah ahng pah-kee-RAHM-dahm nee-NYOH kung oo-OO-wee kah-YOH ngah-YOHN?
translation: Ligtas po ba ang pakiramdam ninyo kung uuwi kayo ngayon?

english: Who could you call if you felt unsafe?
transliteration: SEE-noh poh ahng mah-ah-REE nee-NYOHNG tah-WAH-gahn kung heen-DEE kah-YOH lee-GTHAHS?
translation: Sino po ang maaari ninyong tawagan kung hindi kayo ligtas?

english: Can we identify warning signs that things are getting worse?
transliteration: mah-ah-REE poh bah nah-TAN-too-yahn ahng mahng bah-BAH-lahng pah-lah-tahn-DAHN nah loo-MAH-lah ahng see-tooh-WAH-syon?
translation: Maaari po ba nating tukuyin ang mga babalang palatandaan na lumalala ang sitwasyon?

english: If you are in immediate danger, seek emergency help.
transliteration: kung nah-sah ah-gah-RAHNG pah-ngah-NEEB poh kah-YOH hoo-MEE-ngih ah-GAHD ngah TOO-lohng pahng-ee-MEHR-jen-see.
translation: Kung nasa agarang panganib po kayo, humingi agad ng tulong pang-emergency.

english: We can arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: mah-ah-REE poh tah-YOHNG mahg-TAHG-dah ngah soo-NOH-d na ah-POYNT-ment.
translation: Maaari po tayong magtakda ng susunod na appointment.

english: Would you like information about local support services?
transliteration: goo-STOH poh bah nee-NYOH ngah in-for-MAH-syon tooong-KOHL sah mahng loh-KAHL nah ser-BIS-yohng bee-gee-GAY ngah soo-POR-tah?
translation: Gusto po ba ninyo ng impormasyon tungkol sa mga lokal na serbisyong nagbibigay ng suporta?

english: Is there anything else you would like to ask?
transliteration: mah-EYE EE-bah poh bah kah-YOHNG goo-STOHNG ee-tah-NOHNG?
translation: May iba pa po ba kayong gustong itanong?

english: I am going to ask some questions about your symptoms.
transliteration: mahg-tah-TAH-nohng poh ah-KOH tooong-KOHL sah EE-lahng simp-TOHMS nee-NYOH.
translation: Magtatanong po ako tungkol sa ilang sintomas ninyo.

english: When did your symptoms first begin?
transliteration: kah-ee-LAHN poh oo-MOO-nahng nah-sim-BOO-lah ahng mahng simp-TOHMS nee-NYOH?
translation: Kailan po unang nagsimula ang mga sintomas ninyo?

english: Did the symptoms start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: beeG-LAH-ahng bahng nah-sim-BOO-lah ahng mahng simp-TOHMS oh oon-tee-OON-tee?
translation: Biglaan po bang nagsimula ang mga sintomas o unti-unti?

english: What were you doing when this started?
transliteration: ah-NOH poh ahng gee-NAH-gah-WAH nee-NYOH nahng nah-sim-BOO-lah EE-toh?
translation: Ano po ang ginagawa ninyo nang magsimula ito?

english: Are the symptoms constant or do they come and go?
transliteration: pah-LAH-gee poh bah ahng mahng simp-TOHMS oh nah-WAH-wah aht bah-lee-KAH-lik?
translation: Palagi po ba ang mga sintomas o nawawala at bumabalik?

english: How long does each episode last?
transliteration: gah-AH-noh poh kah-TAH-gahl too-mah-TAH-gahl ahng bah-waht nah pahg-ah-TAH-keh?
translation: Gaano po katagal tumatagal ang bawat pag-atake?

english: How many times a day or week does this happen?
transliteration: ee-LAHNG bee-SEHS poh sah ee-SAHNG dah-AHN oh LEENG-goh EE-toh nahng-yah-YAH-ree?
translation: Ilang beses po sa isang araw o linggo ito nangyayari?

english: Are your symptoms getting better, worse, or staying the same?
transliteration: goo-mah-GAH-ling poh bah, loo-MAH-lah, oh nah-nah-NAH-tee-ling pah-REE-hoh ahng mahng simp-TOHMS nee-NYOH?
translation: Gumagaling po ba, lumalala, o nananatiling pareho ang mga sintomas ninyo?

english: Have you ever had this problem before?
transliteration: nah-rah-NAH-sahn nah poh bah nee-NYOH ahng proh-BLEH-mahng EE-toh dah-TEE?
translation: Naranasan na po ba ninyo ang problemang ito dati?

english: Does anything make it better or worse?
transliteration: mah-YOHN poh bahng nah-kah-pahg-bee-GAY oh nah-kah-pahg-pah-LAH-lah EE-toh?
translation: Mayroon po bang nakapagpapabuti o nakapagpapalala nito?

english: Please tell me immediately if you feel unwell during the examination.
transliteration: pah-kee-SAH-bee poh ah-GAHD sah ah-KOH kung mah-SAH-mah ahng pah-kee-RAHM-dahm nee-NYOH hah-BAHNG see-noo-SOO-ree kah-YOH.
translation: Pakisabi po agad sa akin kung masama ang pakiramdam ninyo habang sinusuri kayo.

english: Did you suddenly develop weakness on one side of your body?
transliteration: beeG-LAH poh bahng nah-NGI-nah ahng ee-SAHNG bah-HAH-gee ngah kah-TOO-wahn nee-NYOH?
translation: Bigla po bang nanghina ang isang bahagi ng katawan ninyo?

english: Did one side of your face suddenly droop?
transliteration: beeG-LAH poh bahng loo-MAHY-lahy ahng ee-SAHNG bah-HAH-gee ngah moo-KHAH nee-NYOH?
translation: Bigla po bang lumaylay ang isang bahagi ng mukha ninyo?

english: Did you suddenly have trouble speaking?
transliteration: beeG-LAH poh bah kah-YOHNG nah-hee-RAH-pahng mahg-sah-LEE-tah?
translation: Bigla po ba kayong nahirapang magsalita?

english: Did you suddenly have trouble understanding speech?
transliteration: beeG-LAH poh bah kah-YOHNG nah-hee-RAH-pahng oo-min-TEEN-dee ahng see-NAH-bee?
translation: Bigla po ba kayong nahirapang umintindi ng sinasabi?

english: Did you suddenly lose vision in one or both eyes?
transliteration: beeG-LAH poh bah kah-YOHNG nah-WAH-lahn ngah pah-NEEN sah ee-SAH oh pah-REH-hohng mah-TAH?
translation: Bigla po ba kayong nawalan ng paningin sa isa o parehong mata?

english: Did you suddenly lose your balance or coordination?
transliteration: beeG-LAH poh bah kah-YOHNG nah-WAH-lahn ngah bah-LAHN-seh oh koh-or-dee-NAH-syon?
translation: Bigla po ba kayong nawalan ng balanse o koordinasyon?

english: What time were you last completely well?
transliteration: ah-NOHNG oh-RAHS poh ahng HOO-ling pahg-kah-kah-TAH-ohhn nah loo-BOO-sahng kah-YOHNG mah-ah-YOHS ahng pah-kee-RAHM-dahm?
translation: Anong oras po ang huling pagkakataong lubos kayong maayos ang pakiramdam?

english: Did the symptoms go away completely?
transliteration: too-LOO-yahn poh bahng nah-WAH-lah ahng mahng simp-TOHMS?
translation: Tuluyan po bang nawala ang mga sintomas?

english: Did you have the worst headache of your life?
transliteration: nah-rah-NAH-sahn poh bah nee-NYOH ahng pinah-kah-MAH-tin-ding sah-KIT ngah OO-bohng boo-HAY nee-NYOH?
translation: Naranasan po ba ninyo ang pinakamatinding sakit ng ulo sa buong buhay ninyo?

english: Did the headache reach maximum intensity within seconds or a minute?
transliteration: oo-MAH-bot poh bah sah pinah-kah-MAH-lahks ngah TIN-dee ahng sah-KIT ngah OO-bohng ee-LOHM sah ee-LAHNG seh-GOON-doh oh ee-SAHNG mee-NOO-toh?
translation: Umabot po ba sa pinakamalakas na tindi ang sakit ng ulo sa loob ng ilang segundo o isang minuto?

english: Do you have a fever with a stiff neck?
transliteration: mahg-lah-GAHT poh bah kah-YOH aht nah-nee-nee-GAHS ahng LEH-eg?
translation: May lagnat po ba kayo at naninigas ang leeg?

english: Have you had a new seizure or lost consciousness?
transliteration: nah-gah-ROHN poh bah kah-YOH kah-MAH-ee-lahn ngah bee-BAH-roong kohm-BOOL-syon oh nah-WAH-lahn ngah mah-LAHY?
translation: Nagkaroon po ba kayo kamakailan ng bagong kombulsyon o nawalan ng malay?

english: Do you have new difficulty controlling your bladder or bowels?
transliteration: nah-hee-RAH-pahn poh bah kah-YOHNG kohnt-roh-LIN ahng pahg-ee-EE-hee oh pahg-EE-dah-MEE?
translation: Nahihirapan po ba kayong kontrolin ang pag-ihi o pagdumi?

english: Do you have numbness around your groin or buttocks?
transliteration: MAHN-nid poh bah ahng pah-lee-GEED ngah sing-GEET oh POO-tit nee-NYOH?
translation: Manhid po ba ang paligid ng singit o puwit ninyo?

english: Where exactly is your headache?
transliteration: sah-AHN poh MISM-oh ahng sah-KIT ngah OO-loh nee-NYOH?
translation: Saan po mismo ang sakit ng ulo ninyo?

english: Is the pain on one side or both sides of your head?
transliteration: nah-sah ee-SAHNG pah-NEEG poh bah oh mahg-ka-REE-bahng pah-NEEG ngah OO-loh nee-NYOH ahng sah-KIT?
translation: Nasa isang panig po ba o magkabilang panig ng ulo ninyo ang sakit?

english: Does the pain spread to your neck, face, or behind your eyes?
transliteration: koo-mah-KAH-lat poh bah ahng sah-KIT pah-PUN-tah sah LEH-eg, moo-KHAH, oh LAH-kohd ngah mahng mah-TAH nee-NYOH?
translation: Kumakalat po ba ang sakit papunta sa leeg, mukha, o likod ng mga mata ninyo?

english: Is the pain throbbing, pressing, stabbing, or burning?
transliteration: poo-mee-PINT-tig, doo-mee-DEEN, too-too-TOOK, oh pah-RAHNG nah-soo-SOO-nog poh bah ahng sah-KIT?
translation: Pumipintig, dumidiin, tumutusok, o parang nasusunog po ba ang sakit?

english: How severe is the pain from zero to ten?
transliteration: gah-AH-noh poh kah-TAHN-dee ahng sah-KIT moo-LAH seh-ROH sahng-GAHM-poo?
translation: Gaano po katindi ang sakit mula sero hanggang sampu?

english: Does light or noise bother you during the headache?
transliteration: nah-kah-kah-ah-BAH-lah poh bah sah ee-NYOH ahng lee-WAH-nah oh ee-NGAY hah-BAHNG mah-SAH-kit ahng OO-loh nee-NYOH?
translation: Nakakaabala po ba sa inyo ang liwanag o ingay habang masakit ang ulo ninyo?

english: Do you feel nauseated or vomit with the headache?
transliteration: nah-soo-SOO-kah poh bah kah-YOH oh ngah-SEE-soo-KAH kah-pahg mah-SAH-kit ahng OO-loh nee-NYOH?
translation: Nasusuka po ba kayo o nagsusuka kapag masakit ang ulo ninyo?

english: Do you see flashing lights or zigzag lines before the headache?
transliteration: mah-EYE nah-kee-KEE-tah poh bah kah-YOH ngah mahng koo-mee-KEES-lahp nah EE-lahw oh mahng lee-NYAHNG zigzag bah-goo mah-SAH-kit ahng OO-loh nee-NYOH?
translation: May nakikita po ba kayong mga kumikislap na ilaw o mga linyang zigzag bago sumakit ang ulo ninyo?

english: Does physical activity make the headache worse?
transliteration: loo-mah-LAH-kahs poh bah ahng sah-KIT ngah OO-loh kah-pahg koo-mee-KI-los oh nahg-ee-HEHR-see-syo kah-YOH?
translation: Lumalakas po ba ang sakit ng ulo kapag kumikilos o nag-eehersisyo kayo?

english: Does coughing, straining, or bending make it worse?
transliteration: loo-MAH-lah poh bah EE-toh kah-pahg oo-MOO-boh, oo-mee-EE-ree, oh yoo-MOO-koh kah-YOH?
translation: Lumalala po ba ito kapag umuubo, umiiri, o yumuyuko kayo?

english: Is the headache worse when lying down or standing up?
transliteration: mah-sah mah-SAH-kit poh bah ahng OO-loh nee-NYOH kah-pahg nah-hah-LAH-yahg oh nahk-tah-TAY-oh?
translation: Mas sumasakit po ba ang ulo ninyo kapag nakahiga o nakatayo?

english: Does the headache wake you from sleep?
transliteration: nah-gee-GEE-sing poh bah kah-YOH sah sah-KIT ngah OO-loh hah-BAHNG nah-too-TOO-log?
translation: Nagigising po ba kayo sa sakit ng ulo habang natutulog?

english: Have your headaches changed recently?
transliteration: nahg-bah-BAH-go poh bah kah-MAH-ee-lahn ahng pah-nah-nah-KIT ngah OO-loh nee-NYOH?
translation: Nagbago po ba kamakailan ang pananakit ng ulo ninyo?

english: How many days each month do you have a headache?
transliteration: ee-LAHNG dah-AHN poh bah pah-REE-hoh mah-SAH-kit ahng OO-loh nee-NYOH?
translation: Ilang araw po bawat buwan sumasakit ang ulo ninyo?

english: How often do you take painkillers for headaches?
transliteration: gah-AH-noh poh kah-dah-LAHS kah-YOH oo-mee-EE-nohm ngah gah-MOHT sah sah-KIT ngah OO-loh?
translation: Gaano po kadalas kayong umiinom ng gamot sa sakit ng ulo?

english: Do you feel the room spinning or do you feel faint?
transliteration: pah-kee-RAHM-dahm poh bah nee-NYOH eye oo-mee-EE-kot ahng pah-lee-GEED oh pah-RAHNG mah-hee-hee-MAH-tahy kah-YOH?
translation: Pakiramdam po ba ninyo ay umiikot ang paligid o parang mahihimatay kayo?

english: Do you feel unsteady when walking?
transliteration: nah-WAH-wah-lahn poh bah kah-YOH ngah bah-LAHN-seh kah-pahg nahg-lah-LAH-kahd?
translation: Nawawalan po ba kayo ng balanse kapag naglalakad?

english: Does turning your head trigger the dizziness?
transliteration: nahg-si-SIM-boo-lah poh bah ahng pahg-kah-HEE-loh kah-pahg ee-nee-EE-kot nee-NYOH ahng OO-loh?
translation: Nagsisimula po ba ang pagkahilo kapag iniikot ninyo ang ulo?

english: Does standing up trigger the dizziness?
transliteration: nahg-si-SIM-boo-lah poh bah ahng pahg-kah-HEE-loh kah-pahg too-mah-TAH-yoh kah-YOH?
translation: Nagsisimula po ba ang pagkahilo kapag tumatayo kayo?

english: Does the dizziness last seconds, minutes, hours, or longer?
transliteration: too-mah-TAH-gahl poh bah ahng pahg-kah-HEE-loh nahng EE-lahng seh-GOON-doh, EE-lahng mee-NOO-toh, EE-lahng OH-rahs, oh mahs mah-TAH-gahl?
translation: Tumatagal po ba ang pagkahilo nang ilang segundo, ilang minuto, ilang oras, o mas matagal?

english: Do you have ringing in your ears or hearing loss?
transliteration: mah-EYE oo-GOHNG poh bah sah tah-EE-ngah nee-NYOH oh nah-bah-WAHS ahng pahng-DEEN-ig nee-NYOH?
translation: May ugong po ba sa tainga ninyo o nabawasan ang pandinig ninyo?

english: Have you fallen because of the dizziness?
transliteration: nah-DAH-pah oh nah-HOO-log nah poh bah kah-YOH dah-HEEL sah pahg-kah-HEE-loh?
translation: Nadapa o nahulog na po ba kayo dahil sa pagkahilo?

english: Can you walk without assistance?
transliteration: nah-kah-kah-LAH-kahd poh bah kah-YOH nahng wah-LAHNG TOO-lohng?
translation: Nakakalakad po ba kayo nang walang tulong?

english: Do you feel weakness in your arms or legs?
transliteration: nahng-hee-HEE yah poh bah ahng mahng brAHS-oh oh bihn-TEE nee-NYOH?
translation: Nanghihina po ba ang mga braso o binti ninyo?

english: Is one side weaker than the other?
transliteration: mahs mah-HI-nah poh bah ahng ee-SAHNG pah-NEEG kah-SEE sah kah-BEE-lah?
translation: Mas mahina po ba ang isang panig kaysa sa kabila?

english: Do you have trouble lifting your arms above your head?
transliteration: nah-hee-RAH-pahn poh bah kah-YOHNG ee-TAH-ahs ahng mahng brAHS-oh nee-NYOH nahng lahm-PAHS sah OO-loh?
translation: Nahihirapan po ba kayong itaas ang mga braso ninyo nang lampas sa ulo?

english: Do you have trouble standing up from a chair?
transliteration: nah-hee-RAH-pahn poh bah kah-YOHNG too-MAH-yoh moo-LAH sah oo-POO-ahhn?
translation: Nahihirapan po ba kayong tumayo mula sa upuan?

english: Do you trip because your foot drags?
transliteration: nah-DAH-dah-pah poh bah kah-YOH dah-HEEL soo-mah-SAH-yahd sah sah-HEEG ahng pah-AH nee-NYOH?
translation: Nadadapa po ba kayo dahil sumasayad sa sahig ang paa ninyo?

english: Do you drop objects from your hands?
transliteration: nah-bee-BEE-tah-wahn poh bah nee-NYOH ahng mahng bah-GAY nah hah-HAK nee-NYOH?
translation: Nabibitawan po ba ninyo ang mga bagay na hawak ninyo?

english: Does the weakness get worse with repeated activity?
transliteration: loo-mah-LAH-kahs poh bah ahng pah-ngih-HEE-nah kah-pahg pah-ree-OOO-lit kah-YOHNG koo-mee-KI-los?
translation: Lumalakas po ba ang panghihina kapag paulit-ulit kayong kumikilos?

english: Does resting improve the weakness?
transliteration: goo-mee-GIN-hah-wah poh bah ahng pah-ngih-HEE-nah kah-pahg nahg-pah-pah-HEE-rah-ngah kah-YOH?
translation: Gumiginhawa po ba ang panghihina kapag nagpapahinga kayo?

english: Have you noticed muscle twitching or cramps?
transliteration: nah-pahn-SIN poh bah nee-NYOH nah koo-mee-KEE-bot ahng mahng kah-LAH-mooos nee-NYOH oh nahg-kah-ROON kah-YOH ngah poo-LEE-kat?
translation: Napansin po ba ninyo na kumikibot ang mga kalamnan ninyo o nagkakaroon kayo ng pulikat?

english: Have your muscles become smaller over time?
transliteration: nah-pahn-SIN poh bah nee-NYOH nah loo-mee-LEE-it ahng mahng kah-LAH-mooos nee-NYOH hah-BAHNG too-mah-TAH-gahl?
translation: Napansin po ba ninyo na lumiliit ang mga kalamnan ninyo habang tumatagal?

english: Do you have numbness or tingling anywhere?
transliteration: mah-EYE pah-mah-MAH-nid oh pah-ning-EE-lig poh bah kah-YOH sah-AHN-mahn sah kah-TOO-wahn?
translation: May pamamanhid o pangingilig po ba kayo saanman sa katawan?

english: Where does the numbness begin and where does it spread?
transliteration: sah-AHN poh nahg-si-SIM-boo-lah ahng pah-mah-MAH-nid aht sah-AHN EE-toh koo-mah-KAH-lat?
translation: Saan po nagsisimula ang pamamanhid at saan ito kumakalat?

english: Is the numbness in both hands or both feet?
transliteration: pah-REE-hoh poh bahng mah-NAN-nid ahng dah-LAH-wahng kah-MAY oh dah-LAH-wahng pah-AH nee-NYOH?
translation: Pareho po bang manhid ang dalawang kamay o dalawang paa ninyo?

english: Do you feel burning or electric-shock-like pain?
transliteration: pah-RAHNG nah-soo-SOO-nog poh bah oh pah-RAHNG nah-koo-koo-REE-yehn-teh ahng sah-KIT?
translation: Parang nasusunog po ba o parang nakukuryente ang sakit?

english: Does the pain travel from your back down your leg?
transliteration: koo-mah-KAH-lat poh bah ahng sah-KIT moo-LAH sah lee-KOHD pah-BAH-bah sah bihn-TEE nee-NYOH?
translation: Kumakalat po ba ang sakit mula sa likod pababa sa binti ninyo?

english: Can you feel hot and cold normally?
transliteration: nor-MAHL poh bah ahng pah-kee-RAHM-dahm nee-NYOH sah ah-NEET aht lah-MEET?
translation: Normal po ba ang pakiramdam ninyo sa init at lamig?

english: Does touching the skin cause unusual pain?
transliteration: nahg-doo-DOO-loht poh bah ngah kah-ee-BAHNG sah-KIT kah-pahg heen-hah-hah-WAHK ahng bah-LIT nee-NYOH?
translation: Nagdudulot po ba ng kakaibang sakit kapag hinahawakan ang balat ninyo?

english: Have you ever had a seizure or fit?
transliteration: nah-gah-ROHN nah poh bah kah-YOH ngah kohm-BOOL-syon oh pah-ning-ee-SAY?
translation: Nagkaroon na po ba kayo ng kombulsyon o pangingisay?

english: Did anyone see what happened during the episode?
transliteration: mah-EYE nah-kah-KEE-tah poh bah sah nah-yah-REE nahh-TEE-kah kah-YOH?
translation: May nakakita po ba sa nangyari noong inatake kayo?

english: Did your arms or legs shake uncontrollably?
transliteration: nah-nging-ee-NIG poh bah nahng HEEN-dee mah-pee-GEE-lahn ahng mahng brAHS-oh oh bihn-TEE nee-NYOH?
translation: Nanginginig po ba nang hindi mapigilan ang mga braso o binti ninyo?

english: Did you lose awareness of your surroundings?
transliteration: heen-DEE poh bah nee-NYOH mahm-ya-LAH mahng mahng-yah-YAH-ree sah pah-lee-GEED nee-NYOH?
translation: Hindi po ba ninyo namalayan ang mga nangyayari sa paligid ninyo?

english: Did you bite your tongue?
transliteration: nah-kah-GAT poh bah nee-NYOH ahng DHEE-lah nee-NYOH?
translation: Nakagat po ba ninyo ang dila ninyo?

english: Did you lose control of your bladder?
transliteration: nah-WAH-lahn poh bah kah-YOH ngah kohnt-ROHL sah pahg-ee-EE-hee?
translation: Nawalan po ba kayo ng kontrol sa pag-ihi?

english: Were you confused or sleepy afterward?
transliteration: nah-LEE-loo oh ee-nahn-TOHK poh bah kah-YOH pahg-kah-TEH-lahk?
translation: Nalito o inantok po ba kayo pagkatapos?

english: Did you notice a strange smell, feeling, or warning before the episode?
transliteration: mah-EYE nah-ah-MOY poh bah kah-YOH ngah kah-ee-BAH ngah pah-kee-RAHM-dahm, oh mah-EYE kah-ee-BAH poh kah-YOHNG nah-rah-MAH-dahn, oh mah-EYE bah-WAH-lah poh bah kah-goo nah-rah-TAHK?
translation: May naamoy po ba kayong kakaiba, may kakaiba po ba kayong naramdaman, o may babala po ba bago kayo inatake?

english: How long did it take to return to normal?
transliteration: gah-AH-noh poh kah-TAH-gahl bah-goo kah-YOH bah-MAH-lik sah bah-TAH?
translation: Gaano po katagal bago kayo bumalik sa dati?

english: Have you missed any doses of your seizure medicine?
transliteration: mah-EYE mahng DOH-sis poh bah ngah gah-MOHT nee-NYOH pah-rah sah kohm-BOOL-syon nah heen-DEE nee-NYOH nah-EE-nohm?
translation: May mga dosis po ba ng gamot ninyo para sa kombulsyon na hindi ninyo nainom?

english: Do your hands shake when resting or when using them?
transliteration: nah-nging-ee-NIG poh bah ahng mahng kah-MAY nee-NYOH kah-pahg nahg-pah-pah-HEE-rah-ngah oh gee-NAH-gah-MIT ahng mahng EE-toh?
translation: Nanginginig po ba ang mga kamay ninyo kapag nagpapahinga o ginagamit ang mga ito?

english: Does the shaking affect one hand or both?
transliteration: ee-SAHNG kah-MAY lahng poh bah oh pah-REE-hohng kah-MAY ahng nah-nging-ee-NIG?
translation: Isang kamay lang po ba o parehong kamay ang nanginginig?

english: Has your handwriting become smaller?
transliteration: nah-gee-GEE mah-HI-nah poh bah ahng soo-LAHT-KAH-may nee-NYOH?
translation: Naging mas maliit po ba ang sulat-kamay ninyo?

english: Do you feel stiff or move more slowly?
transliteration: nah-nee-NEE-gahs poh bah ahng kah-TOO-wahn nee-NYOH oh mahs ma-bah-LOH kah-YOHNG koo-MEE-kilos?
translation: Naninigas po ba ang katawan ninyo o mas mabagal kayong kumilos?

english: Have you had difficulty starting to walk?
transliteration: nah-hee-RAH-pahn nah poh bah kah-YOHNG mahg-si-MOO-lahng mahg-lah-LAH-kahd?
translation: Nahirapan na po ba kayong magsimulang maglakad?

english: Do you freeze or feel stuck while walking?
transliteration: nah-TEE-tig-EE-lah poh bah kah-YOH oh pah-RAHNG heen-DEE mah-kah-KI-los hah-BAHNG nahg-lah-LAH-kahd?
translation: Natitigil po ba kayo o parang hindi makakilos habang naglalakad?

english: Have you noticed changes in your voice or facial expression?
transliteration: nah-pahn-SIN poh bah nee-NYOH ahng pahg-bah-BAH-go sah bohs oh eksp-reh-SYON ngah moo-KHAH nee-NYOH?
translation: Napansin po ba ninyo ang pagbabago sa boses o ekspresyon ng mukha ninyo?

english: Have you been forgetting recent conversations or appointments?
transliteration: nah-kah-kah-lim-OO-tahn poh bah nee-NYOH kah-MAH-ee-lahn ahng mahng nah-pahg-ooos-AH-pahn oh mahng tee-PAH-nahn?
translation: Nakakalimutan po ba ninyo kamakailan ang mga napag-usapan o mga tipanan?

english: Do you have trouble finding the right words?
transliteration: nah-hee-RAH-pahn poh bah kah-YOHNG hah-nehh-NIN ahng tah-MAHNG mahng sah-LEE-tah?
translation: Nahihirapan po ba kayong hanapin ang tamang mga salita?

english: Have you become lost in familiar places?
transliteration: nah-LEE-lee-gahw poh bah kah-YOH sah mahng loh-GAHR nah pah-MEE-lahr sah ee-NYOH?
translation: Naliligaw po ba kayo sa mga lugar na pamilyar sa inyo?

english: Do you have difficulty managing medicines or finances?
transliteration: nah-hee-RAH-pahn poh bah kah-YOHNG ah-see-KAH-soo-hin ahng mahng gah-MOHT oh PEH-rah nee-NYOH?
translation: Nahihirapan po ba kayong asikasuhin ang mga gamot o pera ninyo?

english: Have you noticed changes in your mood or behaviour?
transliteration: nah-pahn-SIN poh bah nee-NYOH ahng pahg-bah-BAH-go sah ee-NYOHNG mood oh pahg-oo-oo-GAH-lee?
translation: Napansin po ba ninyo ang pagbabago sa inyong mood o pag-uugali?

english: Do you have trouble concentrating?
transliteration: nah-hee-RAH-pahn poh bah kah-YOHNG mahg-POH-koos?
translation: Nahihirapan po ba kayong magpokus?

english: Has your speech become slurred?
transliteration: pah-RAHNG boo-LOHL poh bah ahng pahg-sah-LEE-tah nee-NYOH?
translation: Parang bulol po ba ang pagsasalita ninyo?

english: Do you have trouble swallowing food or liquids?
transliteration: nah-hee-RAH-pahn poh bah kah-YOHNG loo-MOH-nohg ngah pahg-KAH-een oh ee-NOO-min?
translation: Nahihirapan po ba kayong lumunok ng pagkain o inumin?

english: Do you see double?
transliteration: doh-BLEH poh bah ahng nah-KEE-kee-tah nee-NYOH?
translation: Doble po ba ang nakikita ninyo?

english: Does the double vision go away when you cover one eye?
transliteration: nah-WAH-wah-lah poh bah ahng doh-BLEHNG pah-NEEN kah-pahg tee-nah-TAH-kahn nee-NYOH ahng ee-SAHNG mah-TAH?
translation: Nawawala po ba ang dobleng paningin kapag tinatakpan ninyo ang isang mata?

english: Have you noticed a drooping eyelid?
transliteration: nah-pahn-SIN poh bah nee-NYOH nah nah-kah-LAY-lahy ahng tah-LOO-kahp ngah mah-TAH nee-NYOH?
translation: Napansin po ba ninyo na nakalaylay ang talukap ng mata ninyo?

english: Do you have numbness or pain in your face?
transliteration: nah-mah-MAH-nid oh soo-MAH-kit poh bah ahng moo-KHAH nee-NYOH?
translation: Namamanhid o sumasakit po ba ang mukha ninyo?

english: Have you noticed weakness on one side of your face?
transliteration: nah-pahn-SIN poh bah nee-NYOH nah nah-ngih-HEE yah ahng ee-SAHNG pah-NEEG ngah moo-KHAH nee-NYOH?
translation: Napansin po ba ninyo na nanghihina ang isang panig ng mukha ninyo?

english: Have you noticed changes in your hearing?
transliteration: nah-pahn-SIN poh bah nee-NYOH ahng pahg-bah-BAH-go sah pahng-DEEN-ig nee-NYOH?
translation: Napansin po ba ninyo ang pagbabago sa pandinig ninyo?

english: Do you choke or cough when swallowing?
transliteration: nah-sah-MEED oh oo-MOO-boh poh bah kah-YOH kah-pahg loo-MOO-nohg?
translation: Nasasamid o umuubo po ba kayo kapag lumulunok?

english: Have you ever had a stroke or a mini-stroke?
transliteration: nah-gah-ROHN nah poh bah kah-YOH ngah stroke oh mini-stroke?
translation: Nagkaroon na po ba kayo ng stroke o mini-stroke?

english: Have you ever had a head injury or concussion?
transliteration: nah-gah-ROHN nah poh bah kah-YOH ngah peen-SAH-lah sah OO-loh oh pahg-kah-oon-TOHG?
translation: Nagkaroon na po ba kayo ng pinsala sa ulo o pagkauntog?

english: Have you ever had meningitis or a brain infection?
transliteration: nah-gah-ROHN nah poh bah kah-YOH ngah men-in-JAI-tis oh im-pehk-SYON sah OO-tahk?
translation: Nagkaroon na po ba kayo ng meningitis o impeksiyon sa utak?

english: Do you have diabetes, high blood pressure, or high cholesterol?
transliteration: mah-EYE dee-ah-BEE-tis, ahl-tah-preh-SYON, oh mah-TAH-ahs nah koh-lehs-TEH-rohl poh bah kah-YOH?
translation: May diabetes, altapresyon, o mataas na kolesterol po ba kayo?

english: Does anyone in your family have migraines, seizures, or a neurological condition?
transliteration: mah-EYE kah-pahm-EE-lyah poh bahng may my-GRAYN, kohm-BOOL-syon, oh sah-KIT sah ner-BEE-yohs?
translation: May kapamilya po ba kayong may migraine, kombulsyon, o sakit sa nerbiyos?

english: What medicines do you take regularly?
transliteration: ah-NOHNG mahng gah-MOHT poh ahng reh-goo-LAHR nee-NYOHNG ee-nee-EE-nohm?
translation: Anong mga gamot po ang regular ninyong iniinom?

english: What is the name and dose of your seizure medicine?
transliteration: ah-NOH poh ahng pah-nga-LAHN aht DOH-sis ngah gah-MOHT nee-NYOH pah-rah sah kohm-BOOL-syon?
translation: Ano po ang pangalan at dosis ng gamot ninyo para sa kombulsyon?

english: How long have you been taking this medicine?
transliteration: gah-AH-noh nah poh kah-YOH kah-TAH-gahl oo-mee-EE-nohm ngah gah-MOHT nah EE-toh?
translation: Gaano na po kayo katagal umiinom ng gamot na ito?

english: Have you recently started, stopped, or changed a medicine?
transliteration: mah-EYE see-nee-MOO-lahn, ee-tee-NEE-gil, oh bee-NAH-go poh bah kah-YOHNG gah-MOHT kah-MAH-ee-lahn?
translation: May sinimulan, itinigil, o binago po ba kayong gamot kamakailan?

english: Has this medicine helped your symptoms?
transliteration: nah-kah-TOO-lohng poh bah ahng gah-MOHT nah EE-toh sah mahng simp-TOHMS nee-NYOH?
translation: Nakatulong po ba ang gamot na ito sa mga sintomas ninyo?

english: Have you noticed any side effects?
transliteration: mah-EYE nah-pahn-SIN poh bah kah-YOH ngah ah-NOO-mahng side eh-FEKT?
translation: May napansin po ba kayong anumang side effect?

english: Do you drink alcohol or use recreational drugs?
transliteration: oo-mee-EE-nohm poh bah kah-YOH ngah ah-LAHK oh goo-mah-GAH-mit ngah mahng DROH-gah pah-rah mahg-lee-BAHNG?
translation: Umiinom po ba kayo ng alak o gumagamit ng mga droga para maglibang?

english: Can you tell me your full name?
transliteration: mah-ah-REE poh bahng sah-BEE-hin nee-NYOH sah ah-KOH ahng boo-OHNG pah-nga-LAHN nee-NYOH?
translation: Maaari po bang sabihin ninyo sa akin ang buong pangalan ninyo?

english: Can you tell me today's date?
transliteration: mah-ah-REE poh bahng sah-BEE-hin nee-NYOH sah ah-KOH ahng PET-sah ngah-YOHN?
translation: Maaari po bang sabihin ninyo sa akin ang petsa ngayon?

english: Can you tell me where we are right now?
transliteration: mah-ah-REE poh bahng sah-BEE-hin nee-NYOH kung nah-sah-AHN tah-YOH ngah-YOHN?
translation: Maaari po bang sabihin ninyo kung nasaan tayo ngayon?

english: Please repeat these three words after me.
transliteration: pah-kee-soo-NOHD poh ah-KOH sah pahg-oo-OO-lit ngah tah-TLOHNG sah-LEE-tahng EE-toh.
translation: Pakisundan po ako sa pag-uulit ng tatlong salitang ito.

english: Please remember these words; I will ask you again later.
transliteration: pah-kee-ah-LAH-lah poh ahng mahng sah-LEE-tahng EE-toh; tah-tah-NOHNG-in koh poh kah-YOH oo-LEET mah-YAH.
translation: Pakialala po ang mga salitang ito; tatanungin ko po kayo ulit mamaya.

english: Please name this object.
transliteration: pah-kee-pah-nga-LAH-nahn poh ahng bah-GAY nah EE-toh.
translation: Pakipangalanan po ang bagay na ito.

english: Please follow this two-step instruction.
transliteration: pah-kee-SOO-nohd poh ahng dah-LAH-wahng hahng-KAHHNG uh-TOHS nah EE-toh.
translation: Pakisunod po ang dalawang hakbang na utos na ito.

english: Please read this sentence aloud.
transliteration: pah-kee-RAHD poh nahng mah-LAH-kahs ahng pahng-ooong-ooos-AHP nah EE-toh.
translation: Pakibasa po nang malakas ang pangungusap na ito.

english: Please write a complete sentence.
transliteration: pah-kee-SOO-lat poh ngah ee-SAHNG boo-OHNG sahn-teen-syah.
translation: Pakisulat po ang isang buong pangungusap.

english: Please copy this drawing.
transliteration: pah-kee-koh-PYAH poh ahng lah-RAH-wahn nah EE-toh.
translation: Pakikopya po ang larawang ito.

english: I am going to check your eye movements and facial muscles.
transliteration: soo-soo-REE-in koh poh ahng gah-LAW ngah mahng mah-TAH aht kah-LAH-mooos ngah moo-KHAH nee-NYOH.
translation: Susuriin ko po ang galaw ng mga mata at kalamnan ng mukha ninyo.

english: Please look straight ahead.
transliteration: too-MEE-ngin poh kah-YOH nahng deh-REHT-soh sah hah-RAHP.
translation: Tumingin po kayo nang diretso sa harap.

english: Follow my finger with your eyes without moving your head.
transliteration: soo-NDAHN poh ngah mahng mah-TAH nee-NYOH ahng dah-HEE-lee koh nahng heen-DEE gee-nee-GAH-wahn ahng OO-loh.
translation: Sundan po ng mga mata ninyo ang daliri ko nang hindi ginagalaw ang ulo.

english: Please cover one eye.
transliteration: tah-KAH-pahn poh nee-NYOH ahng ee-SAHNG mah-TAH.
translation: Takpan po ninyo ang isang mata.

english: Tell me when you can see my moving finger.
transliteration: sah-BEE-hin poh nee-NYOH sah ah-KOH kah-pahg nah-KEE-kee-tah nah ahng goo-mah-GAH-lahw kohng dah-HEE-lee.
translation: Sabihin po ninyo sa akin kapag nakikita na ninyo ang gumagalaw kong daliri.

english: I am going to shine a light into your eyes.
transliteration: see-see-NDAH-hahn koh poh ngah ee-LAHW ahng mahng mah-TAH nee-NYOH.
translation: Sisindihan ko po ng ilaw ang mga mata ninyo.

english: Please raise your eyebrows.
transliteration: pah-kee-TAH-ahs poh ahng mahng kee-LAHY nee-NYOH.
translation: Pakitaas po ang mga kilay ninyo.

english: Please close your eyes tightly.
transliteration: ee-PEE-kit poh nee-NYOH nahng mah-REE-in ahng mahng mah-TAH nee-NYOH.
translation: Ipikit po ninyo nang mariin ang mga mata ninyo.

english: Please smile and show your teeth.
transliteration: ngoo-MEE-tee poh kah-YOH aht ee-PAH-kee-tah ahng mahng NGEE-pin nee-NYOH.
translation: Ngumiti po kayo at ipakita ang mga ngipin ninyo.

english: Please puff out your cheeks.
transliteration: pah-hah-ngih-NAHN poh nee-NYOH ahng mahng pee-SHING nee-NYOH.
translation: Pahanginan po ninyo ang mga pisngi ninyo.

english: Does this feel the same on both sides of your face?
transliteration: pah-REE-hoh poh bah ahng pah-kee-RAHM-dahm nah EE-toh sah mahg-kaa-REE-bahng pah-NEEG ngah moo-KHAH nee-NYOH?
translation: Pareho po ba ang pakiramdam nito sa magkabilang panig ng mukha ninyo?

english: Please open your mouth and say ah.
transliteration: pah-kee-BOO-kah poh ahng bee-BEEG aht sah-BEE-hin ahng ah.
translation: Pakibuka po ang bibig at sabihin ang “ah.”

english: Please stick out your tongue.
transliteration: ee-LAH-bas poh nee-NYOH ahng DHEE-lah nee-NYOH.
translation: Ilabas po ninyo ang dila ninyo.

english: Please shrug your shoulders against my hands.
transliteration: ee-TAH-ahs poh nee-NYOH ahng mahng bah-LEE-kAHT nee-NYOH lah-BAHN sah mahng kah-MAY koh.
translation: Itaas po ninyo ang mga balikat ninyo laban sa mga kamay ko.

english: Please turn your head against my hand.
transliteration: ee-LEENG poh nee-NYOH ahng OO-loh lah-BAHN sah mahng kah-MAY koh.
translation: Iling po ninyo ang ulo laban sa kamay ko.

english: Please hold both arms straight out in front of you.
transliteration: pa-ki-ha-RAP nang tu-WID ang da-la-WANG bra-SO sa ha-RAP nin-YO
translation: Pakiharap nang tuwid ang dalawang braso sa harap ninyo.

english: Turn your palms upward and close your eyes.
transliteration: i-ha-RAP pa-i-TAAS ang mga pa-LAD nin-YO at i-pi-KIT ang mga MA-ta
translation: Iharap paitaas ang mga palad ninyo at ipikit ang mga mata.

english: Please squeeze my fingers.
transliteration: pa-ki-PI-sil ang mga da-LI-ri ko
translation: Pakipisil ang mga daliri ko.

english: Please push against my hand.
transliteration: pa-ki-TU-lak ang ka-MAY ko
translation: Pakitulak ang kamay ko.

english: Please pull against my hand.
transliteration: pa-ki-HI-la ang ka-MAY ko
translation: Pakihila ang kamay ko.

english: Please lift your leg off the bed.
transliteration: pa-ki-TAAS ang BIN-ti nin-YO mu-LA sa ka-MA
translation: Pakitaas ang binti ninyo mula sa kama.

english: Please bend your knee.
transliteration: pa-ki-ba-LUK-tot ang TU-hod nin-YO
translation: Pakibaluktot ang tuhod ninyo.

english: Please straighten your knee.
transliteration: pa-ka-TU-wid ng TU-hod nin-YO
translation: Pakatuwid ng tuhod ninyo.

english: Please pull your toes up toward your head.
transliteration: hi-LA-hin pa-TAAS ang mga da-LI-ri ng PA-a nin-YO pa-PUN-ta sa U-lo nin-YO
translation: Hilahin pataas ang mga daliri ng paa ninyo papunta sa ulo ninyo.

english: Please push your foot down like pressing a pedal.
transliteration: i-TU-lak pa-BA-wa ang PA-a nin-YO na pa-RANG pu-mi-PIN-dot ng PE-dal
translation: Itulak pababa ang paa ninyo na parang pumipindot ng pedal.

english: Please relax while I move your arm.
transliteration: pa-ki-re-LAKS ha-BANG i-gi-na-GA-law ko ang bra-SO nin-YO
translation: Paki-relaks habang iginagalaw ko ang braso ninyo.

english: Please close your eyes while I check your sensation.
transliteration: i-pi-KIT ang mga MA-ta nin-YO ha-BANG si-nu-SU-ri ko ang pa-KI-ram-dam nin-YO
translation: Ipikit ang mga mata ninyo habang sinusuri ko ang pakiramdam ninyo.

english: Can you feel me touching you here?
transliteration: na-ra-ram-DA-man ba nin-YO ka-PAG hi-na-ha-WA-kan ko KA-yo ri-TO
translation: Nararamdaman ba ninyo kapag hinahawakan ko kayo rito?

english: Does it feel the same on the left and right?
transliteration: mag-ka-pa-RE-ho ba ang pa-KI-ram-dam sa ka-LI-wa at ka-NAN
translation: Magkapareho ba ang pakiramdam sa kaliwa at kanan?

english: Tell me whether this feels sharp or dull.
transliteration: sa-BI-hin nin-YO kung ma-TA-lim o ma-PU-rol ang pa-KI-ram-dam ni-TO
translation: Sabihin ninyo kung matalim o mapurol ang pakiramdam nito.

english: Tell me whether this feels warm or cold.
transliteration: sa-BI-hin nin-YO kung ma-I-nit o ma-LA-mig ang pa-KI-ram-dam ni-TO
translation: Sabihin ninyo kung mainit o malamig ang pakiramdam nito.

english: Tell me which way I move your finger or toe.
transliteration: sa-BI-hin nin-YO kung sa-ANG di-rek-SI-yon ko gi-na-GA-law ang da-LI-ri ng ka-MAY o PA-a nin-YO
translation: Sabihin ninyo kung saang direksiyon ko ginagalaw ang daliri ng kamay o paa ninyo.

english: I am going to tap your knee gently to check your reflexes.
transliteration: ma-RA-han kong ta-ta-PI-tin ang TU-hod nin-YO pa-RA su-RI-in ang mga re-FLEKS nin-YO
translation: Marahan kong tatapikin ang tuhod ninyo para suriin ang mga reflex ninyo.

english: Please let your arm or leg relax.
transliteration: pa-ki-re-LAKS ang bra-SO o BIN-ti nin-YO
translation: Paki-relaks ang braso o binti ninyo.

english: Please touch your nose and then my finger.
transliteration: pa-ki-ha-WA-kan ang i-LONG nin-YO pag-ka-TA-pos ay ang da-LI-ri ko
translation: Pakihawakan ang ilong ninyo, pagkatapos ay ang daliri ko.

english: Please do that again a little faster.
transliteration: pa-ki-GA-win u-LIT i-YON nang me-DYO mas ma-BI-lis
translation: Pakigawin ulit iyon nang medyo mas mabilis.

english: Please tap your hands on your thighs, turning them over quickly.
transliteration: pa-ki-pa-LAK-pak ang mga ka-MAY nin-YO sa mga HI-ta nin-YO at ma-BI-lis na pag-pa-li-TIN ang ha-RAP at LI-kod ng mga ka-MAY
translation: Pakipalakpak ang mga kamay ninyo sa mga hita ninyo, at mabilis na pagpalitin ang harap at likod ng mga kamay.

english: Please slide your heel down your other shin.
transliteration: i-pa-DU-las ang sa-KONG nin-YO pa-BA-wa sa ka-BI-ling lu-LOD nin-YO
translation: Ipadulas ang sakong ninyo pababa sa kabilang lulod ninyo.

english: Please stand with your feet together.
transliteration: tu-MA-yo nang mag-ka-di-KIT ang mga PA-a nin-YO
translation: Tumayo nang magkadikit ang mga paa ninyo.

english: Please close your eyes while standing; I will stay beside you.
transliteration: i-pi-KIT ang mga MA-ta nin-YO ha-BANG na-ka-TA-yo ma-na-na-TI-li a-KO sa ta-BI nin-YO
translation: Ipikit ang mga mata ninyo habang nakatayo; mananatili ako sa tabi ninyo.

english: Please walk across the room and back.
transliteration: mag-LA-kad KA-yo pa-TA-wid ng si-LID at pa-BA-lik
translation: Maglakad kayo patawid ng silid at pabalik.

english: Please walk heel to toe in a straight line.
transliteration: mag-LA-kad KA-yo nang tu-WID mag-ka-di-KIT ang sa-KONG at mga da-LI-ri ng PA-a
translation: Maglakad kayo nang tuwid, magkadikit ang sakong at mga daliri ng paa.

english: Please walk on your heels.
transliteration: mag-LA-kad KA-yo ga-MIT ang mga sa-KONG nin-YO
translation: Maglakad kayo gamit ang mga sakong ninyo.

english: Please walk on your toes.
transliteration: mag-LA-kad KA-yo ga-MIT ang mga da-LI-ri ng PA-a nin-YO
translation: Maglakad kayo gamit ang mga daliri ng paa ninyo.

english: Please turn around and walk back.
transliteration: pu-MI-hit KA-yo at mag-LA-kad pa-BA-lik
translation: Pumihit kayo at maglakad pabalik.

english: We may need a CT scan of your head.
transliteration: ma-a-A-ring kai-LANG-an na-TIN ng si-TI scan ng U-lo nin-YO
translation: Maaaring kailanganin natin ng CT scan ng ulo ninyo.

english: We may need an MRI scan of your brain or spine.
transliteration: ma-a-A-ring kai-LANG-an na-TIN ng em-ar-ay scan ng U-tak o gu-LO-dan nin-YO
translation: Maaaring kailanganin natin ng MRI scan ng utak o gulugod ninyo.

english: An EEG records the electrical activity of your brain.
transliteration: i-ni-ta-TA-la ng i-i-DI ang e-lek-tri-KAL na ak-ti-bi-DAD ng U-tak nin-YO
translation: Itinatala ng EEG ang elektrikal na aktibidad ng utak ninyo.

english: A nerve conduction study checks how your nerves send signals.
transliteration: si-nu-SU-ri ng NERV con-DUK-shun stu-DI kung PA-a-no nag-pa-pa-DA-la ng mga sen-YAS ang mga U-gat nin-YO
translation: Sinusuri ng nerve conduction study kung paano nagpapadala ng mga senyas ang mga ugat ninyo.

english: A lumbar puncture takes a small sample of fluid from your lower back.
transliteration: ku-ku-HA ang LUM-bar PUNK-chur ng ka-UN-ting li-KI-do mu-LA sa i-ba-BANG ba-HA-gi ng li-KOD nin-YO
translation: Kukuha ang lumbar puncture ng kaunting likido mula sa ibabang bahagi ng likod ninyo.

english: I will explain the benefits and risks before any procedure.
transliteration: i-pa-pa-li-WA-nag ko ang mga ben-E-pis-yo at pa-NI-bag bi-BI-fore ang a-NO mang pa-ma-MA-ra-an
translation: Ipapaliwanag ko ang mga benepisyo at panganib bago ang anumang pamamaraan.

english: Do you have any questions before we proceed?
transliteration: may mga ta-NONG ba KA-yo bi-fore ta-YO mag-pa-TU-loy
translation: May mga tanong ba kayo bago tayo magpatuloy?

english: We will discuss the results and next steps with you.
transliteration: pag-u-u-SA-pan na-TIN ang mga re-SUL-ta at su-SU-nod na HAK-bang ka-SA-ma KA-yo
translation: Pag-uusapan natin ang mga resulta at susunod na hakbang kasama kayo.

english: Please take your medicines exactly as prescribed.
transliteration: i-NU-min nin-YO ang mga ga-MOT a-YON na a-YON sa re-SE-ta
translation: Inumin ninyo ang mga gamot ayon na ayon sa reseta.

english: Do not stop seizure medicines suddenly without medical advice.
transliteration: hu-WAG big-LANG i-TI-gil ang mga ga-MOT pa-RA sa SI-zher nang wa-LANG pa-YO ng dok-TOR
translation: Huwag biglang itigil ang mga gamot para sa seizure nang walang payo ng doktor.

english: Seek emergency care for sudden weakness, trouble speaking, or a severe sudden headache.
transliteration: mag-PUN-ta a-GAD sa i-MER-jen-si kung big-LANG KA-yong mang-HI-na ma-hi-RA-pang mag-sa-LI-ta o su-MA-kit nang ma-TIN-di at big-LANG ang U-lo
translation: Magpunta agad sa emergency kung bigla kayong manghina, mahirapang magsalita, o sumakit nang matindi at biglaan ang ulo.

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: mag-a-A-yos KA-mi ng FOL-low-up na a-POINT-ment
translation: Mag-aayos kami ng follow-up na appointment.

english: What questions do you have for me?
transliteration: a-NO ang mga ta-NONG nin-YO sa a-KIN
translation: Ano ang mga tanong ninyo sa akin?

english: Hello. I am here to examine your eyes.
transliteration: ku-MUS-ta po nan-di-TO a-KO pa-RA su-RI-in ang mga MA-ta nin-YO
translation: Kumusta po. Nandito ako para suriin ang mga mata ninyo.

english: What brings you in today?
transliteration: a-NO po ang da-Hi-lan ng pag-PUN-ta nin-YO ri-TO nga-YON
translation: Ano po ang dahilan ng pagpunta ninyo rito ngayon?

english: Please sit here.
transliteration: ma-U-po po KA-yo ri-TO
translation: Maupo po kayo rito.

english: Which eye is bothering you?
transliteration: a-LING MA-ta po ang may prob-LE-ma
translation: Aling mata po ang may problema?

english: Is it one eye or both eyes?
transliteration: i-SA po ba o pa-re-HONG MA-ta
translation: Isa po ba o parehong mata?

english: When did the problem start?
transliteration: ka-I-lan po nag-si-MU-la ang prob-LE-ma
translation: Kailan po nagsimula ang problema?

english: May I examine your eyes?
transliteration: ma-a-A-ri ko po bang su-RI-in ang mga MA-ta nin-YO
translation: Maaari ko po bang suriin ang mga mata ninyo?

english: Please tell me if anything hurts.
transliteration: sa-BI-hin po nin-YO sa a-KIN kung may ma-SA-kit
translation: Sabihin po ninyo sa akin kung may masakit.

english: How long has this been happening?
transliteration: ga-A-no na po i-TO ka-ta-LAG nang nang-ya-YA-ri
translation: Gaano na po ito katagal nang nangyayari?

english: How many days has this been happening?
transliteration: i-LANG a-RAW na po i-TOng nang-ya-YA-ri
translation: Ilang araw na po itong nangyayari?

english: Did it start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: big-LA-an po ba i-TONG nag-si-MU-la o un-ti-un-TI
translation: Biglaan po ba itong nagsimula o unti-unti?

english: Is it constant, or does it come and go?
transliteration: tu-LOY-tu-LOY po ba i-TO o na-wa-WA-la at bu-ma-BA-lik
translation: Tuloy-tuloy po ba ito, o nawawala at bumabalik?

english: How long does each episode last?
transliteration: ga-A-no po ka-TAG-al ang ba-WAT pag-a-TA-ke
translation: Gaano po katagal ang bawat pag-atake?

english: Does it last seconds, minutes, hours, or days?
transliteration: tu-ma-TA-gal po ba i-TO nang i-LANG se-GUN-do mi-NU-to O-ras o a-RAW
translation: Tumatagal po ba ito nang ilang segundo, minuto, oras, o araw?

english: Is it getting better, worse, or staying the same?
