transliteration: mas su-MA-sa-kit po ba ka-pag u-mu-U-bo o bu-ma-BA-hing ka-YO?
translation: Mas sumasakit po ba kapag umuubo o bumabahing kayo?

english: Is bending forward or backward painful?
transliteration: ma-SA-kit po ba ka-pag yu-mu-YU-ko pa-su-LONG o pa-A-tras?
translation: Masakit po ba kapag yumuyuko pasulong o paatras?

english: Have you had a slipped or herniated disc before?
transliteration: nag-ka-RO-on na po ba ka-YO da-TI ng na-du-LAS o LUS-los na disc sa gu-LO-dog?
translation: Nagkaroon na po ba kayo dati ng nadulas o luslos na disc sa gulugod?

english: Have you had back surgery before?
transliteration: na-o-pe-RA-han na po ba ka-YO da-TI sa LI-kod?
translation: Naoperahan na po ba kayo dati sa likod?

english: Does your shoulder hurt?
transliteration: ma-SA-kit po ba ang ba-LI-kat ni-NYO?
translation: Masakit po ba ang balikat ninyo?

english: Can you lift your arm above your head?
transliteration: na-i-a-A-ngat po ba ni-NYO ang bra-SO nang lam-PAS sa U-lo?
translation: Naiaangat po ba ninyo ang braso nang lampas sa ulo?

english: Does your shoulder feel unstable or pop out?
transliteration: pa-RANG hin-DI ma-ta-TAG po ba ang ba-LI-kat ni-NYO o pa-RANG lu-MA-la-bas i-TO sa pu-WES-to?
translation: Parang hindi matatag po ba ang balikat ninyo o parang lumalabas ito sa puwesto?

english: Does your elbow hurt?
transliteration: ma-SA-kit po ba ang si-KO ni-NYO?
translation: Masakit po ba ang siko ninyo?

english: Does your wrist hurt?
transliteration: ma-SA-kit po ba ang pul-SU-han ni-NYO?
translation: Masakit po ba ang pulsuhan ninyo?

english: Do you have pain or swelling in your fingers?
transliteration: ma-SA-kit o na-ma-MA-ga po ba ang ma-NGA da-LI-ri ni-NYO?
translation: Masakit o namamaga po ba ang mga daliri ninyo?

english: Can you make a fist?
transliteration: na-ka-ku-YOM po ba ka-YO ng ka-MA-o?
translation: Nakakuyom po ba kayo ng kamao?

english: Can you grip or hold objects normally?
transliteration: na-ka-ka-HA-wak o na-ka-ka-PI-tan po ba ni-NYO nang nor-MAL ang ma-NGA ba-GAY?
translation: Nakakahawak o nakakapitan po ba ninyo nang normal ang mga bagay?

english: Do your fingers become numb at night?
transliteration: na-ma-MA-nhid po ba ang ma-NGA da-LI-ri ni-NYO sa ga-BI?
translation: Namamanhid po ba ang mga daliri ninyo sa gabi?

english: Does your hip or groin hurt?
transliteration: ma-SA-kit po ba ang ba-LA-kang o si-NGIT ni-NYO?
translation: Masakit po ba ang balakang o singit ninyo?

english: Does your knee hurt?
transliteration: ma-SA-kit po ba ang tu-HOD ni-NYO?
translation: Masakit po ba ang tuhod ninyo?

english: Does your knee swell after activity?
transliteration: na-ma-MA-ga po ba ang tu-HOD ni-NYO pag-ka-TA-pos ku-MI-los?
translation: Namamaga po ba ang tuhod ninyo pagkatapos kumilos?

english: Does your knee lock or give way?
transliteration: na-ba-BA-ra-han o bu-mi-BI-gay po ba ang tu-HOD ni-NYO?
translation: Nababarahan o bumibigay po ba ang tuhod ninyo?

english: Does your ankle hurt?
transliteration: ma-SA-kit po ba ang bu-KUNG-bu-KONG ni-NYO?
translation: Masakit po ba ang bukung-bukong ninyo?

english: Does your foot or heel hurt?
transliteration: ma-SA-kit po ba ang PA-a o sa-KONG ni-NYO?
translation: Masakit po ba ang paa o sakong ninyo?

english: Can you put weight on the injured leg?
transliteration: na-i-pa-PA-tong po ba ni-NYO ang bi-GAT ng ka-TA-wan sa na-SAK-tang ba-NTI?
translation: Naipapatong po ba ninyo ang bigat ng katawan sa nasaktang binti?

english: Can you take four steps?
transliteration: na-ka-ka-GA-wa po ba ka-YO ng a-PAT na hak-BANG?
translation: Nakakagawa po ba kayo ng apat na hakbang?

english: Do you have pain in your calf?
transliteration: ma-SA-kit po ba ang ba-NTI ni-NYO?
translation: Masakit po ba ang binti ninyo?

english: Is one calf more swollen than the other?
transliteration: mas na-ma-MA-ga po ba ang i-SANG ba-NTI ka-YSA sa ka-BI-la?
translation: Mas namamaga po ba ang isang binti kaysa sa kabila?

english: Have you been diagnosed with arthritis?
transliteration: na-sa-BI-han na po ba ka-YO na may ar-THRI-tis ka-YO?
translation: Nasabihan na po ba kayo na may arthritis kayo?

english: Have you been diagnosed with osteoarthritis?
transliteration: na-sa-BI-han na po ba ka-YO na may os-te-o-ar-THRI-tis ka-YO?
translation: Nasabihan na po ba kayo na may osteoarthritis kayo?

english: Have you been diagnosed with rheumatoid arthritis?
transliteration: na-sa-BI-han na po ba ka-YO na may ru-ma-TOID ar-THRI-tis ka-YO?
translation: Nasabihan na po ba kayo na may rheumatoid arthritis kayo?

english: Have you been diagnosed with osteoporosis or weak bones?
transliteration: na-sa-BI-han na po ba ka-YO na may os-te-o-po-RO-sis o ma-hi-HI-na ang ma-NGA bu-TO ni-NYO?
translation: Nasabihan na po ba kayo na may osteoporosis o mahihina ang mga buto ninyo?

english: Have you broken a bone before?
transliteration: na-ba-LI-an na po ba ka-YO ng bu-TO da-TI?
translation: Nabalian na po ba kayo ng buto dati?

english: Have you had a bone density test?
transliteration: nag-pa-TEST na po ba ka-YO pa-RA ma-SU-kat ang ti-BAY ng ma-NGA bu-TO ni-NYO?
translation: Nagpa-test na po ba kayo para masukat ang tibay ng mga buto ninyo?

english: Do you have pain or swelling in several joints?
transliteration: may pa-na-NA-kit o pa-MA-ma-ga po ba ka-YO sa i-LANG ka-su-ka-SU-an?
translation: May pananakit o pamamaga po ba kayo sa ilang kasukasuan?

english: Does anyone in your family have arthritis or osteoporosis?
transliteration: may ar-THRI-tis o os-te-o-po-RO-sis po ba ang si-NU-man sa pa-MIL-ya ni-NYO?
translation: May arthritis o osteoporosis po ba ang sinuman sa pamilya ninyo?

english: Have you had surgery on a bone or joint?
transliteration: na-o-pe-RA-han na po ba ka-YO sa bu-TO o ka-su-ka-SU-an?
translation: Naoperahan na po ba kayo sa buto o kasukasuan?

english: Have you had a hip or knee replacement?
transliteration: na-pal-TAN na po ba ng ar-ti-pi-SYAL na ka-su-ka-SU-an ang ba-LA-kang o tu-HOD ni-NYO?
translation: Napaltan na po ba ng artipisyal na kasukasuan ang balakang o tuhod ninyo?

english: Have you ever had a cast or splint?
transliteration: nag-ka-RO-on na po ba ka-YO ng CAST o pang-su-por-TA sa na-ba-LI-ang bu-TO?
translation: Nagkaroon na po ba kayo ng cast o pangsuporta sa nabaling buto?

english: Have you tried physiotherapy?
transliteration: na-subu-KAN na po ba ni-NYO ang phy-si-o-THER-a-py?
translation: Nasubukan na po ba ninyo ang physiotherapy?

english: What medicines have you taken for the pain?
transliteration: a-NONG ma-NGA ga-MOT na po ang i-NI-nom ni-NYO pa-RA sa sa-KIT?
translation: Anong mga gamot na po ang ininom ninyo para sa sakit?

english: Have you taken ibuprofen, naproxen, or diclofenac (Voltaren)?
transliteration: u-MI-nom na po ba ka-YO ng i-bu-PRO-fen, nap-ROK-sen, o dai-klo-FE-nak (vol-TA-ren)?
translation: Uminom na po ba kayo ng ibuprofen, naproxen, o diclofenac (Voltaren)?

english: How much medicine do you take and how often?
transliteration: ga-A-no ka-RA-mi ang i-ni-I-nom ni-NYONG ga-MOT at ga-A-no ka-DA-las?
translation: Gaano karami ang iniinom ninyong gamot at gaano kadalas?

english: How long have you been taking it?
transliteration: ga-A-no na po ka-ta-GAL u-mi-I-nom ni-NYO ni-TO?
translation: Gaano na po kayo katagal umiinom nito?

english: Has the medicine helped?
transliteration: na-ka-tu-LONG po ba ang ga-MOT?
translation: Nakatulong po ba ang gamot?

english: Do you take blood thinners or steroid medicines?
transliteration: u-mi-I-nom po ba ka-YO ng ga-MOT pam-pa-LAB-naw ng DU-go o ste-ROID?
translation: Umiinom po ba kayo ng gamot pampalabnaw ng dugo o steroid?

english: Do you have any medication allergies?
transliteration: may al-ler-JI po ba ka-YO sa a-NU-mang ga-MOT?
translation: May allergy po ba kayo sa anumang gamot?

english: I am going to examine the painful area.
transliteration: su-SU-ri-in ko po ang ba-HA-ging ma-SA-kit.
translation: Susuriin ko po ang bahaging masakit.

english: Please tell me if anything hurts.
transliteration: pa-ki-SA-bi po sa a-KIN kung may ma-SA-kit.
translation: Pakisabi po sa akin kung may masakit.

english: Please stand up.
transliteration: tu-MA-yo po ka-YO.
translation: Tumayo po kayo.

english: Please sit down.
transliteration: ma-U-po po ka-YO.
translation: Maupo po kayo.

english: Please lie on your back.
transliteration: hu-MI-ga po ka-YO nang na-ka-ti-HA-ya.
translation: Humiga po kayo nang nakatihaya.

english: Please lie on your stomach.
transliteration: hu-MI-ga po ka-YO nang pa-DA-pa.
translation: Humiga po kayo nang padapa.

english: Please walk a few steps.
transliteration: mag-la-KAD po ka-YO nang i-LANG hak-BANG.
translation: Maglakad po kayo nang ilang hakbang.

english: Please walk on your toes.
transliteration: mag-la-KAD po ka-YO nang na-ka-tip-TOE.
translation: Maglakad po kayo nang naka-tiptoe.

english: Please walk on your heels.
transliteration: mag-la-KAD po ka-YO nang na-ka-tu-KOD sa sa-KONG.
translation: Maglakad po kayo nang nakatukod sa sakong.

english: Bend forward, please.
transliteration: yu-MU-ko po ka-YO pa-su-LONG.
translation: Yumuko po kayo pasulong.

english: Bend your knee, please.
transliteration: i-ba-LUK-kot po ni-NYO ang tu-HOD.
translation: Ibaluktot po ninyo ang tuhod.

english: Straighten your knee, please.
transliteration: i-TU-wid po ni-NYO ang tu-HOD.
translation: Ituwid po ninyo ang tuhod.

english: Raise your arm, please.
transliteration: i-TA-as po ni-NYO ang bra-SO.
translation: Itaas po ninyo ang braso.

english: Make a fist and then open your hand.
transliteration: ku-MU-yom po ka-YO ng ka-MA-o, ta-POS i-BU-ka ang ka-MAY.
translation: Kumuyom po kayo ng kamao, tapos ibuka ang kamay.

english: Spread your fingers apart.
transliteration: i-hi-WA-lay po ni-NYO ang ma-NGA da-LI-ri.
translation: Ihiwalay po ninyo ang mga daliri.

english: Push against my hand.
transliteration: i-TU-lak po ni-NYO ang ka-MAY ko.
translation: Itulak po ninyo ang kamay ko.

english: Pull against my hand.
transliteration: hi-LA-hin po ni-NYO ang ka-MAY ko.
translation: Hilahin po ninyo ang kamay ko.

english: Please relax your muscles.
transliteration: lu-WA-gan po ni-NYO ang ma-NGA ka-LAM-nan.
translation: Luwagan po ninyo ang mga kalamnan.

english: Tell me if you feel this touch.
transliteration: sa-BI-hin po ni-NYO sa a-KIN kung na-ra-RAM-da-man ni-NYO ang dam-PI na i-TO.
translation: Sabihin po ninyo sa akin kung nararamdaman ninyo ang dampi na ito.

english: I am going to examine your joints and muscles.
transliteration: su-SU-ri-in ko po ang ma-NGA ka-su-ka-SU-an at ka-LAM-nan ni-NYO.
translation: Susuriin ko po ang mga kasukasuan at kalamnan ninyo.

english: Please tell me if anything hurts during the examination.
transliteration: pa-ki-SA-bi po sa a-KIN kung may ma-SA-kit ha-BANG su-su-RI-in ko ka-YO.
translation: Pakisabi po sa akin kung may masakit habang sinusuri ko kayo.

english: Please stand up straight.
transliteration: tu-MA-yo po ka-YO nang tu-WID.
translation: Tumayo po kayo nang tuwid.

english: Please walk across the room and come back.
transliteration: mag-la-KAD po ka-YO pa-ta-WID ng si-LID at bu-MA-lik.
translation: Maglakad po kayo patawid ng silid at bumalik.

english: Please walk on your heels.
transliteration: mag-la-KAD po ka-YO nang na-ka-tu-KOD sa sa-KONG.
translation: Maglakad po kayo nang nakatukod sa sakong.

english: Please walk on your toes.
transliteration: mag-la-KAD po ka-YO nang na-ka-tip-TOE.
translation: Maglakad po kayo nang naka-tiptoe.

english: Please try walking in a straight line, heel to toe.
transliteration: su-BU-kan po ni-NYONG mag-la-KAD nang tu-WID, sa-KONG sa ha-RAP ng da-LI-ri ng PA-a.
translation: Subukan po ninyong maglakad nang tuwid, sakong sa harap ng daliri ng paa.

english: Please stand on one leg.
transliteration: tu-MA-yo po ka-YO sa i-SANG PA-a.
translation: Tumayo po kayo sa isang paa.

english: Please squat down as far as you comfortably can.
transliteration: mag-SKWAT po ka-YO hang-GANG sa a-BOT ng kom-por-TA-ble sa i-NYO.
translation: Mag-squat po kayo hanggang sa abot ng komportable sa inyo.

english: Please sit down and stand up without using your hands, if you can.
transliteration: ma-U-po po ka-YO at tu-MA-yo nang hin-DI gu-mi-GA-mit ng ma-NGA ka-MAY, kung ka-YA ni-NYO.
translation: Maupo po kayo at tumayo nang hindi ginagamit ang mga kamay, kung kaya ninyo.

english: Can you put your full weight on this leg?
transliteration: KA-ya po ba ni-NYONG i-pa-TONG ang bu-ONG bi-GAT ng ka-TA-wan ni-NYO sa bin-TING i-TO?
translation: Kaya po ba ninyong ipatong ang buong bigat ng katawan ninyo sa binting ito?

english: Please lie on your back.
transliteration: hu-MI-ga po ka-YO nang na-ka-ti-HA-ya.
translation: Humiga po kayo nang nakatihaya.

english: Please lie on your stomach.
transliteration: hu-MI-ga po ka-YO nang pa-DA-pa.
translation: Humiga po kayo nang padapa.

english: Please turn onto your side.
transliteration: pu-MI-hit po ka-YO pa-ta-GI-lid.
translation: Pumihit po kayo patagilid.

english: I am going to press gently on this area.
transliteration: da-HAN-da-HAN ko pong pi-PIN-dutin ang ba-HA-ging i-TO.
translation: Dahan-dahan ko pong pipindutin ang bahaging ito.

english: Does it hurt when I press here?
transliteration: ma-SA-kit po ba ka-pag pi-ni-PIN-dot ko ri-TO?
translation: Masakit po ba kapag pinipindot ko rito?

english: Is the pain in the muscle, bone, or joint?
transliteration: na-SA ka-LAM-nan, bu-TO, o ka-su-ka-SU-an po ba ang sa-KIT?
translation: Nasa kalamnan, buto, o kasukasuan po ba ang sakit?

english: Please relax your muscles.
transliteration: lu-WA-gan po ni-NYO ang ma-NGA ka-LAM-nan.
translation: Luwagan po ninyo ang mga kalamnan.

english: I will move your arm or leg for you; try to relax.
transliteration: i-ga-GA-law ko po ang bra-SO o ba-NTI ni-NYO; su-BU-kan po ni-NYONG mag-re-LAKS.
translation: Igagalaw ko po ang braso o binti ninyo; subukan po ninyong magrelaks.

english: Please look down and bring your chin toward your chest.
transliteration: tu-MI-ngin po ka-YO pa-ba-BA at i-la-PIT ang ba-BA sa dib-DIB.
translation: Tumingin po kayo pababa at ilapit ang baba sa dibdib.

english: Please look up toward the ceiling.
transliteration: tu-MI-nga po ka-YO sa ki-SA-me.
translation: Tumingala po kayo sa kisame.

english: Please turn your head to the left and then to the right.
transliteration: i-LI-ngon po ni-NYO ang U-lo sa ka-LI-wa, ta-POS sa ka-NAN.
translation: Ilingon po ninyo ang ulo sa kaliwa, tapos sa kanan.

english: Please tilt your ear toward your shoulder.
transliteration: i-ta-GI-lid po ni-NYO ang U-lo pa-RA ma-i-la-PIT ang ta-I-nga sa ba-LI-kat.
translation: Itagilid po ninyo ang ulo para mailapit ang tainga sa balikat.

english: Please bend forward and try to touch your toes.
transliteration: yu-MU-ko po ka-YO pa-su-LONG at su-BU-kang a-BU-tin ang ma-NGA da-LI-ri ng PA-a.
translation: Yumuko po kayo pasulong at subukang abutin ang mga daliri ng paa.

english: Please lean backward as far as is comfortable.
transliteration: yu-MU-ko po ka-YO pa-A-tras hang-GANG sa kom-por-TA-ble sa i-NYO.
translation: Yumuko po kayo paatras hanggang sa komportable sa inyo.

english: Please bend sideways to each side.
transliteration: yu-MU-ko po ka-YO pa-ta-GI-lid sa mag-ka-BI-lang pa-NIG.
translation: Yumuko po kayo patagilid sa magkabilang panig.

english: Please twist your upper body to the left and right.
transliteration: i-i-KOT po ni-NYO ang i-TA-as na ba-HA-gi ng ka-TA-wan sa ka-LI-wa at ka-NAN.
translation: Iikot po ninyo ang itaas na bahagi ng katawan sa kaliwa at kanan.

english: I will raise your straight leg; tell me if pain travels down it.
transliteration: i-a-a-NGAT ko po ang tu-WID ni-NYONG ba-NTI; sa-BI-hin po ni-NYO sa a-KIN kung ku-ma-KA-lat pa-ba-BA ri-TO ang sa-KIT.
translation: Iaangat ko po ang tuwid ninyong binti; sabihin po ninyo sa akin kung kumakalat pababa rito ang sakit.

english: Does this movement cause tingling or pain down your arm?
transliteration: na-ngi-NI-lig o su-MA-sa-kit po ba ang bra-SO ni-NYO pa-ba-BA ka-pag gi-na-GA-wa ang ga-LAW na i-TO?
translation: Nangingilig o sumasakit po ba ang braso ninyo pababa kapag ginagawa ang galaw na ito?

english: Please lift your hips off the bed.
transliteration: i-A-ngat po ni-NYO ang ba-LA-kang mu-LA sa ka-MA.
translation: Iangat po ninyo ang balakang mula sa kama.

english: Please lift both arms straight in front of you.
transliteration: i-A-ngat po ni-NYO nang tu-WID ang da-LA-wang bra-SO sa ha-RAP ni-NYO.
translation: Iangat po ninyo nang tuwid ang dalawang braso sa harap ninyo.

english: Please raise both arms out to your sides.
transliteration: i-A-ngat po ni-NYO ang da-LA-wang bra-SO pa-la-BAS sa mag-ka-BI-lang ta-GI-lid.
translation: Iangat po ninyo ang dalawang braso palabas sa magkabilang tagiliran.

english: Please lift your arms above your head.
transliteration: i-A-ngat po ni-NYO ang ma-NGA bra-SO sa i-sa-BAB ng U-lo.
translation: Iangat po ninyo ang mga braso sa ibabaw ng ulo.

english: Please reach behind your head.
transliteration: i-a-BOT po ni-NYO ang ka-MAY sa LI-kod ng U-lo.
translation: Iabot po ninyo ang kamay sa likod ng ulo.

english: Please reach behind your back.
transliteration: i-a-BOT po ni-NYO ang ka-MAY sa LI-kod ng LI-kod ni-NYO.
translation: Iabot po ninyo ang kamay sa likod ng likod ninyo.

english: Keep your elbow by your side and turn your hand outward.
transliteration: pa-na-ti-LI-hing na-sa ta-GI-lid ang si-KO at i-pi-HIT pa-la-BAS ang ka-MAY.
translation: Panatilihing nasa tagiliran ang siko at ipihit palabas ang kamay.

english: Keep your elbow by your side and turn your hand inward.
transliteration: pa-na-ti-LI-hing na-sa ta-GI-lid ang si-KO at i-pi-HIT pa-LO-ob ang ka-MAY.
translation: Panatilihing nasa tagiliran ang siko at ipihit paloob ang kamay.

english: Please push your arm upward against my hand.
transliteration: i-TU-lak po ni-NYO pa-i-TA-as ang bra-SO la-BAN sa ka-MAY ko.
translation: Itulak po ninyo paitaas ang braso laban sa kamay ko.

english: Please keep your arm up while I gently push down.
transliteration: pa-na-ti-LI-hing na-ka-i-TA-as ang bra-SO ha-BANG ma-RA-han ko i-TONG i-ti-TU-lak pa-ba-BA.
translation: Panatilihing nakataas ang braso habang marahan ko itong itinutulak pababa.

english: Please bring your arm across your chest.
transliteration: i-LA-gay po ni-NYO ang bra-SO sa ta-PAT ng dib-DIB.
translation: Ilagay po ninyo ang braso sa tapat ng dibdib.

english: Please bend and straighten your elbow.
transliteration: i-ba-LUK-kot at i-TU-wid po ni-NYO ang si-KO.
translation: Ibaluktot at ituwid po ninyo ang siko.

english: Please turn your palm up, then down.
transliteration: i-ha-RAP po ni-NYO ang pa-LAD pa-i-TA-as, ta-POS pa-ba-BA.
translation: Iharap po ninyo ang palad paitaas, tapos pababa.

english: Please bend your wrist up and down.
transliteration: i-ba-LUK-kot po ni-NYO pa-i-TA-as at pa-ba-BA ang pul-SU-han.
translation: Ibaluktot po ninyo pataas at pababa ang pulsuhan.

english: Please move your wrist from side to side.
transliteration: i-ga-LAW po ni-NYO ang pul-SU-han mu-LA sa i-SANG ta-GI-lid pa-PUN-ta sa ka-BI-la.
translation: Igalaw po ninyo ang pulsuhan mula sa isang tagiliran papunta sa kabila.

english: Please make a fist.
transliteration: ku-MU-yom po ka-YO ng ka-MA-o.
translation: Kumuyom po kayo ng kamao.

english: Please open your hand and spread your fingers.
transliteration: i-BU-ka po ni-NYO ang ka-MAY at i-bu-KA-ka ang ma-NGA da-LI-ri.
translation: Ibuka po ninyo ang kamay at ibukaka ang mga daliri.

english: Please touch your thumb to each fingertip.
transliteration: i-dam-PI po ni-NYO ang hin-la-LA-ki sa DU-lo ng ba-WAT da-LI-ri.
translation: Idampi po ninyo ang hinlalaki sa dulo ng bawat daliri.

english: Please squeeze my fingers as hard as you can.
transliteration: pi-SI-lin po ni-NYO ang ma-NGA da-LI-ri ko nang pi-na-ka-MA-lakas na ka-YA ni-NYO.
translation: Pisilin po ninyo ang mga daliri ko nang pinakamalakas na kaya ninyo.

english: Please hold your fingers apart while I push them together.
transliteration: pa-na-ti-LI-hing mag-ka-hi-WA-lay ang ma-NGA da-LI-ri ha-BANG i-ti-TU-lak ko ang ma-NGA i-TO pa-RA mag-di-DI-kit.
translation: Panatilihing magkahiwalay ang mga daliri habang itinutulak ko ang mga ito para magdikit.

english: Please straighten your fingers against my hand.
transliteration: i-TU-wid po ni-NYO ang ma-NGA da-LI-ri la-BAN sa ka-MAY ko.
translation: Ituwid po ninyo ang mga daliri laban sa kamay ko.

english: Does tapping here cause tingling in your fingers?
transliteration: na-ngi-NI-lig po ba ang ma-NGA da-LI-ri ni-NYO ka-pag ti-na-TA-pik ko ri-TO?
translation: Nangingilig po ba ang mga daliri ninyo kapag tinatapik ko rito?

english: Please bend both wrists and hold the backs of your hands together.
transliteration: i-ba-LUK-kot po ni-NYO ang da-la-WANG pul-SU-han at pag-di-KIT-in ang LI-kod ng ma-NGA ka-MAY.
translation: Ibaluktot po ninyo ang dalawang pulsuhan at pagdikitin ang likod ng mga kamay.

english: Please grip my fingers and do not let go.
transliteration: ha-WA-kan po ni-NYO ang ma-NGA da-LI-ri ko nang ma-HI-gpit at hu-WAG bi-bi-Taw.
translation: Hawakan po ninyo ang mga daliri ko nang mahigpit at huwag bibitaw.

english: Please bring your knee toward your chest.
transliteration: i-la-PIT po ni-NYO ang tu-HOD sa dib-DIB.
translation: Ilapit po ninyo ang tuhod sa dibdib.

english: Please move your leg out to the side.
transliteration: i-ga-LAW po ni-NYO ang ba-NTI pa-la-BAS sa ta-GI-lid.
translation: Igalaw po ninyo ang binti palabas sa tagiliran.

english: Please bring your leg back toward the middle.
transliteration: i-ba-LIK po ni-NYO ang ba-NTI pa-PUN-ta sa git-NA.
translation: Ibalik po ninyo ang binti papunta sa gitna.

english: I will gently rotate your hip; tell me if it hurts.
transliteration: da-HAN-da-HAN kong i-i-KOT ang ba-LA-kang ni-NYO; sa-BI-hin po ni-NYO kung ma-SA-kit.
translation: Dahan-dahan kong iikot ang balakang ninyo; sabihin po ninyo kung masakit.

english: Please bend your knee and let it fall outward.
transliteration: i-ba-LUK-kot po ni-NYO ang tu-HOD at ha-YA-ang bu-MAG-sak i-TO pa-la-BAS.
translation: Ibaluktot po ninyo ang tuhod at hayaang bumagsak ito palabas.

english: Please lift your straight leg off the bed.
transliteration: i-A-ngat po ni-NYO ang tu-WID na ba-NTI mu-LA sa ka-MA.
translation: Iangat po ninyo ang tuwid na binti mula sa kama.

english: Please push your knee outward against my hand.
transliteration: i-TU-lak po ni-NYO pa-la-BAS ang tu-HOD la-BAN sa ka-MAY ko.
translation: Itulak po ninyo palabas ang tuhod laban sa kamay ko.

english: Please stand on one leg while I check your hips.
transliteration: tu-MA-yo po ka-YO sa i-SANG PA-a ha-BANG su-su-RI-in ko ang ba-LA-kang ni-NYO.
translation: Tumayo po kayo sa isang paa habang sinusuri ko ang balakang ninyo.

english: Please bend your knee as far as you can.
transliteration: i-ba-LUK-kot po ni-NYO ang tu-HOD hang-GANG sa ka-YA ni-NYO.
translation: Ibaluktot po ninyo ang tuhod hanggang sa kaya ninyo.

english: Please straighten your knee completely.
transliteration: pa-kee-too-LOO-yan pong ee-TOO-wid ang ee-NYONG TOO-hod
translation: Pakituluyan pong ituwid ang inyong tuhod.

english: Please tighten the muscles at the front of your thigh.
transliteration: pa-kee-HIG-pee-tan po ang mga ka-LAM-nan sa ha-RAP ng ee-NYONG hee-TA
translation: Pakihigpitan po ang mga kalamnan sa harap ng inyong hita.

english: Please lift your straight leg while keeping your knee straight.
transliteration: pa-kee-TA-as po ang TOO-wid nee-NYONG BIN-tee ha-BANG na-na-na-TEE-ling TOO-wid ang ee-NYONG TOO-hod
translation: Pakitaas po ang tuwid ninyong binti habang nananatiling tuwid ang inyong tuhod.

english: I will gently move your kneecap.
transliteration: ma-RA-han ko pong ee-ga-GA-law ang ee-NYONG BOO-to sa TOO-hod
translation: Marahan ko pong igagalaw ang inyong buto sa tuhod.

english: I will gently test whether your knee feels stable.
transliteration: ma-RA-han ko pong soo-soo-BOO-kan kung ma-TA-tag ang ee-NYONG TOO-hod
translation: Marahan ko pong susubukan kung matatag ang inyong tuhod.

english: Does your knee click, catch, or lock when you move it?
transliteration: may na-ree-REE-nig o na-ra-RA-man-dam po ba ka-YONG pag-click, pag-SA-bit, o pag-ka-PIR-mee ng TOO-hod ka-pag ee-gee-ga-GA-law nee-NYO ee-to
translation: May naririnig o nararamdaman po ba kayong pag-click, pagsabit, o pagkapirmi ng tuhod kapag iginagalaw ninyo ito?

english: Does your knee feel like it might give way?
transliteration: pa-kee-RAM-dam po ba nee-NYO ay ma-a-a-RING boo-ma-GAY ang ee-NYONG TOO-hod
translation: Pakiramdam po ba ninyo ay maaaring bumigay ang inyong tuhod?

english: Please take a few steps and turn around.
transliteration: pa-kee-LA-kad po nang ee-LANG HAK-bang at poo-MEE-hit pa-BA-lik
translation: Pakilakad po nang ilang hakbang at pumihit pabalik.

english: Please do a small squat if you feel safe doing so.
transliteration: pa-kee-soo-BOO-kan po ang ba-HA-gyang pag-squat kung LIG-tas ee-to pa-RA sa ee-NYO
translation: Pakisubukan po ang bahagyang pag-squat kung ligtas ito para sa inyo.

english: Please point your toes down.
transliteration: pa-kee-DOOT-dot po pa-BA-ba ang ee-NYONG mga da-LEE-ree sa PA-a
translation: Pakidutdot po pababa ang inyong mga daliri sa paa.

english: Please pull your toes up toward your head.

english: Have you noticed changes in your sleep or mood?

english: Are you using hormone therapy?

english: Have you ever had ovarian cysts or fibroids?

english: We need to assess you urgently.

translation: Maaaring kailangan po namin ng pagsusuri ng dugo.

english: We will check your blood count.
transliteration: bee-BEE-lang-in po na-MEEN ang mga se-LOO-la sa DUG-o nee-NYO

english: Does the pain move toward your back?

translation: Kumakalat po ba ang sakit papunta sa likod ninyo?

english: Have you noticed any skin changes on your breast?

english: Has anyone in your family had breast cancer?
transliteration: nag-kah-ROON nah poh bah ng kahn-SEHR sah SOO-nee-mahn sah pah-MEEL-yah NEE-nyoh

english: Have you had a mammogram or breast ultrasound?
transliteration: nag-pah-MAM-oh-gram oh OOL-tra-sound nah poh bah kah-yoh sah SOO-soh

english: Do you have pain around your anus?

english: Does it hurt when you pass stool?

english: Have you noticed blood on the toilet paper?
transliteration: may nah-pahn-SEEN poh bah kah-YOHNG DOO-goh sah TEE-shoo pag-kah-TAH-pos mag-POON-yahs
translation: May napansin po ba kayong dugo sa tisyu pagkatapos magpunas?

english: Have you noticed a lump near your anus?
transliteration: may nah-pahn-SEEN poh bah kah-YOHNG boo-KOL mah-LEE-kat sah POO-yoot NEE-nyoh
translation: May napansin po ba kayong bukol malapit sa puwit ninyo?

english: Is there any discharge or pus near your anus?
transliteration: may loo-MAH-lah-bahs poh bang lee-KEE-doh oh nah-NAH mah-LEE-kat sah POO-yoot NEE-nyoh

english: Have you ever had hemorrhoids or piles?
transliteration: nag-kah-ROON nah poh bah kah-yoh ng ahl-moh-RAH-nahs

english: Have you had surgery before?

english: What operation did you have?
transliteration: AH-nong oh-peh-rah-SYON poh ang gee-NAH-wah sah ee-NYOH

english: When was your last operation?
transliteration: KAI-lahn poh ang HOO-lee NEE-nyong oh-peh-rah-SYON

english: Have you had surgery on your abdomen?
transliteration: nah-oh-peh-RAH-hahn nah poh bah kah-yoh sah TEE-yahn
translation: Naoperahan na po ba kayo sa tiyan?

english: Have you had your appendix removed?
transliteration: nah-AH-lis nah poh bah ang ah-PEN-deeks NEE-nyoh

english: Have you ever had problems after surgery?
transliteration: nag-kah-ROON nah poh bah kah-yoh ng proh-BLEH-mah pag-kah-TAH-pos oh-peh-rah-HAHN

english: Have you ever had trouble with anesthesia?
transliteration: nag-kah-ROON nah poh bah kah-yoh ng proh-BLEH-mah sah pahm-pah-TOO-log noong ee-noh-oh-peh-rah-HAHN kah-yoh
translation: Nagkaroon na po ba kayo ng problema sa pampatulog noong inooperahan kayo?

english: Do you have diabetes, heart disease, or lung disease?
transliteration: may dah-ee-ah-BEE-tis, sah-KEET sah POO-soh, oh sah-KEET sah BAH-gah poh bah kah-yoh
translation: May diabetes, sakit sa puso, o sakit sa baga po ba kayo?

english: Have you ever been diagnosed with cancer?
transliteration: nah-sah-BEE-hahn nah poh bah kah-yoh ng dok-TOR nah may kahn-SEHR kah-yoh
translation: Nasabihan na po ba kayo ng doktor na may kanser kayo?

english: Have you ever had an organ transplant?
transliteration: nag-kah-ROON nah poh bah kah-yoh ng TRANZ-plant ng OR-gahn
translation: Nagkaroon na po ba kayo ng transplant ng organ?

english: What medicines do you take regularly?
transliteration: AH-nong mah-GAH gah-MOT poh ang reh-goo-LAHR NEE-nyong ee-NEE-nohm
translation: Anong mga gamot po ang regular ninyong iniinom?

english: Do you take blood thinners?
transliteration: oo-mee-NEE-nohm poh bah kah-yoh ng pahm-pah-LAHB-naw ng DOO-goh
translation: Umiinom po ba kayo ng pampalabnaw ng dugo?

english: Do you take aspirin?
transliteration: oo-mee-NEE-nohm poh bah kah-yoh ng AS-pi-rin
translation: Umiinom po ba kayo ng aspirin?

english: Do you take steroids or medicines that suppress your immune system?
transliteration: oo-mee-NEE-nohm poh bah kah-yoh ng STEH-roid oh gah-MOT nah nag-pah-PAH-hee-nah sah ee-MYOON SIS-tem NEE-nyoh
translation: Umiinom po ba kayo ng steroid o gamot na nagpapahina sa immune system ninyo?

english: Are you allergic to any medicines?
transliteration: may AL-ler-jee poh bah kah-yoh sah ah-NUH-mang gah-MOT
translation: May allergy po ba kayo sa anumang gamot?

english: Have you ever had excessive bleeding after surgery?
transliteration: nag-kah-ROON nah poh bah kah-yoh ng mah-TEE-ning pag-doo-ROO-goh pag-kah-TAH-pos oh-peh-rah-HAHN
translation: Nagkaroon na po ba kayo ng matinding pagdurugo pagkatapos operahan?

english: Do you smoke or vape?
transliteration: nah-nee-nee-gah-REE-boh oh nag-beh-VAPE poh bah kah-yoh
translation: Naninigarilyo o nagbe-vape po ba kayo?

english: Do you drink alcohol?
transliteration: oo-mee-NEE-nohm poh bah kah-yoh ng ah-LAHK
translation: Umiinom po ba kayo ng alak?

english: Please lie down on the examination bed.
transliteration: hoo-MEE-gah poh kah-yoh sah KAH-mah pah-RAH sah pag-soosoo-REE
translation: Humiga po kayo sa kama para sa pagsusuri.

english: Please bend your knees slightly.
transliteration: bah-HAHG-yah poh NEE-nyong ee-bah-LOOT-kot ang mah-GAH too-DOO NEE-nyoh
translation: Bahagya po ninyong ibaluktot ang mga tuhod ninyo.

english: I am going to examine your abdomen.
transliteration: soo-soo-REE-in koh poh ang TEE-yahn NEE-nyoh
translation: Susuriin ko po ang tiyan ninyo.

english: I will gently press on your abdomen.
transliteration: mah-rah-HAHN koh pong pee-pee-SEE-leen ang TEE-yahn NEE-nyoh
translation: Marahan ko pong pipisilin ang tiyan ninyo.

english: Tell me if this is painful.
transliteration: SAH-bee-hin poh NEE-nyoh kung mah-SAH-keet EE-toh
translation: Sabihin po ninyo kung masakit ito.

english: Does it hurt more when I release the pressure?
transliteration: mahs mah-SAH-keet poh bah kah-pahg ee-NAH-ah-lis koh ang DEE-een
translation: Mas masakit po ba kapag inaalis ko ang diin?

english: Please take a deep breath.
transliteration: hoo-MEE-ngah poh kah-yoh nang mah-lah-LEEM
translation: Huminga po kayo nang malalim.

english: Please cough once.
transliteration: oo-MOO-boh poh kah-yoh nang ee-sahng BAH-yes
translation: Umubo po kayo nang isang beses.

english: May I examine the lump?
transliteration: mah-AH-ah-ree koh poh bang soo-ree-HEEN ang boo-KOL
translation: Maaari ko po bang suriin ang bukol?

english: May I examine your surgical scar?
transliteration: mah-AH-ah-ree koh poh bang soo-ree-HEEN ang peh-KLAT NEE-nyoh moo-LAH sah oh-peh-rah-SYON
translation: Maaari ko po bang suriin ang peklat ninyo mula sa operasyon?

english: I would like to examine your breast, if you agree.
transliteration: GOOS-toh koh poh sah-NANG soo-ree-HEEN ang SOO-soh NEE-nyoh, kung poo-mah-PAH-yag kah-yoh
translation: Gusto ko po sanang suriin ang suso ninyo, kung pumapayag kayo.

english: We can have a chaperone present during the examination.
transliteration: mah-AH-ah-ree pong may kah-SAH-mah hah-BANG ee-sah-sah-GAH-nahp ang pag-soosoo-REE
translation: Maaari pong may kasama habang isinasagawa ang pagsusuri.

english: I need to examine the area around your anus.
transliteration: kah-ee-LAHN-gahn koh pong soo-ree-HEEN ang pah-LEE-geed ng POO-yoot NEE-nyoh
translation: Kailangan ko pong suriin ang paligid ng puwit ninyo.

english: A rectal examination involves gently placing a gloved finger into the rectum.

translation: Sa pagsusuri sa puwit, marahang ipinapasok ang daliring may guwantes sa tumbong.

english: Do I have your permission to perform this examination?

translation: Pumapayag po ba kayo na gawin ko ang pagsusuring ito?

english: Please tell me if you want me to stop at any time.
transliteration: SAH-bee-hin poh NEE-nyoh sah ah-KIN kung GOOS-toh NEE-nyong hoom-TOH koh ah-noo-MAHNG OH-ras
translation: Sabihin po ninyo sa akin kung gusto ninyong huminto ako anumang oras.

english: We need to take a blood sample.
transliteration: kah-ee-LAHN-gahn poh nah-TEEN koo-MAH-ha ng DOO-goh
translation: Kailangan po nating kumuha ng dugo.

english: We would like to do an ultrasound scan.
transliteration: GOOS-toh poh NAA-ming mag-pah-OOL-tra-sound
translation: Gusto po naming magpa-ultrasound.

english: We may need a CT scan of your abdomen.
transliteration: mah-ah-ah-REE kah-ee-LAHN-gahn poh nah-TEEN mag-pah-SEE-tee scan ng TEE-yahn NEE-nyoh
translation: Maaaring kailanganin po nating magpa-CT scan ng tiyan ninyo.

english: Have you had a CT scan before?
transliteration: nag-pah-SEE-tee scan nah poh bah kah-yoh dah-TEE
translation: Nagpa-CT scan na po ba kayo dati?

english: We may need an MRI scan.
transliteration: mah-ah-ah-REE kah-ee-LAHN-gahn poh nah-TEEN mag-pah-em-ar-AI scan
translation: Maaaring kailanganin po nating magpa-MRI scan.

english: We would like to take a small tissue sample for testing.
transliteration: GOOS-toh poh NAA-ming koo-MAH-hah ng mah-LEE-it nah pee-RAH-soh ng LAH-mahn pah-RAH mah-soo-REE
translation: Gusto po naming kumuha ng maliit na piraso ng laman para masuri.

english: This is called a biopsy.
transliteration: BAI-op-see poh ang tah-WAHG dee-TOH
translation: Biopsy po ang tawag dito.

english: We may need to look inside your bowel with a camera.
transliteration: mah-ah-ah-REE kah-ee-LAHN-gahn poh nah-TEEN tee-NGAHN ang LOH-ob ng bee-TEE-kah GAH-mit ang KAH-meh-rah
translation: Maaaring kailanganin po nating tingnan ang loob ng bituka gamit ang kamera.

english: You may need an operation.
transliteration: mah-ah-ah-REE kah-ee-LAHN-gahn poh NEE-nyo ng oh-peh-rah-SYON
translation: Maaaring kailanganin po ninyo ng operasyon.

english: We will explain the benefits and risks of surgery.

translation: Ipapaliwanag po namin ang mga benepisyo at panganib ng operasyon.

english: There may be alternatives to surgery.
transliteration: mah-ah-ah-REE may ee-BAH pang pah-RAH-an boo-KOD sah oh-peh-rah-SYON
translation: Maaaring may iba pang paraan bukod sa operasyon.

english: Do you have any questions about the operation?
transliteration: may mah-GAH tah-NONG poh bah kah-yoh tooh-KOL sah oh-peh-rah-SYON
translation: May mga tanong po ba kayo tungkol sa operasyon?

english: You may need general anesthesia, which makes you unconscious during surgery.
transliteration: mah-ah-ah-REE kah-ee-LAHN-gahn poh NEE-nyo ng JEH-neh-ral an-es-THEE-zhah, nah mag-pah-TOO-log sah ee-NYOH hah-BANG ee-noh-oh-peh-rah-HAHN
translation: Maaaring kailanganin po ninyo ng general anesthesia, na magpapatulog sa inyo habang inooperahan.

english: Local anesthesia numbs only the area being treated.
transliteration: pee-nee-pah-MAH-neet poh ng LOH-kal an-es-THEE-zhah ang bah-HAH-geng gah-gah-MOO-tin LAH-mang
translation: Pinapamanhid po ng local anesthesia ang bahaging gagamutin lamang.

english: We may need to make a small cut in the skin.
transliteration: mah-ah-ah-REE kah-ee-LAHN-gahn poh NAA-ming goo-MAH-wah ng mah-LEE-it nah HEE-wah sah BAH-lat
translation: Maaaring kailanganin po naming gumawa ng maliit na hiwa sa balat.

english: We may need to place a drain to remove fluid.
transliteration: mah-ah-ah-REE kah-ee-LAHN-gahn poh NAA-ming mag-LAH-gay ng TOO-boh pah-rah mah-AH-lis ang lee-KEE-doh
translation: Maaaring kailanganin po naming maglagay ng tubo para maalis ang likido.

english: We may need to close the wound with stitches.
transliteration: mah-ah-ah-REE kah-ee-LAHN-gahn poh NAA-ming tah-HEE-in ang soo-GAHT
translation: Maaaring kailanganin po naming tahiin ang sugat.

english: When did you last eat or drink anything?
transliteration: KAI-lahn poh kah-yoh HOO-ling kah-MAH-een oh oo-MEE-nohm ng kah-HEET ah-NOH
translation: Kailan po kayo huling kumain o uminom ng kahit ano?

english: Please do not eat or drink until the team tells you it is safe.
transliteration: HOO-wag poh kah-yohng koo-MAH-een oh oo-MEE-nohm hang-GANG hin-DEE see-NAH-sah-bee ng pahng-KAHT nah LIG-tahs nah
translation: Huwag po kayong kumain o uminom hangga't hindi sinasabi ng pangkat na ligtas na.

english: Have you spoken with the anesthesiologist?
transliteration: nah-KAH-oosahp nah poh bah kah-yoh sah ah-nes-THEE-zhaw-logist
translation: Nakausap na po ba ninyo ang anesthesiologist?

english: Is there any chance you could be pregnant?
transliteration: may poh-see-bee-LEE-dahd poh bah nah boong-GEES kah-yoh
translation: May posibilidad po ba na buntis kayo?

english: We will check your blood pressure and pulse.
transliteration: soo-soo-KAH-tin poh NAA-meen ang preh-SYON ng DOO-goh at POOL-soh NEE-nyoh
translation: Susukatin po namin ang presyon ng dugo at pulso ninyo.

english: We may give you fluids through a vein.
transliteration: mah-ah-ah-REE big-YAHN poh NAA-meen kah-yoh ng lee-KEE-doh sah pam-mah-GEE-tahn ng OO-gat
translation: Maaaring bigyan po namin kayo ng likido sa pamamagitan ng ugat.

english: I am going to check your wound.
transliteration: tee-TEE-ngnan koh poh ang soo-GAHT NEE-nyoh
translation: Titingnan ko po ang sugat ninyo.

english: Is the wound more painful than before?
transliteration: mahs mah-SAH-keet poh bah ang soo-GAHT key-SAH-dah-TEE
translation: Mas masakit po ba ang sugat kaysa dati?

english: Have you noticed redness or swelling around the wound?
transliteration: may nah-pahn-SEEN poh bah kah-YOHNG pah-moo-MOO-lah oh pah-mah-MAH-gah sah pah-LEE-geed ng soo-GAHT
translation: May napansin po ba kayong pamumula o pamamaga sa paligid ng sugat?

english: Is any pus coming from the wound?
transliteration: may loo-MAH-lah-bahs poh bang nah-NAH sah soo-GAHT
translation: May lumalabas po bang nana sa sugat?

english: We will change the dressing.
transliteration: pah-pah-lee-TAHN poh NAA-meen ang ben-DAH
translation: Papalitan po namin ang benda.

english: Please keep the dressing clean and dry.
transliteration: pah-nah-TEE-lee-hin poh NEE-nyong mah-LEE-nis at TOO-yoh ang ben-DAH
translation: Panatilihin po ninyong malinis at tuyo ang benda.

english: We will remove the stitches when the wound has healed enough.
transliteration: tah-tahng-GAH-lin poh NAA-meen ang mah-GAH tah-HEE kah-pahg sah-PAHT nah ang pag-GAH-ling ng soo-GAHT
translation: Tatanggalin po namin ang mga tahi kapag sapat na ang paggaling ng sugat.

english: Is the drain collecting fluid?
transliteration: may nah-ee-EE-pong lee-KEE-doh poh bah sah drain
translation: May naiipong likido po ba sa drain?

english: How is your pain since the operation?
transliteration: koo-MOOS-tah poh ang pah-nah-NAH-keet NEE-nyoh moo-LAH nang ee-noh-oh-peh-rah-HAHN kah-yoh
translation: Kumusta po ang pananakit ninyo mula nang operahan kayo?

english: Have you been able to eat or drink?
transliteration: nah-kah-KAH-een oh nah-kah-EE-nohm nah poh bah kah-yoh
translation: Nakakain o nakainom na po ba kayo?

english: Have you felt nauseated or vomited?
transliteration: nah-soo-SOO-kah poh bah kah-yoh oh nag-SOO-kah
translation: Nasusuka po ba kayo o nagsuka?

english: Have you passed gas since surgery?
transliteration: nah-kah-pag-LEE-bas nah poh bah kah-yoh ng HAH-ngin moo-LAH nang ee-noh-oh-peh-rah-HAHN kah-yoh
translation: Nakapaglabas na po ba kayo ng hangin mula nang operahan kayo?

english: Have you passed stool since surgery?
transliteration: nah-kah-DOO-mee nah poh bah kah-yoh moo-LAH nang ee-noh-oh-peh-rah-HAHN kah-yoh
translation: Nakadumi na po ba kayo mula nang operahan kayo?

english: Have you been able to get out of bed and walk?
transliteration: nah-kah-BANG-on at nah-kah-LAH-kad nah poh bah kah-yoh
translation: Nakabangon at nakalakad na po ba kayo?

english: Have you had any trouble passing urine?
transliteration: nah-hee-HEE-rah-pahn poh bah kah-YOHNG oo-MEE-hee
translation: Nahihirapan po ba kayong umihi?

english: Please ask for help before getting up if you feel dizzy.
transliteration: hoo-MEE-ngi poh MOO-nah kah-yoh ng TOO-long bah-GOON too-MAH-yoh kung nah-hee-HEE-loh kah-yoh
translation: Humingi po muna kayo ng tulong bago tumayo kung nahihilo kayo.

english: Do you have severe or worsening abdominal pain?
transliteration: mah-TEEN-dee poh bah oh loo-mah-LAH-lah ang sah-KEET ng TEE-yahn NEE-nyoh
translation: Matindi po ba o lumalala ang sakit ng tiyan ninyo?

english: Have you been vomiting repeatedly?
transliteration: pah-oo-LEET-oo-LEET poh bah kah-YOHNG nag-soo-SOO-kah
translation: Paulit-ulit po ba kayong nagsusuka?

english: Are you unable to pass gas or stool?
transliteration: hin-DEE poh bah kah-yoh mah-kah-pag-LEE-bas ng HAH-ngin oh doo-MEE-mee
translation: Hindi po ba kayo makapaglabas ng hangin o dumumi?

english: Do you have a fever or chills?
transliteration: may lag-NAHT oh pah-nee-NEE-gding poh bah kah-yoh
translation: May lagnat o panginginig po ba kayo?

english: Is the wound bleeding heavily?
transliteration: mah-LAH-kahs poh bah ang pag-doo-ROO-goh ng soo-GAHT
translation: Malakas po ba ang pagdurugo ng sugat?

english: Do you have chest pain or trouble breathing?
transliteration: may sah-KEET poh bah kah-yoh sah dib-DIB oh nah-hee-HEE-rah-pahng hoo-MEE-ngah
translation: May sakit po ba kayo sa dibdib o nahihirapang huminga?

english: Have you fainted or felt very dizzy?
transliteration: nah-hee-MAH-tay poh bah kah-yoh oh nah-kah-RAH-mdahm ng mah-TEE-ning pag-kee-LEE-oh
translation: Nahimatay po ba kayo o nakaramdam ng matinding pagkahilo?

english: If these symptoms occur, seek emergency medical care.
transliteration: kung mahng-YAH-ree ang mah-GAH sim-TOH-mahs nah EE-toh, mag-pah-gah-MOOT poh kah-yoh ah-GAHD sah ee-mer-JEN-see room
translation: Kung mangyari ang mga sintomas na ito, magpagamot po kayo agad sa emergency room.

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment with the surgical team.
transliteration: ah-ah-YOO-sin poh NAA-meen ang FAH-low-up nah ah-POYNT-ment NEE-nyo sah pahng-KAHT ng mah-GAH see-ROO-hah-noh
translation: Aayusin po namin ang follow-up na appointment ninyo sa pangkat ng mga siruhano.

english: We may refer you to a cancer specialist.
transliteration: mah-ah-ah-REE ee-ree-FEHR poh NAA-meen kah-yoh sah es-peh-SYAH-lees-tah sah kahn-SEHR
translation: Maaaring i-refer po namin kayo sa espesyalista sa kanser.

english: Please come back if the wound becomes red, swollen, or painful.
transliteration: boo-mah-LEEK poh kah-yoh kung mah-MOO-lah, mah-MAH-gah, oh soo-MAH-keet ang soo-GAHT
translation: Bumalik po kayo kung mamula, mamaga, o sumakit ang sugat.

english: Do you have any questions?
transliteration: may mah-GAH tah-NONG poh bah kah-yoh
translation: May mga tanong po ba kayo?

english: Can you explain how you will care for the wound at home?
transliteration: mah-AH-ah-ree poh bah NEE-nyong ee-pah-lee-WAH-nag kung PAH-ah-noh NEE-nyong ah-ah-LAH-gah-an ang soo-GAHT sah BAH-hay
translation: Maaari po ba ninyong ipaliwanag kung paano ninyo aalagaan ang sugat sa bahay?

english: Thank you for speaking with me today.
transliteration: sah-LAH-maht poh sah pak-kee-pag-oo-SAHp NEE-nyo sah ah-KIN ngah-YON
translation: Salamat po sa pakikipag-usap ninyo sa akin ngayon.
